entries.trans: a. 幸运的, 幸福的
example: Another one of my roommates was not as fortunate. She had a boyfriend but now all that is history.
我的另一个舍友就没有这么幸运了。她曾经有一个男朋友，可惜已经分手。

entries.trans: adv. 幸运地, 幸亏
example: Fortunately Kennedy and Khrushchev understood the trap they were in and did what was necessary to avoid disaster.
所幸肯尼迪和赫鲁晓夫明白这个陷阱并且做了该做的来避免灾难。

entries.trans: n. 财富, 运气, 兴隆, 大量财产, 好运, 命运；[法] 命运, 财产, 大量财产
example: Whether Asian economies are up to that long-term challenge is something on which fortune tellers might usefully comment.
亚洲经济能否战胜这一长期挑战，算命大师们或许可以发表些有用的评论。

entries.trans: n. 论坛, 公开讨论的广场, 法庭, 讨论会；[法] 讨论会, 专题讨论, 公共论坛
example: Original I decided to be not to return to any son in the forum, but saw a son, I tell the oneself this son to must return!
本来我决定不在论坛回任何帖子了，但是看了你的帖子，我告诉自己这个帖子是一定要回的！

entries.trans: n. 化石, 古物；a. 化石的, 陈腐的, 守旧的
example: Scientists have found a 67 million-year-old fossil of a snake coiled around dinosaur eggs and a hatchling.
科学家在一块6700万年的化石中发现了一条蛇盘绕在恐龙蛋和一只幼仔周围。

entries.trans: a. 收养的, 养育的；vt. 养育, 抚育, 培养, 鼓励, 抱(希望)
a. 污秽的, 邪恶的, 恶臭的, 肮脏的, 恶劣的, 淤塞的；vt. 弄脏, 妨害, 污蔑, 犯规, 淤塞；vi. 腐烂, 犯规, 缠结；adv. 违反规则地, 不正当地；n. 犯规, 缠绕
example: On the court, his confidence level is on the rise and he has had some good and not-so-good games while trying to deal with foul trouble.
球场上他的信心继续增长。虽说有时打得好，有时打得不够好，但控制犯规一直是他努力的方向。

entries.trans: vt. 建立, 创立, 铸造；find的过去式和过去分词
example: At twenty-three, I finally escaped and found myself sailing for a year and a half down the inter-coastal waterway to the Bahamas.
23岁那年，我终于逃跑了，然后沿着两岸间水道航行了一年半，向南去往巴哈马群岛。

entries.trans: n. 基础, 根据, 建立；[化] 地基
example: At 85, Edwards is now too frail to give interviews, but his wife told the Nobel Foundation of his happiness at receiving the prize.
85岁高龄的爱德华，爱德华兹由于身体欠佳，无法在获奖后立即接受采访。他的妻子对诺贝尔基金委转达了他得奖后的喜悦心情。

entries.trans: n. 水源, 源, 喷泉, 泉水, 本源；[医] 泉
example: He remembered the fountain below the hill, when holding on to his mother's sarovary (loose Turkish trousers) he had gone with her for water.
他想到了喷泉低于山当抱着妈妈sarovary（活土耳其裤）他已经与她取水。

entries.trans: n. 鸟, 飞禽, 家禽；vi. 打鸟
example: One of a breed of American domestic fowl having gray, barred plumage, yellow legs, and a rose - colored comb.
多米尼加鸡；芦花纹鸡一种羽毛灰色有花斑、腿黄、冠玫瑰色的美国家禽。

entries.trans: n. 狐狸, 狡猾的人；vi. 奸狡地行动, (书页)生斑, 变酸；vt. 欺骗, 使变酸, 为(鞋等)换面, 使生黄斑
example: Oh, some stones and mud!  Fox goes on with his head down as if he is very busy.
“哦，是石头和土！”狐狸弗克斯很忙碌的样子，低着头继续往前走。

entries.trans: n. 小部分, 破片, 分数；[医] 部分, 成分, 分散
example: At least some of the substantially asphaltene-free, and metal-free distillate fraction is converted to a hydrogen donor diluent.
至少部分基本上不含沥青质且不含金属的馏出馏分被转化成供氢体稀释剂。

entries.trans: n. 破碎, 骨折；v. (使)破碎, (使)破裂
example: Deaths were due to pre-existing medical conditions or events, which had occurred at the time of hip fracture.
死亡由于先前存在的健康状况和事件，在髋部骨折期间诱发。

entries.trans: a. 易碎的, 脆的；[医] 脆弱的, 脆的
example: Lovers of unprovoked betrayal of deeply hurt Butterfly fragile mind, he made the next swear: Lovers vow not to kill man.
祝英台的无端背叛深深伤害了梁山伯脆弱的心灵，他发下毒誓：不杀祝英台誓不为人。

entries.trans: n. 碎片, 破片, 片段；[计] 段落; 片段; 分段
example: Space experts are trying to solve the mystery of 'a UFO fragment' which crashed close to a village in Siberia.
航天专家正在设法揭开这个在西伯利亚的村庄附近坠毁的“飞碟碎块”的秘密。

entries.trans: a. 芬香的, 馥郁的, 愉快的
example: Lemon balm is a fragrant oil that is often used in warding of pests or insects in the garden or in herbal insect repellents .
柠檬香蜂草是一种芬芳的精油，经常用于花园中防御有害物或昆虫，或者用于草本植物杀虫剂。

entries.trans: a. 脆弱的, 虚弱的, 意志薄弱的；n. 少女, 少妇, 灯心草篓
example: And yet, at a time of fast-melting glaciers and strange rains, of spreading deserts and rising seas, it is a frail and distant promise.
然而，一个时期中迅速消融的冰川与奇奇怪怪的降雨，沙漠扩大及海平面上升，环保规划显得脆弱而遥远。

entries.trans: n. 框, 结构, 体格；vt. 构成, 设计, 制定, 使适合, 陷害；[计] 框架, 图文框, 帧
example: That actually reminds me of some foreign mechanical philosopher, whose name slipt my mind, but he said: "Space is an empty frame! "
这反倒让我想起了外国的某机械唯物主义哲学家，名字我给忘了，但是，他说：“空间，是虚无的框架！”

entries.trans: n. 结构, 骨架, 参照标准, 准则, 观点；[医] 构架组织
example: The target platform is typically described in terms related to the implementation language and a technical framework on top of that.
目标平台是用与实现语言以及技术框架相关的术语描述的。

entries.trans: n. 法国
example: Now France has put an air force behind its fine words, with military strikes against an Arab leader that would once have been unthinkable.
现在法国用空中军事力量武装自己好听的言辞，同时用军事行动反对一位阿拉伯领导人，曾几何时这是完全想不到的事情。

entries.trans: a. 坦白的, 率直的, 老实的；vt. 免费邮寄；n. 免费邮寄特权
example: Here is one of my favorite scenes featuring the words of the teacher Frank seems to have admired most, Mr. O'Halloran.
以下是我最喜欢的场景之一，写的是弗兰克最景仰的奥哈洛伦老师的话。

entries.trans: n. 欺骗, 欺诈, 诡计, 骗子；[经] 欺诈, 舞弊, 骗子
example: Violation (either through fraud or negligence) by a trustee of a duty that equity requires of him.
There is no indication, however, that the company was trying to deceive anyone or that any kind of fraud was taking place.

entries.trans: n. 自由, 坦率, 特权；[法] 自由, 自主, 免除
example: Over time the grief and sense of loss left and greater freedom and a higher vibration achieved in their evolution was the result.
随着时间的过去，结果就是，在他们提升中悲痛与丧失感消失了，而更大的自由和更高的振动实现了。

entries.trans: adv. 自由地, 随意地, 无拘束地, 直率地, 坦白地, 慷慨地, 免费地, 大量地；[计] 浮动地
example: Since China in June began to let the yuan float more freely, it has gained less than 3% against the dollar.
自6月中国允许人民币汇率更加自由地浮动以来，人民币兑美元升值幅度不到3%。

entries.trans: vi. 冻结, 冷冻, 僵硬, 楞住；vt. 使结冰, 使冻住, 使呆住；n. 结冰, 凝固；[计] 冻结
example: Mannitol is usually used as a cryoprotectant and an excipient during pharmaceutical freeze-drying.
甘露醇是药品冷冻干燥中常用的低温保护剂和赋形剂。

entries.trans: n. 船货, 运费, 货运；vt. 装货, 使充满, 以货运运送, 租(或出租)(船等)
example: Cargo can also be sent out of Chongqing along the Yangtze or via air cargo -- a new air freight carrier went into operation in May.
同时也可以通过长江航运或空运将货物运出重庆——一个新航空货运公司在5月份投入运营。

entries.trans: n. 频率, 频数；[计] 频率
example: The frequency and high cost of this has led to reluctance by some operators to have this maintenance done at the required frequency.
频率和成本高，这导致一些运营商不愿意将这一维修工作在所需的频率。

entries.trans: a. 时常发生的, 频繁的, 快速的；vt. 时常来访, 常常聚集, 常与...交往
example: Check for the different types of users you know for frequent login and count the number of groups they belong to .
检查您所知的经常登录的用户的类型，并计算他们所属的组的数量。

entries.trans: adv. 频繁, 经常地
example: Leonardo used his hands liberally and frequently as part of his painting technique.
莱昂纳多会经常用他的指纹作为他的特殊的绘画手法。

entries.trans: a. 新鲜的, 新奇的, 另外的, 淡的, 精神饱满的, 冒失的；adv. 最新地, 刚刚；n. 开始, 泛滥
example: But necessity is the mother of invention; and the food industry seems to have no shortage of fresh recipes.
但是必要的需求是发明的母亲，而食品产业看来从不缺乏新的配方。

entries.trans: v. (使)显得新鲜, (使)精神饱满, (使)减少咸味
example: But she often munched peanut butter sandwiches between takes - forcing her to freshen up before filming the intimate scenes.
可她总是在拍摄间隙吃花生酱三明治来充饥，闹得每次拍亲密戏之前都只好清新口气先。

entries.trans: n. 烦躁, 磨损, 焦急, 网状饰物；vi. 烦恼, 不满, 磨损；vt. 使烦恼, 腐蚀, 使磨损, 使起波纹
example: But do not fret, there are things that you can do to help you make the best out of your situation.
但请别烦躁，你可以做一些事情来帮助你达到最好的状态。

entries.trans: n. 摩擦, 摩擦治疗, 不和；[医] 摩擦
example: This article has explored a way that friction spinning machines can be better used for manufacturing high-grade marketable goods .
探索了一条更好地利用摩擦纺纱开发中高档市场适销产品的途径。

entries.trans: n. 电冰箱
example: Tip: Put the word "Breathe" as a screensaver or desktop pic, or put it up as a note on your wall or fridge or on your desk.
提示：用“调息”一词作一个屏幕保护程序或桌面图片，或把它作为一个提示贴在您的墙壁、冰箱办公桌上。

entries.trans: n. 惊骇, 吃惊；[医] 惊吓
example: She was child and mad with fright and she wanted to bury her head in her mother's lap and shut out this sight.
她仿佛还是一个小孩子，现在吓慌了，想躲到母亲怀里，避开这种可怕的景象。

entries.trans: vt. 使惊吓；vi. 惊恐
example: To ask me what is everyone afraid of me to frighten their children by adults, though are down, but the well-known large.
要问我是啥，人见人害怕，大人用我吓孩子，虽是遗臭万年，但是名气大。

entries.trans: a. 可怕的, 惊人的, 丑的, 非常的
example: Almost immediately, "the wind began to blow, and the sea to rise in a most frightful manner. "
几乎立刻，风刮得，海上升，在一个最可怕的态度。

entries.trans: n. 边缘, 端, 流苏, 穗, 初步；vt. 加穗于, 加饰边于；a. 边缘的, 附加的
example: Not so long ago, the industry wisdom on plug-ins was that they represented a fringe technology, too expensive for mass production.
不久前汽车产业还认为插电式混合动力车仅代表着一种边缘技术，对于量产而言则过于昂贵。

entries.trans: adv. 向那边, 向后
example: To and fro, repeatedly escape, no longer young and ignorant, but, what can also be negative number weight bear long, really do not know. MS.
来来回回、反反复复的逃避，不再年幼无知，可是，到底还可以负多少重承受多久、真的不知道。

entries.trans: n. 女礼服, 连衣裙, 工装, 罩袍, 僧衣
example: Just how special was not readily apparent to those who saw him, in his old Beethoven frock-coat or his shapeless orange cardigan.
当人们看到施托克豪森穿着一身陈旧的贝多芬礼服大衣或形状怪异的橙色开襟羊毛衫时，他们是无法轻易地发觉他有多么特别古怪。

entries.trans: n. 青蛙；[医] 蛙, 马蹄叉
example: Luckily the frog, who had been hunting butterflies nearby, saw him and with all his strength pushed him back into the pond.
幸运的是，青蛙正好在附近捕蝶，他看见了鲦鱼，于是用尽全力把他推回到了池塘中。

entries.trans: n. 边界, 边境；[法] 国境, 边境, 边界
example: And it might be said after all that, at first sight, our science certainly seems to have re-adopted the solution of closing the frontier.
我们终究要说，乍看来，我们的科学重新采用的解决方法，似乎是将这个边境封闭。

entries.trans: n. 霜, 冰冻, 冷漠；vt. 覆着霜, 冻结, 结霜；vi. 受冻, 起霜
example: Few of the Dwarves are able to survive in this sharp frost, not to mention the enemies who would dare trying to usurp the town.
即使是矮人也很难在凛冽的严寒中存活，更不用说是胆敢侵占本镇的敌人了。

entries.trans: n. 皱眉；vi. 皱眉头；vt. 皱眉表示
example: Said Beth with a frown as she sat down in her cubicle that was identical to that of every other person in the office.
贝思皱着眉头说，她在小隔间坐了下来，办公室其他人的小隔间都跟她的一样。

entries.trans: a. 结果实的, 多实的, 产量多的
example: Reading this book. The heart is at will. Read a page fruitful life perception about the personal growth.
读这本书。心是随意的。看一部写满丰盛人生感悟的手札。

entries.trans: vt. 挫败, 击败, 破坏；a. 无益的, 挫败的, 挫折的
example: The trafficking of cocaine, marijuana, heroin and other drugs has continued to frustrate the efforts of governments around the world.
可卡因、大麻、海洛因以及其他毒品的走私继续打击着全球政府的努力。

entries.trans: n. 油炸食物, 鱼苗；v. 油炸, 煎
example: He can't spend too much time arguing with you about the matter. He had other fish to fry.
他不能用太的时间和你辩论这件事，他还有别的事要做。

entries.trans: n. 燃料, 木炭；vt. 加燃料, 供燃料；vi. 得到燃料
example: The increase in ash depth from the rear to the front changes the resistance of the fuel bed plus the ash to the air flow.
灰层由后而前增加，这样就改变了燃料床（或者叫燃料层？）加上炉灰对（炉内）气流的阻力。

entries.trans: vt. 实践, 履行, 实行, 完成, 结束, 满足；[经] 履行(契约), 满期
example: It seemed as if fate had intervened and, in order to help Federer fulfil his destiny, removed Nadal from his path.
这似乎是命运的安排，为了帮助费德勒实现自己的梦想，将纳达尔从他前进的道路上清除掉。

entries.trans: vt. 实践, 履行, 实行, 完成, 结束, 满足；[法] 履行, 完成, 达到
example: He said he worked diligently not so much to fulfill his dreams as to live up to his mother's expectations.
他说他勤奋学习不是为了实现自己的梦想，而是为了不辜负母亲的希望。

entries.trans: n. 官能, 职务, 功能, 函数；vi. 活动, 运行, 行使职责；[计] 功能, 函数
example: The interior is often divided with plywood walls, especially useful when the containers function as hotel rooms.
内部经常用胶合板墙隔开，当集装箱被用作旅馆客房时，这样尤其是有用的。

entries.trans: n. 基金, 资金, 存款, 财源, 贮藏；vt. 提供资金, 积累
n. 基本原理, 原则, 基波；a. 基本的, 重要的, 原音的
example: But despite real drawbacks and a bit of hype, cloud computing remains a fundamental, very important trend.
尽管存在障碍以及炒作成分，云计算仍然是根本而重要的趋势。

entries.trans: [经] 债务转期
example: Happily for Scotmas, there was an alternative: a new financing platform called Funding Circle, which found it the money within two weeks.
很另Scotmas开心的是他们还有一个选择：一个称为基金圈（FundingCircle）的新金融平台可以在2周之内为公司提供资金。

entries.trans: n. 葬礼, 出殡
example: Mrs. Li from Harbin City, Heilongjiang Province, spent nearly 78-hundred yuan on her mother's funeral.
黑龙江哈尔滨的李太太在她母亲的葬礼上花费了7800元。

entries.trans: a. 好笑的, 有趣的, 滑稽的；n. 滑稽人物
example: The tunes are so incredibly cheesy that they are funny, and they seem to be a perfect match for Sonic's early-'90s sense of style.
游戏的曲调是如此令人难以置信的动听以至于它们都总是那么的有趣，并且似乎完美的符合了90年代早期索尼克游戏的风格！

entries.trans: n. 毛皮；vt. 以毛皮制作, 使生苔, 使生水垢；vi. 生苔, 积水垢
example: Fort McKay was a small fur trading post. It had no gas, electricity, telephone, or running water.
麦凯堡是一座小型的毛皮交易站，并没有瓦斯、电力、电话或自来水。

entries.trans: a. 狂怒的, 激烈的, 吵闹的
example: The Chief Petty Officer was furious at me for making such a dive, at my age, and in not very good condition.
海军上士因为我的年纪已大并且在这种不利的条件下去进行这样的潜水而发愁。

entries.trans: n. 火炉, 熔炉, 考验；vt. 在炉中烧
example: A recession is often seen as the furnace for a recovery.
The upward flow of gas is, of course, much faster; it takes only a few seconds to rise and issue from the furnace.

entries.trans: vt. 供给, 提供, 装设；[化] 供应; 供给; 配料
example: A story will furnish, not the full answer, but an inkling of it. A man had a dog.
在这讲一个故事，尽管不能提供全部的答案但它可以给我们一些提示。

entries.trans: n. 家具, 帆具
example: If I got even a tiny drop of paint on her furniture, she would get furious. So I learned to be very careful.
如果我在她的家具上沾上一小滴油漆，她就会大发雷霆，所以我学会很小心。

entries.trans: a. 更远的, 此外的, 更多的；vt. 促进, 增进, 助长；adv. 更进一步地, 更远地, 此外
example: Further integrating Oracle's and Sun's products seems to be one of the main reasons for the takeover.
看起来进一步融合甲骨文和Sun的产品是这次收购的主要原因了。

entries.trans: adv. 此外, 而且
example: Furthermore, they might be specific to particular providers of a service, not the interface of a particular service itself.
进一步地，它们可能明确一个服务特定的提供者，而不是特定服务的接口自身。

entries.trans: n. 愤怒, 狂暴, 狂怒的人；[医] 狂乱, 狂暴, 狂怒
example: Within a minute of this shot, the storm unleashed its fury on the beach. It was a great day.
在拍摄了这张照片之后的一分钟内，风暴就在海滩上释放了它的狂暴。

entries.trans: n. 保险丝, 导火线；v. 熔化, 融合
example: Traditional implementation of these concerns requires you to fuse their implementation with the core concern of a module.
对这些关注点的传统实现方式需要我们将这些实现融合到模块的核心关注点中。

entries.trans: n. 大惊小怪, 小题大作, 忙乱；vi. 无事自扰, 焦急, 焦燥, 忙乱；vt. 使激动, 使烦燥
example: A state of emergency was introduced without any great fuss: life was to go on as normal.
这完全是在没有任何重大情况下就宣布国家进入紧急状态，生活如往日一样正常。

entries.trans: n. 增益, 获得, 利润, 收获, 增加；vt. 得到, 增进, 赚到；vi. 获利, 增加；[计] 增益
example: To delay sth so that you can have more time to make a decision, deal with a problem, etc.
There would be no gain if you were to find yourself at a level that you could not cope with.

entries.trans: n. 银河, 星系, 一群(显赫的人物)；[电] 银河系
example: In more than a year, "Planck" found a large number of objects outside the galaxy, the astronomical study provides valuable information.
在一年多时间里，“普朗克”发现了银河系内外大量的天体，为天文学研究提供了宝贵的资料。

entries.trans: n. 走廊, 最高楼座, 画廊, 收集, 图库；[计] 图库
example: An open-sided roofed arcade or gallery along the front or side of a building; often at an upper level.
建筑物前面或侧面的开放式的有屋顶的拱廊；通常位置比较高。

entries.trans: n. 加仑；[医] 加仑
example: It included special offers of $1. 99-a-gallon gasoline for a year to any customer who purchased a gas guzzler.
这样的猫腻就包括提供给这些大型车为期一年1.99美元的特价油供应。

entries.trans: n. 赌博, 冒险；v. 赌博, 孤注一掷
example: It was bit of a gamble on him at the time but, by and large, most people say that Jeremie did very well during his time at the Club.
当时对他来说这是场赌博。但是最终大体来说，多数人认为杰勒米在俱乐部效力期间表现不错。

entries.trans: n. 队, 群, 帮；vi. 成群结队, 结成一伙；vt. 使成群结队
example: By September, the gang had begun to suspect it had a mole.
Police said the amount of money-laundering gang of up to 1 billion pounds.

entries.trans: n. 流氓, 歹徒；[法] 暴徒, 恶棍, 打手
example: But as he pressed toward the door he saw the larger gangster waving to him, a leer on his square face, and Kostya did not resist.
不过，就在他向门口挤去的时候，他看到了那个大块头在向他招手，他的方脸上挂着一丝暧昧的神态。克斯特亚没有拒绝。

entries.trans: n. 监禁, 监狱；vt. 监禁
example: Rilke used to say that no poet would mind going to gaol, since he would at least have time to explore the treasure house of his memory.
里尔克曾经常常说，诗人都不会介意蹲监狱，因为那样他至少有时间探索他记忆的宝库。

entries.trans: n. 缝隙, 缺口, 间断, 间距, 通用汇编程序；vt. 打开缺口, 造成缝隙；vi. 豁开；[计] 通用汇编程序, 图形应用程序, 间距
example: WTO spokesman said he could not comment on the gap between the release of each report.
一位WTO发言人表示，他不能对两份报告的发布间隔进行置评。

entries.trans: n. 车库, 汽车修理厂, 机库；vt. 把车送入修车场
example: Washing, fueling, and storing 20 cars in lower Manhattan is no easy trick, but Fiat found a nearby garage to handle the duties.
要在曼哈顿下城为20辆汽车洗车、加油和停车，绝非易事，但菲亚特在附近找到了一个车库解决了所有这些问题。

entries.trans: n. 垃圾, 废物；[计] 无用信息
example: Chua also said that she called one of her daughters "garbage" when she felt she was being disrespected.
蔡女士还提到，她曾把自己的一个女儿叫做“废物”，当她觉得不值得尊重她的时候。

entries.trans: n. 园丁, 花匠, 园艺家
example: Lf you want to be a successful gardener, you've got to have green fingers.
假如你想当个称职的园丁，那你就得有园艺技能。

entries.trans: n. 大蒜；[化] 大蒜
example: How about stakes through the heart? Reflections? Photographs? Holy water? Garlic? All that traditional vampire lore.
用木桩刺穿心脏怎么样？倒映？摄相？圣水？大蒜？所有那些关于吸血鬼的民间传说怎么说？

entries.trans: n. 衣服, 衣装, 外表
example: Create a username and be able to save the garment and submit to the company for a quote (they only do bulk orders primarily for schools).
创建一个用户名，并能够保存的服装，并提交报价（他们主要是为学校只能做批量订单）给该公司。

entries.trans: n. 气体, 汽油, 瓦斯；[化] 气体; 煤气; 瓦斯; 毒气
example: The very gas we are busy pumping into the air at the rate of 30bn tonnes a year, mostly by burning fossil fuels.
就是我们主要通过燃烧矿物燃料，忙着以每年三百亿吨的速度排入空气的那种气体。

entries.trans: a. 气体的, 气态的, 无实质的；[医] 气[体]的
example: Storage of huge amount of dangerous gaseous and liquid materials is usually involved in industrial production and transportation processes.
工业生产、储运过程涉及储存大量气态和液态的危险性物质，该类物质大都易燃易爆、有毒有害。

entries.trans: n. 汽油；[化] 汽油
example: He said government funds helped advance his work until gasoline prices dropped a few years later, and public funding disappeared.
他说，政府资金帮助推动了他在这方面的研究工作，但是几年后汽油价格下跌了，公共资金就消失了。

entries.trans: n. 喘气；vi. 喘气, 喘息, 渴望；vt. 气喘吁吁地说
example: By the end of the summer I had my answer: I needed to leave him, even if it meant getting a --gasp --roommate.
在夏末，我有了答案：我得离开他，就算要有一个--啊--室友。当他回来时，我们好好地谈论了一番。

entries.trans: n. 集合, 聚集；vi. 聚集, 集合, 渐增；vt. 使聚集, 搜集, 积聚
example: She said the fat would tend to gather around a smoker's girth and torso , adding to the harmful effects on their health.
她说，脂肪会倾向于聚集周围吸烟者的腰围和躯干，加上有害的影响，对他们的健康。

entries.trans: n. 聚集, 集中, 采集；[化] 富集
example: Amid reports of a major political gathering in North Korea, communist history suggests post-Kim moderation is possible.
Groping his way franticly through the gathering gloom, he emerged victorious on the topmost crag.

entries.trans: n. 标准度量, 计量器；vt. 精确计量, 估计；[计] 线规
example: But the meeting left Bear Stearns's representatives concerned that Mr. Flowers simply was trying to gauge their desperation.
但是，会议让贝尔斯登的代表们感觉弗劳尔斯仅仅是想知道他们有多绝望。

entries.trans: a. 欢快的, 艳丽的, 快乐的, 放荡的
example: The daily newspaper there recently omitted the name of the partner of a deceased gay man in its free obituary notice.
最近当地的一家日报社从它的免费讣告中删去了一个同性恋死者伴侣的名字。

entries.trans: n. 注视, 凝视；vi. 注视, 凝视
example: The suggestion was that there was something determinedly European about this new American gaze.
这种对一个新美国的凝视暗示出其中必然有些欧洲人的成分。

entries.trans: n. 齿轮, 工具；vt. 以齿轮连起, 开动, 使适应, 安排；vi. 连接上, 适合
example: Mill buyers in this region report that their orders are very healthy, as they gear up for what is always a busy fall season.
轧机买家在这一地区的报告说，他们的订单是非常健康的，因为他们装备自己，为什么是总是一个繁忙的秋天。

entries.trans: n. 基因；[化] 基因(遗传因子)
example: The products of this gene cluster are probably used for synthesis of a new polyketide antibiotics.
该基因簇编码的产物可能用来合成一种新的聚酮类抗生素。

entries.trans: n. 一般, 将军, 大体；a. 全面的, 大体的, 总的, 一般的, 普遍的；n. 常规；[计] 常规
example: Mr. Thein Sein said the use of force would be a "last resort to protect the lives and safeguard the property of the general public. "
登盛说，动用武力是“保护生命、捍卫大众财产的最后手段”。

entries.trans: n. 一般化, 普遍化, 概括；[化] 推广; 普适化
example: Then we elaborated the concept of map generalization in mobile environment from the point of the fundamental problems in map generalization.
进一步从制图综合基本问题出发，阐述了移动环境地图自动综合的概念。

entries.trans: vt. 一般化, 概括, 推广；vi. 形成概念, 笼统讲
example: Since I do not know the details, I can only generalize about the matter.
The objective of this paper is to generalize the concept of fuzzy sets from a real space to a topological space.

entries.trans: adv. 通常, 逐渐地, 普遍地
example: Students of English language and linguistics generally will find it a textbook of lasting value.
英语语言和语言学学生一般会发现它的持久价值的教科书。

entries.trans: vt. 产生, 发生, 导致；[电] 产生
example: By running the right knee at the ball, Hogan was able to generate terrific speed in his lower body.
向着球位快速地移动右膝关节，使得侯根的下盘可以极快地移动。

entries.trans: n. 一代, 一世, 产生；[医] 生殖, 世代
example: As such, we need to prepare the next generation of entrepreneurs to meet the challenges brought by the global nature of enterprise.
就此而言，我们必须为下一代创业者做好准备，以满足全球化企业带来的挑战。

entries.trans: n. 产生器, 发电机, 生产者；[计] 发生器
example: The heat is then used to turn a steam generator to generate electricity in a central plant.
然后，这种热能把曾经的蒸汽发电转成工厂中心的发电。

entries.trans: n. 慷慨, 宽大
example: When i say "generosity" , i mean a generosity of spirit: a lack of pettiness and jealousy, and a meeting (or close to it) of the minds.
当说到慷慨，我指的是一种慷慨的精神：不吝啬不嫉妒，并且还要有一种这样的思想。

entries.trans: a. 慷慨的, 有雅量的, 大量的, 丰富的
example: A 30% commission 'seems to be generous by China standards, ' he said.
他说，按照中国的标准，30%的佣金看起来也很丰厚了。

entries.trans: a. 创始的, 遗传的, 起源的, 遗传学的；[医] 生殖的, 遗传的
example: A side effect of increasing genetic variance following disruptive selection is often greater genetic flexibility of the population.
经分裂选择后遗传变量增加的附带作用，往往使种群的遗传可塑性有所增加。

entries.trans: n. 遗传学；[化] 遗传学
example: Scientists have identified multiple genes and mutations that seem to be related to ASDs, but it's more complex than just genetics.
科学家们发现多基因和基因突变似乎和自闭症有关，但它比遗传学更加复杂。

entries.trans: n. 天才, 天赋, 精神, 神魔；[医] 特征
example: Since the Age of Stone, human progress has been conditioned by the genius of my professional forbears .
从石器时代开始，人类的发展就受到我的专业的限制。

entries.trans: a. 温和的, 文雅的
example: Marsh tall, gentle, gentle, love Michelle, persistent pursuit of her for years, until she did get her divorce.
马什身材修长，文质彬彬，温文尔雅，很爱米歇尔，执著地追求她多年，直到她离婚才得到她。

entries.trans: n. 绅士, 先生
example: Persuade gentleman not to have feculent sexual intercourse so, do not taste the forbidden fruit that should not taste.
所以劝君不要有不洁性交，不要尝不应该尝的禁果。

entries.trans: adv. 温和地, 温柔地, 轻轻地, 逐渐地
example: Trying to be nice; I gently tried to wake her up in advertvthe actualce my stop feeble.
为了做个好青年，我在我的车站到之前才悄悄地野心弄醒她。

entries.trans: a. 真正的, 真实的, 诚恳的；[医] 真性的
example: We know that genuine faith is often tested, but this seems to go beyond what should be asked as a proof of faith.
虽然知道真正的信心常受试验，但以此来验证信心似乎过分一点了。

entries.trans: a. 地理学的, 地理的
example: The historical geographical environment, is often the essential condition for social material life and social development.
历史地理环境，是社会物质生活和社会发展的经常必要条件。

entries.trans: n. 地理学, 地理；[医] 地理
example: Nowadays quality education in middle schools make it a final goal that we should cultivate people with geography attainment.
目前，中学地理素养教育已把培养具有地理素养的人作为基本价值取向。

entries.trans: n. 地质学, 地质情况
example: If it gets there in one piece, it will examine the climate and geology of Mars and look for any signs of life that might have arisen.
如果“好奇号”能完好无损的抵达火星，它将研究火星的气候和地质以及寻找任何可能产生的生命迹象。

entries.trans: a. 几何学的, 几何的；[机] 几何学的
example: The resolution is a feature of the radial response, which is often summarized by a geometrical or pseudogeometrical factor.
径向分辨率是径向响应的一个特征，常由几何因子或准几何因子求和得到。

entries.trans: n. 几何学；[机] 几何学
example: One must understand the metaphors of this geometry to understand Metatron and the electromagnetic nature of the creational of our reality.
一旦明白了这个几何图形的隐喻，就会明白到梅塔特隆和我们的创造实相的电磁场本性。

entries.trans: n. 细菌, 种子, 生殖细胞, 根源；[医] 芽胞, 胚, 胚芽, 病菌
example: Even there is acid rain the sky, poisonous rain, the air fills the air germ to flow and has no oxygen body.
甚至天空下起酸雨，有毒雨，空中弥漫菌流以及无氧气体。

entries.trans: n. 德国人, 德语；a. 德国的, 德国人的, 德国语的, 同父母的
example: One of the unique aspects of the German occupation of Denmark was that the monarchy was left intact.
一个独特的方面，德国占领丹麦是君主立宪制是原封不动。

entries.trans: n. 德国
example: We recently got the chance to see her German tattoo and talk to her about how she had to sink or swim when she got to Germany.
我们最近有机会看见她的德文纹身，并询问她刚到德国时，如何“自主沉浮”。

entries.trans: n. 手势, 姿态；vi. 作手势, 作姿态
example: Being hesitated a moment, I gave him a gesture and let him in.
我犹豫了一会儿，给他做了个手势，让他进了家门。

entries.trans: n. 鬼, 灵魂, 幻影, 一丝, 一点；v. 鬼似地游荡
example: How much green tea and sugar is required to make the Ghost Dress?
He looks as if he had been a ghost.

entries.trans: n. 巨人, 大力士, 巨大怪物；a. 庞大的, 巨大的
example: With his hands-on approach, he brings to life the mystery and majesty of these giant wonders of the botanical world.
结合自己的亲身体验，他将植物世界这些奇迹巨人们的神秘与雄壮描绘地栩栩如生。

entries.trans: a. 巨人般的, 巨大的
example: The construction of the gigantic Egyptian pyramids at Giza during the 2500 B. C. was one of the greatest engineering feats of ancient times.
在吉萨期间建设的巨大的埃及金字塔是在远古时代2500年中最大的工程壮举。

entries.trans: n. 姜, 精力, 姜黄色；a. 姜黄色的；vt. 用姜调味, 使活泼, 使有生气
example: She said it might be possible to get the same effect by eating ginger cookies, depending on how much ginger is used.
Drink chamomile tea with ginger before going to bed to aid and settle your digestive system. Warm milk can be a sleep aid as well.

entries.trans: n. 魅力, 迷人的美, 魔法；vt. 迷惑
example: In her day Friedel was a striking beauty, and that glamour and grace is still evident today.
在弗瑞德尔的生涯里她是一个惹人注目的美人，迷人的诱惑和优雅的举止今天仍旧显露。

entries.trans: n. 一瞥, 闪光, 掠过, 辉矿类；vi. 扫视, 闪光, 掠过, 提到, 略说；vt. 扫视, 反射, 使掠过
example: Of that glance it might have been well said, not that it penetrated, but that it searched.
At first glance to see if he knew he was a gentle man, and has a noble temperament, a sense of peace of mind.

entries.trans: n. 闪耀光, 刺眼；vi. 发眩光, 瞪视；vt. 瞪眼表示
example: I felt so guilty , but Jenny just laughed and told me she was glad to see that I'd also left my glare in the library !
我觉得很内疚，但珍妮只是笑着告诉我，她很高兴地看到，我也留下了我的眩光的图书馆！

entries.trans: n. 光束, 微光, 反光；vi. 闪烁, 隐约地闪现；vt. 使发微光, 使闪烁
example: The durasteel had been treated so that it did not gleam. It seemed to suck in light rather than reflect it.
硬钢经过特别处理，没有金属光泽，看起来就像是镶嵌在阳光中，而不反射阳光。

entries.trans: n. 滑动, 滑过, 流水；vi. 滑动, 滑翔, 溜走, 流逝；vt. 使滑动
example: The experiments also revealed that the fish could glide even farther if they were just 4-5cm from the bottom of the wind tunnel.
实验也揭示了，在风洞底上方4-5厘米处，飞鱼能够滑翔更远。

entries.trans: n. 滑翔员, 滑翔机
example: There is nothing like strapping into a hang glider and cruising as fast as you can go.
没有什么比把自己绑在一股滑翔伞下，尽可能的快的进入巡航速度。

entries.trans: n. 一瞥, 一闪；vi. 投以一瞥, 闪烁不定；vt. 瞥见
example: Viewers only got to see a glimpse of what was going on.
But only long enough for her to look the other way, so I can once again catch a glimpse of magnificence.

entries.trans: n. 灿烂, 闪烁, 辉耀；vi. 灿烂, 闪烁, 辉耀
example: Passive detection uses MMW radiometer, which does not emit electromagnetic wave, has no glitter effect and works snugly.
被动探测使用毫米波辐射计，不发射电磁波，因而没有电磁污染和目标闪烁效应，工作比较隐蔽，不易被发现。

entries.trans: a. 通用的, 全球的, 球形的, 综合的, 普遍的；[计] 共用
example: How much further China eases monetary policy is bound to reflect the leaders' views of how deeply the Chinese and global economy may slow.
中国的货币政策将进一步放宽到什么程度，这势必反映出中国领导人对国内和全球经济可能放缓程度的看法。

entries.trans: n. 球, 球状物, 地球仪, 天体；v. (使)成球状
example: It's not hard to see how a warming Earth could change those dynamics: as the globe heats up, the top of the atmosphere should get colder.
不难看出，一个正在升温的地球是如何改变那些动力的：由于地球温度升高，大气顶端的大气应该越来越冷。

entries.trans: a. 抑沉的, 忧闷的, 黑暗的, 悲观的
example: He was, he said, "a bit of a loner" ; no party satisfied his restless, hungry and intermittently gloomy spirit.
他如他所说的，“有点孤独”；没有什么政党能满足他不平静的、饥渴的、又间或阴沉的精神。

entries.trans: vt. 赞美, 美化, 赞扬, 使辉煌
example: If God be glorified in him, God shall also glorify him in himself, and shall straightway glorify him.
神要因自己荣耀人子，并且要快快的荣耀他。

entries.trans: a. 光荣的
example: In its long glorious history , a brilliant art and craft has been handed down and masters have been brought up in a number of dynasties.
千多年来，悠久而灿烂的历史进程，给后世留下了精湛绝伦的技艺，也造就了历代数不清的艺术匠师。

entries.trans: n. 光荣, 荣耀, 荣誉, 壮丽, 繁荣；vi. 自豪
example: You don't bring glory or pleasure to God by hiding your abilities or by trying to be someone else.
当你埋没自己的能力或者试图成为别人时，你都无法让上帝感到荣耀或者欣慰。

entries.trans: n. 专业词典, 术语集, 词表；[计] 图文集
example: A sports extremely popular glossary , the soccer lottery ticket is nobody did not know.
体育界一个非常热门的词汇，足球博彩界更是无人不知。

entries.trans: n. 手套；vt. 给...戴手套
example: When I met her at the door her smile wrapped around me like a warm glove, just like yours used to do, my darling.

entries.trans: n. 赤热, 光辉, 热情, 热烈, 红光；vi. 发红光, 红光焕发, 发热, 洋溢, 激动

entries.trans: v. 咬, 啃, 侵蚀, 消耗, 折磨

entries.trans: n. 目标, 终点, 得分, 球门, 守门员；vi. 攻门, 射门得分

entries.trans: n. 上帝, 神像, 偶像；vt. 使神化

entries.trans: n. 鹅, 雌鹅, 鹅肉, 弯把熨斗；vt. 与...性交, 突然加大油门, 使生色, 喝倒彩

entries.trans: n. 磨, 碾, 苦差, 摩擦声, 用功的学生；vt. 磨擦, 磨碎, 磨光, 折磨, 压榨；vi. 磨, 磨碎, 苦干
example: Aaron Kowalski: Managing diabetes can be just a 24-hour-a-day, 7-day-a-week grind that's hard on people and their families.
亚伦•卡瓦斯基：糖尿病护理工作对患者及其家人来说是一种折磨，一天需24小时，一周需7天。

entries.trans: n. 紧握, 柄, 握力, 握手方式, 手提包, 掌握, 支配, 控制；vt. 抓紧, 抱住, 吸住, 掌握；vi. 握牢, 有吸引力
example: Jack leaped to his feet and leveled his weapon. The man in the blue duster looked up fearfully, then let the weapon fall from his grip.
杰克翻身站起，平举手枪，穿着蓝色长罩衫的家伙满怀恐惧地看着他，把手中的武器抛在地上。

entries.trans: n. 呻吟, 叹息；vi. 呻吟, 抱怨, 受压迫；vt. 呻吟地说
example: He'd glance at my awkward ink drawings, groan "Oh, God, " and walk away holding his head in his hands, like a migraine sufferer.
他看着我糟糕的由墨水画出的画，低声嚷道：“哦，老天”，然后，双手抱着脑袋走开，就像一个人得了头疼。

entries.trans: n. 食品商
example: The story of online grocer FreshDirect is something of a chicken-or-egg riddle.
网上食杂商新鲜直达的故事有点像鸡与蛋的谜团。

entries.trans: n. 食品杂货店, 食品杂货业
example: Before you head out for your weekly grocery store trip, think ahead for the next week of some meals you might like to have.
当你出门去为下一周进行采购的时候，首先想一下在下一周你可能会做哪些饭菜。

entries.trans: n. 凹槽, 惯例, 理想境况；vt. 开槽于
example: But with all that said, Adelman would like to see McGrady get into a good groove before the playoffs begin next weekend.
尽管话以致此，阿德尔曼还是希望看到麦蒂在下周季后赛到来之前恢复。

entries.trans: v. 摸索；n. 摸索
example: Michael: I'm not going with you. You will be trying to grope her hair and brush against her body all the time.
迈克尔：我不和你一起去。你会一直要去摸她的头发、蹭她的身体。

entries.trans: n. 总数, 总量；a. 总共的, 未打折扣的, 恶劣的, 粗野的；vt. 总共收入
example: The French court had sentenced him to no less than eight years' imprisonment and that was a gross miscarriage of justice.
法国法庭判了他至少八年的监禁，那是一个严重的误判案。

entries.trans: n. 小树林
example: Escaping into a shady courtyard or grove of trees is as refreshing as rolling into the cool bit of the bed on a steamy night.
在一个有树荫的院子里，或者在树林中会使人神清气爽，就像在一个湿热的夜晚，翻身睡到床上凉爽的一侧一样。

entries.trans: n. 吠声, 咆哮声；v. 怒吠, 咆哮, 吼
example: If you were to ask a woman today if she was turned-on by the growl of a big engine, she would probably scoff at the thought.
如果你问一位现代女性是否会因听到大型引擎的轰隆声而点燃激情，她或许会嘲笑你的想法。

entries.trans: n. 生长, 栽培, 增长；[计] 等比级数
example: It was a luxuriance of aspect, a fullness of growth, which made her appear more of a woman that she really was.
也正是她丰满的面容和成熟的身体，使得她看起来比她的实际年龄显得更像一个成年妇人。

entries.trans: n. 怨言, 满腹牢骚；vi. 抱怨, 发牢骚, 发隆隆声；vt. 抱怨
example: 41At this the Jews began to grumble about him because he said, "I am the bread that came down from heaven. "
Even today stray board members speak out on excesses in our financial markets and grumble that inflation lurks around the corner.

entries.trans: vi. 作呼噜声；vt. 咕哝；n. 呼噜声, 咕哝
example: Ramsay would flay them all when he learned his bride was gone, and what he would do to Grunt and Sour Alyn did not bear thinking about.
当他发现他的新娘跑了的时候，拉姆西会把他们都剥了皮，至于他会对咕噜特和尖酸的阿利做什么简直不忍想象。

entries.trans: n. 担保, 抵押品, 保证书；vt. 保证, 担保
example: The company has established a strict quality guarantee system and obtained a few related quality guarantee certifications as well.
沈阳三浦汽车电子有限公司建立了严格的质量保证体系，已经先后通过了相关体系认证。

entries.trans: n. 守卫者, 警戒, 护卫队, 防护装置；vt. 保卫, 看守, 当心；vi. 防止, 警惕, 警卫, 看守
example: I'm here, with you, beside you, to guard you and to guide you . . .
我就在这里，陪着你，伴着你，保护你，指引你……

entries.trans: n. 指导, 领导；[医] 导
example: Today, my sixteen year old son told me that he's following his guidance counselor's advice: to do what his hero does for a living.
今天16岁的儿子说他打算按指导员说的去做：按心目中的英雄那样去谋生。

entries.trans: n. 引导者, 导游, 指南, 路标；vt. 指导, 支配, 管理, 带领, 操纵；vi. 任向导；[计] 辅助线
example: Focusing on any one of those things, to the exclusion of the others, can be a misleading guide to a market's potential.
只关注这几点中的一点，而将其它点排除在外，对于市场的潜力来说可能会是一个误导。

entries.trans: n. 罪行, 内疚；[法] 罪, 犯罪, 罪行
example: Instead of changing out of a sense of deprivation and guilt, it's better to be motivated by feelings of love, joy and giving.
最好是让爱，欢愉和给予所激励的情感来代替丧失和内疚的感觉。

entries.trans: a. 犯罪的, 有过失的, 自觉有错的, 心虚的；[法] 有罪的, 犯罪的, 自觉有罪的
example: If found guilty Mayweather's career would likely be over as he could be looking at up to 28 years in Nevada prison.
如果找到犯罪证据的话，小梅威瑟将在内华达监狱“仰望（星空）”28年，这样小梅的职业生涯将很可能终结。

entries.trans: n. 吉他
example: An hour's drive to hear that crap. You know, it wasn't even a band. A guy with a guitar. An hour each way.
居然开一小时的车去听那种垃圾音乐，根本都算不上是乐队。一人抱一把吉他，每人一小时。

entries.trans: n. 海湾, 深渊, 漩涡, 隔阂；vt. 吞没
example: It has shored up vulnerable gulf states and, up to this point, contributed to hopes for U. N. action to end the war.
西方的介入给脆弱的海湾区国家予有力的支持，并且到目前为止，带来了联合国采取行动终战争的希望。

entries.trans: n. 树胶, 橡皮, 橡皮糖, 牙床, 老天；vt. 涂以树胶, 用胶粘, 使有粘性；vi. 分泌树胶, 发粘
example: She received a mini comic with the bubble gum package that she bought with her play. She read the comic and got a laugh.
在这块口香糖的包装纸上，有一个微型连环画，她读了这张连环画，大笑了一场。

entries.trans: n. 枪；[医] 枪
example: Zhou usually liked to use my camera as a machine gun. He said he would like to capture every beautiful moment.
周拍起照片来好像在用机关枪，他说他是在捕捉每一美妙的瞬间。

entries.trans: n. 火药；[化] 有烟火药; 火药
example: In an interview, Mr. Rhatigan said he smelled gunpowder coming from the vehicle and went toward it, thinking it could explode at any second.
他接受采访时说，他闻到车里散发出火药味，朝车子走过去，觉得它随时可能爆炸。

entries.trans: n. 突然一阵, 趣味, 爱好
example: A few moments later another customer came into the coffee shop and let a gust of wind in the front door.
过了一会儿，另一位顾客走进了咖啡厅，在门口带来了一阵风。

entries.trans: n. 排水沟, 槽, 贫民区；vt. 开沟于；vi. 流；[计] 装订线
example: I tried to be normal and used one hand, but unfortunately it was just a gutter ball.
我试过是正常的，用一只手，但不幸的是它只是一个排水沟球。

entries.trans: n. 家伙, 支索；vt. 用支索撑住, 取笑, 嘲弄；vi. 逃跑
example: But Republicans and Democrats differ sharply as to which mighty institutions pose the greatest threat to the little guy.
但是，强势的机构如何威胁弱者，共和党和民主党意见完全不一。

entries.trans: n. 健身房, 体育馆；[医] 体育馆, 健身室, 运动场
example: Eight miles away from my home village in Austria there was a gymnasium, and I rode to that gymnasium with a bicycle.
当时我骑着自行车前往一家健身房，那儿离我家所在的奥地利小村庄有八英里。

entries.trans: n. 习惯, 嗜好, 习性；vt. 使穿衣
example: Inspire: Make it a daily habit to read or listen to something positive or inspirational . Keep it with you and listen to it regularly.
激励：每天朗读或记着一些积极或激励的文章！让这成为习惯。持续的专注及焦点就是决定未来发生的道路！

entries.trans: a. 习惯的, 惯常的, 平常的；[法] 习惯的, 以习惯为常业的, 惯常的
example: Narcissism is, in a sense, the converse of an habitual sense of sin; it consists in the habit of admiring oneself and wishing to be admired.
“自恋”在某种程度上是习惯性罪孽感的反面，由赏识自己并希望被赏识的习惯而构成。

entries.trans: n. 冰雹, 致敬, 欢呼, 招呼；vt. 向...欢呼, 致敬, 招呼, 使象下雹样落下；vi. 招呼, 下雹；interj. 万岁, 欢迎
example: But after a bit of time in China, these tourists seem to forget that people that look like locals here could actually hail from anywhere.
但这些游客似乎忘记了，有些人虽然长得像中国人，却可能是从其他国家来的。

entries.trans: n. 理发, (男子的)发式
example: About once a week, Uncle Vernon looked over the top of his newspaper and shouted that Harry needed a haircut.
几乎每周一次，弗农姨父从他的报纸上方看看哈利，对哈利大喊大叫说他该去理发了。

entries.trans: n. 门厅, 走廊, 会堂
example: When I was little, my uncle could get around without the chair. He'd inch his way down the hall like this.
在我还小的时候，我叔叔可以不用轮椅到处走动.他曾一点点地挪到大厅，就像我现在这样。

entries.trans: n. 停止, 立定, 休息；vt. 使停止, 使立定；vi. 立定, 停止, 蹒跚, 踌躇, 有缺点；[计] 停止
example: The dispute has led to the blockade of a bridge between the two countries, and a halt to construction work on the mills.
这场争论导致连接两国的一座桥梁被封锁，纸浆工厂的建设工作也被迫停止。

entries.trans: vt. 二等分, 对半分享, 把...减半
example: He wants to cut the deficit at least as quickly as Labour intended before the general election (ie, to halve it in four years).
他希望大选前，赤字至少能像工党预期的那样得以削减（四年内减半）。

entries.trans: n. 火腿, 后腿, 笨拙演员；a. 过火的, 做作的；v. 演得过火
example: Manchester City left-back Wayne Bridge is on the verge of signing with West Ham United after it was revealed he was in London for a medical.
据悉，曼城左后卫韦恩.布里奇在伦敦接受了西汉姆联队的体检，他很快将与该队签约。

entries.trans: n. 汉堡(德国港口), 肉饼, 汉堡包, 纯精牛肉, 汉堡牛排
example: We used to have simple, unsophisticated tastes and looked with suspicion at anything more exotic than a hamburger.
我们曾经有过的简单，质朴的口味，并期待与怀疑，在任何更多的外来比一个汉堡包。

entries.trans: n. 锤, 铁锤, 钉锤；vt. 锤打, 敲打, 钉；vi. 连续锤打；[计] 锤头
example: The assailant swung and missed, then threw the hammer at Fang as he fled, grazing him on the back.
凶手挥舞铁锤但未命中，就将铁锤扔向正在逃离的方是民，击中背部。

entries.trans: n. 食篮, 阻碍物, 食盒；vt. 阻碍, 使困累, 妨碍, 牵制
example: By the afternoon I had used up all my shot, and, being hungry I sat down and opened a small portable hamper that I carried with me.
到下午的时候，我已经用尽了所有的子弹，并且饥饿难当，我坐下来，打开自带的一个小型的便携野餐篮。

entries.trans: n. 手册；[计] 手册
example: On this point I find myself in agreement with The Wall Street Journal editorial page, not usually my favorite handbook on press conduct.
在这一点上，我发现自己与《华尔街日报》社论版——而不是我通常最喜爱的有关新闻界行为规则的手册——意见一致。

entries.trans: n. 少数, 一把, 棘手事
example: Fourteen years of higher education and a handful of Ivy League degrees, and there I was, stiff and stupid, struck dumb by my own dumbness.
我十四年的大学教育和在几所常春藤大学工作的经历使得我傻乎乎站在那里，笨拙不堪，尴尬不已。

entries.trans: n. 障碍, 困难, 不利条件；vt. 加障碍于, 妨碍
example: Nowadays not being able to use a computer is quite a handicap for a secretary.
今天的秘书如不会使用电脑，那是很吃亏的。

entries.trans: n. 手帕, 头巾, 围巾
example: The differences were that her long and loose hair was bound by a handkerchief and a pair of sandal was on her feet.
所不同的是披散的长发用个手绢束住，脚上也多了一双拖鞋。

entries.trans: n. 柄, 把手, 把柄, 柄状物, 手感；vt. 触摸, 运用, 买卖, 处理, 操作；vi. 搬运, 易于操纵；n. 句柄；[计] 句柄
example: It moved to tvOne in February, the second time it has switched channels, after its previous broadcasters found it a bit too hot to handle.
二月份这个节目转到tvOne电视台播放，这已是第二次更换播放频道了，前一个电视台认为这个节目太火以至于难以掌控。

entries.trans: n. 施舍物, 救济品, 分发的印刷品资料, 广告物品
example: While some have argued a handout would be a way for China to increase its "soft power" abroad, Xie thinks such a move would backfire.
尽管一些争论说救助欧市能够增强中国在国际上的“软实力”，谢国忠却认为那样只会事与愿违。

entries.trans: a. 英俊的, 大方的, 慷慨的, 相当可观的, 美观的, 灵敏的
example: She had never seen a serviceman in a military coffin before. He looked so handsome, so mature.
之前，她还从未见过一名躺在军队灵柩中的军人。他看起来如此英俊，如此成熟。

entries.trans: n. 笔迹
example: One study published this year found that about three out of every four teachers say they are not prepared to teach handwriting.
今年公布的一项研究发现，大约每四个教师中就有三个说他们不准备教书法了。

entries.trans: a. 便利的, 敏捷的, 容易取得的；[化] 便于使用的; 易操作的
example: They would give him a handsome present , and it would come in very handy , as he was just going to be married.
她们定会给他一注可观的缠头，那便巧妙了，因为他正准备结婚。

entries.trans: n. 悬挂, 诀窍, 意义；vt. 悬挂, 附着, 装饰, 垂下, 踌躇, 绞死, 使悬而未决；vi. 悬着, 垂下, 被绞死, 悬而不决
example: When I take a bus, I hang on to the straps with both hands so nobody even thinks I might be trying to steal their bag.
当我坐公车的时候，我总是双手紧握手扶带子这样才没有人会怀疑我偷他们的袋子。

entries.trans: vi. 发生, 发生, 恰巧
example: Necessity creates pressure and forces you invent something or to make it happen or to use your potentiality.
需求创造压力，逼着你去发明一些东西，或者让某些事情发生，或者发挥你的潜力。

entries.trans: n. 快乐, 幸运, 适当
example: A growing number of people are beginning to realize that wealth is not the sole prerequisite for happiness.
越来越多的人开始意识到财富不是幸福的惟一先决条件。

entries.trans: n. 港, 避难所；v. 庇护, 藏匿, (使)入港停泊
n. 港, 避难所；v. 庇护, 藏匿, (使)入港停泊
example: The expressive and colorful cube-shaped houses on concrete pillars are located right in the heart of the city, near the 'Old Harbour'.
这座令人印象深刻的彩色方形屋由混凝土柱子支撑，就坐落在该城市的中心，靠近老港口。

entries.trans: vt. 使变硬, 使坚强, 使冷酷；vi. 变硬, 变冷酷
example: Once the plastics harden and are removed from the molds, the fingers are ready to be hooked up to a base.
一旦塑料变硬，并去除掉模具，手指就可以连接到基座上了。

entries.trans: adv. 刚刚, 几乎不, 勉强是
example: The two of them, Krista with a patch of gauze taped over her eye and Smudge with hardly any sight at all, sat by the garden pond.
他们两个，克丽斯塔一只眼蒙着一块纱布，斯玛奇几乎看不见，一起坐在花园池塘边。

entries.trans: n. 艰难, 辛苦, 苦难；[法] 受苦, 吃苦, 苦难
example: All that hard work, all that hardship, all the time spent underground, it was all for the families. It was all for you.
这些艰险的工作，这些巨大的艰辛，那些在地下度过的时光，不仅是为了赡家糊口，养活妻儿。

entries.trans: n. 硬件, 五金器具, 零件；[计] 硬件
example: Throwing hardware at a problem is often the first thought, especially because databases are resource hogs.
替换有问题的硬件通常是我们的第一考虑，主要原因是数据库会占用大量资源。

entries.trans: a. 难的, 艰苦的, 坚硬的, 勇敢的；adv. 努力地, 辛苦地, 坚硬地
example: I suppose not,  said Archibald Kane genially , as if the report were a compliment to his own hardy condition.
“我也这么想，”甘老先生蔼然的说，仿佛儿子的报告就是对于自己依然康强的一种恭维。

entries.trans: n. 野兔；vi. 飞跑
example: Once upon a time a tortoise and a hare had an argument about who was faster. They decided to settle the argument with a race.
从前，有只乌龟和兔子争论谁跑得快，于是它们决定以赛跑解决这一争论。

entries.trans: n. 伤害, 害处；vt. 伤害, 损害
example: Being tired all the time is often put down to anaemia and women think they should take more iron, but that could do more harm than good.
女人总将长时间的疲劳归因于贫血，自以为多摄入点铁元素就没事了，但是这样做弊多利少。

entries.trans: a. 有害的, 伤害的
example: The most important thing to remember: no matter how much a ink system environment, it can release harmful chemicals.
最重要的是要记住：无论一个油墨系统有多么环保，它都会释放出有害的化学物质。

entries.trans: a. 和睦的, 调和的, 和谐的, 协调的
example: The building of a harmonious campus to be set up to establish harmonious relations between classmates.
These contrary but harmonious aspects build up a common me with a strong character. Somebody mistakes me as introverted as a girl.

entries.trans: n. 协调, 和睦, 调和；[电] 和声学
example: When trying to heighten team harmony, increase morale, improve communication or repair broken trust in an organization.
在试图增加一个组织中的团队和谐、提振士气、加强沟通或修复受损的信任时，这种方法尤其有价值。

entries.trans: n. 马具, 挽具状带子, 甲胄；vt. 给...上挽具, 驾驭, 披上甲胄, 利用...以产生动力
example: People have been talking about emotional intelligence for a while, but somehow they haven't been able to harness its power.
人们谈论情商已经有一段时间了，但是不知怎么的，他们没能驾驭它的能量。

entries.trans: n. 竖琴；vi. 弹奏竖琴, 不停地说
example: Then the elf sat down on a rock at the edge of the sea and began to play the harp.
这时小仙人坐在海边的岩石上开始弹起琴来。

entries.trans: a. 粗糙的, 刺耳的, 严厉的；[法] 粗糙的, 严厉的, 苛刻的
example: On the ladies game : harsh training school instructors scoring very strict Oh, you could find a bit of herself?
游戏介绍：苛刻的淑女训练学校，导师打分很严格的哦，看你的装扮能得几分？

entries.trans: n. 收获, 成果, 收获物, 收获期；v. 收割, 收获
example: He promised it would be temporary. He would quit again after the wheat harvest in a few months.
师伟科保证他只是临时回矿上干活，几个月后当家里的麦子成熟时他就会再度离开煤矿。

entries.trans: n. 激烈而持久的争论；vi. 争论；vt. 与...争辩, 使烦恼
example: People seem to respond on an individual basis Cdepending uponC how much hassle each life event creates for a particular person.
人们似乎反应在个人能力上，这取决于如何太多麻烦的每一个生命活动营造了为一个特别的人。

entries.trans: n. 匆忙, 急忙
example: The wind sweeps snow into the scars of our harvest-time haste, smoothing the brow of hill, hiding furrows and trash in the yard.
风卷起雪花，覆盖了人们丰收农忙之后的痕迹，抚平了山脊，覆盖了院内的车轮印和垃圾。

entries.trans: vt. 催促, 加紧；vi. 赶快, 急忙
example: Let me hasten to add that I am not now, and have never been, a puppy-drowner.
允许我立即加上一句：我现在和以前从来都不是会溺死小狗的人。

entries.trans: a. 匆匆的, 轻率的, 性怠的
example: You seem to be. . . the rash type, just a little bit hasty at times!
The seneschal had wondered about that hasty decision, but the old man had merely smiled and said, "No different than I did with you. "

entries.trans: n. 孵化, 舱口；vt. 孵, 孵出, 策划；vi. 孵化
example: The most they could have done was to lock Mr. Hatch up while he cooled off for a few days, or refine him a little something.
他们至多把哈奇关上几天，让他冷静下来，或是罚他几个钱。

entries.trans: n. 憎恨, 恨, 厌恶；vt. 憎恨, 憎恶；vi. 仇恨
example: We know how much babies hate getting shampoo and water in their eyes when you rinse it out. . . so we designed an ingenious shampoo rinser!
我们知道，当您给宝宝洗头时，大多数的宝宝是多么地讨厌让洗发水和水流进他们眼里，因此，我们设计了这个巧妙的洗发冲！

entries.trans: a. 憎恨的, 可恨的, 可恶的
example: The only group hateful enough to be a suitable butt for barbed humor is lawyers.
惟一的一帮不讨人喜欢且适合当讽刺幽默靶子的人是律师。

entries.trans: n. 憎恨, 仇恨, 憎恶；[法] 敌意, 憎恨, 憎恶
example: I also learned from my study of sexual abuse that it casts a shadow of guilt and a hatred of body over the next generation.
根据我对性虐待的研究表明，性侵害会对罪恶感产生印象并且对下一代的厌恶蒙上阴影。

entries.trans: a. 傲慢的, 骄傲的, 崇高的
example: But Thumbelina did not like that haughty fellow. Yet she was unable to reject what the field mouse woman wanted.
拇指姑娘当然不喜欢那高傲的家伙，然而她无法拒绝田野鼠女人要求。

entries.trans: n. 用力拖拉, 拖运, 强拉, 捕获量, 拖运距离；vi. 拖, 拉, 改变方向, 改变主意；vt. 拖拉, 拖运
example: It for the long haul: for those who can often play with your opponent, you could not meet bet will win.
放长线钓大鱼：对于那些能经常和你玩的对手，千万不可以逢赌必赢。

entries.trans: n. 常到的地方, 生息地；vt. 常到, 出没于, 萦绕于；vi. 出没, 作祟
example: Such anxious ruminations seem to haunt much of our national commentary these days, even in the unlikeliest of contexts.
诸如此类的反思最近常常出现在我们全国性的评论当中，甚至场合都令人匪夷所思。

entries.trans: n. 鹰, 掠夺者, 鹰派成员；vi. 放鹰行猎, 像鹰一般地袭击, 清嗓, 咳嗽；vt. 捕捉, 咳出, 兜售, 叫卖, 散播
example: I got the video camera to take a picture of it only to capture it capturing its prey, a blue jay, where the hawk began to feast.
我的视频摄像头采取了它的照片，只捕捉到它捕获猎物，一个蓝色的周杰伦，鹰开始盛宴。

entries.trans: n. 干草；vt. 制干草, 供给干草；vi. 晒干草
example: Diana would constantly have to remind her to stand properly-and to stop scratching her eyes when the hay fever was bad.
黛安娜常常提醒她站立时姿势要端正，在枯草热病严重时，提醒她不要乱揉眼睛。

entries.trans: n. 冒险, 危险, 机会；vt. 冒...的危险, 赌运气, 使冒危险；[计] 相关危险; 冒险
example: But the habit of the moose to wander across highways in the dark has made it a road hazard responsible for around 700 collisions a year.
习惯在夜间漫游马路的驼鹿已成为公路危害，每年造成约700件交通事故。

entries.trans: a. 危险的, 冒险的, 碰运气的；[法] 危险的, 冒险的, 碰运气的
example: He was trying to make safe surface coatings for food containers using chemicals less hazardous than those found in household cleaners.
他想使用比家庭清洁剂危险还小的化学制剂给食品容器做安全的表面涂层。

entries.trans: n. 头痛, 令人头痛之事；[医] 头痛
example: The headache often gets worse initially, and improvement may only be seen between a week and a month later.
停服初期，头痛常常会加剧，直到一个星期或者一个月后才有所好转。

entries.trans: n. 标题, 起始字, 方向；[计] 上标题
example: Those without a dog spend an average of just 1 hour and 20 minutes a week exercising by going to the gym or heading out for a stroll or jog.
而没有养狗的人平均每周去健身房或外出跑步的锻炼时间只有1小时20分钟。

entries.trans: n. 大标题, 新闻摘要；vt. 为...做标题, 写标题
example: On the front page of the paper there was a lead story under the headline "Pig farmer reaps gains from GMO-free soy" .
报纸头版引导文章的标题是“养猪户从非转基因大豆获利”。

entries.trans: a. 头向前的, 仓猝而用力的, 轻率的；adv. 头向前地, 猛然地, 用力地
example: China could be the next country to go bust, if its headlong rush to build ever-taller skyscrapers is a guide to its future economic health.
如果只顾一味地建造更高的摩天大楼，中国可能是下一个面临破产的国家。摩天大楼是未来经济是否健康的一个指标。

entries.trans: n. (中小学)校长, 监工
example: His father was a headmaster and his mother was a teacher who also wrote children's books.
他的父亲是一名校长和他的母亲是一名教师谁也写儿童读物。

entries.trans: n. 总部, 司令部, 总部人员；[经] 本部, 总部, 总署
example: Rio has headquarters in London but any takeover would also be investigated in Australia, where it has significant assets.
力拓总部设在伦敦，但任何收购还是会在澳大利亚受到调查，因为力拓在那里拥有大量资产。

entries.trans: vi. 痊愈；vt. 使复原, 使和解, 治愈
example: We'd also like to swap over action bars too -- it'd be a pain if you're trying to Mind Flay and you end up trying to Flash Heal!
我们也打算在切换天赋的同时可以连带着动作条一并转换了，当你想要用精神鞭笞时却按出了快速治疗一定不爽吧。

entries.trans: n. 堆, 许多, 累积；vt. 堆积, 装满；[计] 堆
example: A heap of loose fragments, which had fallen from above, blocked up the face of the quarry and my first employment was to clear them away.
一个松散的碎片堆，其中有从上面倒下，阻断了对采石场的脸，我的第一次就业是清楚他们离开。

entries.trans: n. 炉床, 灶台, 炉边；[化] 锻造炉; 敞炉; 炉缸; 炉床; 火床; 炉膛
example: The girl warmly greeted the toad from her bed, and the toad took back its warm spot upon her kitchen hearth.
这个女孩强烈热闹地蟾蜍从她地床上，蟾蜍收回啦它在她地厨房灶台朱砂痣。

entries.trans: a. 诚恳的, 健壮的, 热烈的, 丰盛的
example: Quivering with glee, the little giggler threw back his head, thrust his whiskers in the air and let out a hearty chuckle.
小睡鼠开心得身体微微颤抖，后仰着脑袋，嘴上的小胡须在空气中抖动着，发出了发自内心的轻声笑。

entries.trans: n. 热, 热度, 体温, 高潮；vi. 加热, 激昂, 加剧；vt. 把...加热, 使激动
example: Barbara says that the heat collection system allows her to enjoy many hours of energy-free laundry.
巴巴拉说，集中热源的系统，让她能享受多小时的无能量洗衣。

entries.trans: n. 加热器, 灯丝, 加热工；[化] 加热器
example: Possession of this Warranty Certificate is not proof of the length of time that this water heater has been installed.
拥有本质量保证凭证并不能证明本热水器的安装时间长度。

entries.trans: n. 加热, 供热, 暖气设备, 供暖系统, 暖气装置；a. 加热的, 供暖的
example: Energy can be recovered and returned as process make-up air, used to preheat combustion air, or used for plant or office heating.
可以在空气补偿的过程中对能量进行恢复和退回，用于对燃烧空气的再加热或工厂、办公室的加热。

entries.trans: n. 举, 抛, 起伏, 鼓起；vt. 用力举起, 使举起, 使鼓起；vi. 抛出, 起伏, 喘息, 凸起
example: The body weighed a ton, and it was all he could do to heave him up again on to the bed and prop his head on the pillow.
那孩子忙抢上扶住，这人身子极重，奋力将他扶正，将他脑袋放在枕上。

entries.trans: n. 天堂, 上帝, 天空
example: Take heed that ye do not your alms before men, to be seen of them: otherwise ye have no reward of your Father which is in heaven.
你们要小心，不可将善事行在人的面前，故意叫他们看见。若是这样，就不能得你们天父的赏赐了。

entries.trans: adv. 很重地, 严重地, 难以忍受地
example: It had become a byword for reckless lending , offering home loans of up to 125% and borrowing heavily on the international money markets.
银行发放高达125%的房贷，并在国际货币市场上大量举债，这一挤兑事件使该银行成为了不计后果发放借款的“代名词”。

entries.trans: n. 树篱, 障碍, 套头交易；vt. 用树篱围, 套期保值, 妨碍, 两面下注以防...的损失；vi. 筑树篱, 躲闪, 两面下注以防损失；a. 树篱的, 偷偷摸摸的
example: Bear had been the only big firm that refused to help out Long-Term Capital Management, a hedge fund that came close to the brink in 1998.
贝尔是唯一一家拒绝帮助“长期资本管理公司”摆脱困境的大公司，后者曾是在1998年濒于崩溃边缘的对冲基金。

entries.trans: n. 脚后跟, 踵, 后部, 倾侧；vt. 尾随, 装以鞋跟, 倾侧, 追赶；vi. 紧随, 用脚后跟传球
example: Bend the front knee, keeping the back leg straight, press the right heel down on the floor.
前腿膝关节弯曲，后腿保持绷直状态，右脚后跟贴紧地面并向下压。

entries.trans: n. 高度, 海拔, 高地, 顶点；[化] 高度
example: He made the G-Man brand so popular that, at its height, it was harder to become an FBI agent than to be accepted into an Ivy League college.
他把美国联邦调查局探员塑造成了一个流行品牌，在巅峰时期，想当一名联邦调查局探员比进一所常青藤院校还要难。

entries.trans: vt. 增高, 提高, 加强；vi. 升高, 变大
n. 继承人, 嗣子, 后嗣；[法] 继承人, 后嗣
example: Then the word of the LORD came to him: "This man will not be your heir, but a son coming from your own body will be your heir. "
4耶和华又有话对他说，这人必不成为你的后嗣。你本身所生的才成为你的后嗣。

entries.trans: n. 直升机；vt. 由直升机运送；vi. 乘直升机
example: However, for an indoor helicopter, the equipment for such system would be too heavy to be carried for a tiny indoor helicopter.
然而，对于一个室内直升机，装备等制度，将过重，要进行一个小小的室内直升机。

entries.trans: n. 地狱, 邪恶势力, 苦境, 阴间, 毁坏, 训斥；vi. 狂饮, 飞驰
example: No one expected Venus to be the poisonous hell that it is, or Mars to have the river valleys that it does,  he said.
“在我们进行宇宙探索之前，没有人能够预料到，金星是那样一个充满毒气的地狱，而火星表面却有河谷。”他说。

entries.trans: n. 钢盔, 盔, 防护帽；vt. 给...戴头盔
example: It also failed to punch through even one side. We were a little surprised. It only made a bulge on the inside of the helmet.
让我们惊喜的是，依然是一面都没有被射穿，仅仅是在内部鼓起了小小的一块。

entries.trans: a. 有帮助的, 有益的, 有用的
example: For advanced XML users, XQuery can be very helpful in querying and extracting content out of large XML documents.
对于高级XML用户，XQuery在查询和从大型XML文档抽取内容时非常有帮助。

entries.trans: a. 无助的, 无能为力的, 无依无靠的
example: When he again looked thing is the disordered hair by the wind, weather - beaten face rolling tear -- it was distressed and helpless tears!
当他再次抬起头，映入眼帘的是被风吹得零乱的头发，饱经风霜的脸上滚动着大颗大颗的泪珠--那是心痛而无奈的泪水！

entries.trans: n. 半球, 地球的半面, 大脑半球；[医] 半球
example: We feel that this hemisphere can only be secure and free with democratic governments.
我们认为，本半球只有在民主政府的领导下才能得到安全和自由。

entries.trans: n. 母鸡, 雌禽
example: One afternoon the plump hen wandered with her children in the open air nearby when a hare came up to her.
有天下午，胖母鸡又带上她的一窝小鸡崽儿们在附近的旷野里漫步着。此时，一只野兔突然走上前来。

entries.trans: adv. 因此, 从此
example: He said this world is demon- dominative , suffering, and unworthy staying. Hence, people should make early aspiration to leave there.
他说：这世间是由魔鬼在主导的、是苦涩的、是不值得我们留恋的，所以大家应该趁早立下心愿，以期离开这个鬼地方。

entries.trans: adv. 自此以后, 今后
example: Henceforth, I assume that this namespace is bound to the xbl prefix without further comment.
此后，如果没有单独说明，均假定该名称空间被绑定到xbl前缀。

entries.trans: n. 使者, 传令官, 先驱；vt. 预报, 宣布, 传达, 欢呼
n. 药草, 香草；[医] 草, 草本, 草药
example: It is an herb native to Paraguay that has been used for centuries as a sweetener.
它是巴拉圭的一种本地药草，作为甜味剂已经使用几百年。

entries.trans: n. 兽群, 人群, 牧人；vt. 群集, 使成群, 放牧；vi. 聚在一起
example: The small and yellow spark in the morning can draw on Sprit to leave herd of horses then, the body takes a risk.
一点晨雾中的淡黄星火，便能吸引小马王离开马群，孤身冒险。

entries.trans: n. 遗产, 祖先遗留物, 继承物；[医] 遗传性
example: One of the glories of the British heritage is the right to a fair trial.
英国人引以自豪的传统之一是有获得公正审判的权利。

entries.trans: n. 英雄, 超越常人者, 男主角
example: He begins to realize that being a hero is not quite as simple as he once might have thought.
他开始意识到，作为真正的英雄，并非有如以往所想的那么简单。

entries.trans: a. 英勇的, 英雄式的, 壮丽雄伟的；n. 英雄诗, 史诗, 英勇行为
example: In Poland, though, the war is usually portrayed as a single heroic struggle, against Russians as well as Germans.
然而在波兰，这场战争却时常被描述成一个独自抗击德国人和俄国人的英雄壮举。

entries.trans: n. 巾帼英雄, 烈妇, 女主角；[化] 海洛因; 二醋吗啡; 二乙酰吗啡
example: But all this was just adjust heroine ZhiQingDian team leader cow flowers to see in the eye.
但是这一切被刚调来的女主人公知青点大队长牛鲜花看在眼里。

entries.trans: vi. 犹豫, 迟疑, 踌躇, 支吾, 停顿
example: I ' m always here to help ! do not hesitate to ask questions.
我都会在此帮助您！有问题请多问，请别客气。

entries.trans: n. 兽皮, 迹象, 躲藏处；vt. 藏, 隐瞒, 遮避, 剥...的皮, 隐藏；vi. 躲藏；[计] 隐藏
example: Just as you cannot hide obesity, you cannot hide the huge costs of these diseases to economies and societies.
正如我们无法掩盖肥胖，我们亦无法掩盖这些疾病对经济和社会造成的巨大损失。

entries.trans: n. 等级制度, 僧侣统治, 等级体系；[计] 分级结构; 分层结构; 新闻组, 新闻组分层
example: Depending on where the product is placed into a location hierarchy, it has a set of different tax-related attributes.
根据产品在位置层次结构中的位置不同，产品有不同的与税收相关的属性。

entries.trans: n. 加亮区, 精彩场面；vt. 加亮, 使显著, 以强光照射, 突出；[计] 突出
example: Simply highlight a word and you'll be able to look it up in the dictionary or thesaurus, or find the item to buy through an online retailer.
选中单词，你便能在字典或词库中查寻，或是在网络零售商搜索想买的商品。

entries.trans: adv. 非常, 非常赞许地；[电] 大大地
example: Emerging evidence indicates that this highly organized response also takes place in the central nervous system.
新出现的证据表明，这一高度有组织的反应也发生在中枢神经系统的地方。

entries.trans: n. 公路, 大道, 捷径；[法] 公路, 大路
example: In his paintings, there is no particular change in emotion, and he includes ordinary things like the highway in the background.
在他的绘画，没有在情感上的特殊变化，并且他在背景包括普通的事象高速公路。

entries.trans: n. 徒步旅行, 远足, 涨价, 提高；vi. 步行, 徒步旅行, 上升；vt. 使高涨, 拉起
example: To Tang Qingwei, a 22 -year-old Fudan University senior who was one of the organizers of the hike , last week was a life lesson .
岁的复旦大四学生唐清威是此次登山探险活动的组织者之一，对他而言，上周的事件可谓是一生的教训。

entries.trans: n. 山坡, 山腹
example: While Kimberly roams the hillside road in search of her mother Teri is in the car with the motorist who picked her up.
金伯利在山丘边的道路上徘徊，寻找她的母亲。泰瑞坐在一辆小汽车中，一名驾驶汽车的女子载上了她。

entries.trans: a. 后面的；v. 阻碍, 打扰
example: Still, the lack of respect shown by his classmates did not hinder mike from persisting with telling his woeful tales.
但是，他的同学对他不够尊重这个事实并没有阻止迈克坚持讲他悲哀的故事。

entries.trans: n. 妨害, 障碍, 阻碍物
example: This discrepancy is reflected in two aspects: institutionalization of " noumenal hindrance" in poetry and introspective nature of poetry.
这种偏差主要表现在诗的理障化和诗的理观化两个方面。

entries.trans: n. 铰链, 关键, 枢纽；vt. 装铰链；vi. 靠铰链移动, 依...而转移
example: The, antithesis between them is the hinge on which modern philosophy turns.
这种思想与事物的对立是近代哲学兴趣的转折点。

entries.trans: n. 暗示, 提示；v. 暗示, 示意
example: In July China's microblogging services relabelled themselves as "beta" versions, a possible hint that this was all just an experiment.
7月，中国的微博服务商重新贴出了“测试”版的标签，这就像是一条可能的线索，表明所有的一切都仅仅是一项实验。

entries.trans: n. 臀部, 蔷薇果, 忧郁；a. 熟悉内情的；vt. 使忧郁, 给(屋顶)造屋脊；interj. 喝彩声
example: HIP-HOP music has few rules. singers just do what they think and rap it out in a clever or creative way.
嘻哈音乐的规则非常少。歌手仅仅做他们想的然后敲击出来，或者创造出来。

entries.trans: n. 租金, 租用, 雇用；vt. 雇请, 出租；vi. 受雇
example: If all they needed was a code robot, it would be easy to hire someone in another country to do that kind of work.
如果他们只想找个懂代码的机器人，那不如雇个外国廉价的程序员。

entries.trans: n. 嘘声, 嘶嘶声；vi. 发出嘘声, 发嘶嘶声；vt. 发嘶嘶声表示
example: The door opened with a sucking hiss and out of the dark a large, gaily-dressed, sullen-looking colored woman got on with a little boy.
车门随着一阵抽气声打开。黑暗中走出一个女黑人，身躯硕大，衣着艳丽，面有愠色，带着一个小男孩上车。

entries.trans: n. 历史学家, 记事者
example: The historian says 'it's great' Mr. Ross lives at home, and it's easy to understand why a fledgling ballplayer would want to.
这位历史学家认为，罗斯和家人在一起生活“很不错”，他非常理解一位初出茅庐的球员为什么会选择这种生活方式。

entries.trans: a. 历史上著名的, 有历史性的
example: The Queen was accompanied on her train journey through the historic tunnel by one of her Rolls-Royce cars which was placed on the train.
女王陪同她火车穿越历史隧道的一个她的劳斯莱斯汽车放在火车上。

entries.trans: a. 历史的, 史实的, 历史上的；[法] 历史性的
example: As a unique dramatic language phenomena, it has historical reasons and reflects inherent law of dramatic language as well.
作为一种独特的戏剧语言现象，它既有历史的原因，又体现了戏剧语言内在的规律性。

entries.trans: n. 历史, 过去, 经历, 发展过程, 历史学, 过去的事, 历史记录；[计] 历史记录
example: Four centuries, two centuries, and one-and-a-half centuries: 2009 offers a fine excuse to celebrate two of the great iconoclasts of history.
四百年，二百年，一百五十年：2009年，我们有足够的理由去纪念历史上这两座伟大的里程碑。

entries.trans: n. 打击, 打, 冲撞, 讽刺；vt. 打, 打击, 碰撞, 打中, 袭击, 偶然碰上；vi. 打, 打中, 打击, 碰撞, 偶然碰上；[计] 击中; 找到; 瞬时打扰
example: If a plan, sb's career, etc.
Unfortunately, or fortunately, the fact of the matter was he respected people who actually bit him and hit him.

entries.trans: adv. 迄今, 至今
example: It was as if the chaos of war seemed to comply with some hitherto unknown law of nature.
在这些看似繁杂无序的战争背后都体现了一个迄今都不清楚的自然规律。

entries.trans: a. 沙哑的, 嘶哑的；[医] 声嘶的
example: Clinton s voice was hoarse, she coughed occasionally and seemed to be nursing a cold, but she made no mention of her health.
克林顿声音嘶哑，她有时咳嗽，看上去正患感冒，但她并未提及自己的健康状况。

entries.trans: n. 锄头；v. 用锄耕地, 锄
example: I say to summarize such a wonderful life: the children play, chasing butterflies, elderly crane from hoe, childlike, all fun.
我用一句话来概括这样的美好生活，就是：“孩童嬉戏，追逐黄蝶，老人鹤发童颜，童心未泯，你来我往，普天同乐。”

entries.trans: n. 升高, 起重机, 推动；v. 升起, 升高, 举起
example: Just as the colonel's curtain of fear had begun to descend once again, the promise of international protection will hoist it back up.
正当上校的恐怖之幕开始再次落下之际，国际社会的承诺将其一把掀开。

entries.trans: n. 孔, 洞, 穴, 漏洞；vt. 挖洞, 掘坑；vi. 进洞, 凿洞
example: For the first time, we now have a complete fossil record of how much material such a newborn black hole can eat.
现在，我们第一次拥有一个完整的关于像如此新诞生的黑洞能吞噬多少物质的化石记录。

entries.trans: n. 洞, 窟窿, 山谷；a. 空的, 虚伪的, 空腹的, 凹的；vi. 形成空洞；vt. 挖空
example: At the time of his execution, his artificial, hollow laughter was the saddest sound the Rebels present ever heard.
在他被处决之时，他空洞的人工笑声是当时出席的叛军们一生中所听过的最最悲哀的声音。

entries.trans: a. 神圣的, 圣洁的, 至善的；n. 神圣的东西
example: The concept of "constructing a harmonious society" is an expression of a new value concept combining Holy and Secularisation .
“构建社会主义和谐社会”的提出体现了向一种神圣与世俗相结合的新价值观的转换。

entries.trans: a. 家常的, 平凡的, 朴实无华的
example: He talked with English and French statesmen as an equal; he was as homely and comfortable as an old shoe.
他以平等的身份与英国和法国的政治家交谈；他就像一只穿旧了的鞋子，让人感到普通而又舒适。

entries.trans: a. 同种的, 同质的, 齐性的；[医] 同种的, 纯一的, 同质的, 均匀的
example: The average air outlet temperatures achieved were a little higher due to a more homogeneous temperature distribution.
之间由于比较同种的温度分配，稍微达成的平均的空气出口温度比较高。

entries.trans: a. 诚实的, 坦直的, 可靠的
example: Andy: the funny thing is, on the outside, I was an honest man, straight as an arrow. I had to come to prison to be a crook.
奇怪的是在外面，我是一个正直的人，刚正不阿。监狱反而让我成了一个诈骗犯。

entries.trans: n. 诚实, 公正, 正直
example: Both of you value honesty and open communication, something that will keep your relationship going over the long haul.
白羊和水瓶都很看重诚实和坦率的交流，这些是让情侣继续爱情长跑的因素。

entries.trans: n. 蜂蜜, 甜蜜, 爱人；a. 蜂蜜似的, 甜蜜的, 甘美的；vt. 加蜜使甜, 对...说甜言蜜语；vi. 说甜言蜜语, 奉承
example: Oily skin takes the egg white, to which a bit of lemon or honey can be added.
油质皮肤就用蛋清，也可以加入一点柠檬或蜂蜜。

entries.trans: n. 蜜月, 蜜月假期；vi. 渡蜜月
example: Back in February, we named "Renting a private island in the Seychelles" as one of their "Five best getaways for a royal honeymoon" .
早在二月份，我们（英国广播公司）命名的“最佳的五个皇家蜜月方案”之一就是“在塞舌尔群岛租一个私人岛屿”。

entries.trans: n. 荣誉, 头衔, 信用, 尊敬, 名誉, 阁下, 勋章；vt. 尊敬, 授予荣誉, 承兑, 实践
example: To perform a social duty or ceremony, such as pouring drinks, making a speech, etc.
No particular person, team, etc. is doing better than the others in a competition, an argument, etc.

entries.trans: a. 值得尊敬的, 荣耀的, 高贵的；[法] 荣誉的, 正直的, 体面的
example: It is not altogether with a feeling of complacency that I again mention that she had not rendered these honourable victories public.
我怀着遗憾的心情再一次指出，她没有把那些光荣的成绩公之于众。

entries.trans: n. 钩, 钩状, 镰刀, 陷阱；vt. 挂...于钩上, 钩住, 引上钩, 偷窃；vi. 弯成钩状, 钩紧；[计] 钩
example: I had thought she was giving a supervision, not a lecture, and letting her off the hook would have wasted even more of her time.
我原以为她要去指导学生，不用上课。如果让她错过了，会耽误她更多的时间。

entries.trans: n. 单脚跳, 跳跃, 舞会, 飞行；vi. 单脚跳, 跳跃；vt. 跃过, 跳上, 加蛇麻子于, 服麻醉药；[计] 跳跃式传输
example: Mister Gordon uses words from hip-hop songs to help young people, especially those who grew up with poverty and abuse, as he did.
戈登先生采用希普霍普歌曲中的歌词来帮助年轻人，特别是帮助那些和他曾经一样生活在贫穷和受虐待的环境中的年轻人。

entries.trans: n. 有希望之人, 有前途之人；a. 有希望的, 怀抱希望的, 保持乐观的
example: Buy me?  With a hopeful look in her eyes.
He said he's hopeful a private organization will step forward to do such a report.

entries.trans: a. 无希望的, 绝望的, 不可救药的
example: Like an addict at a slot machine, China is adding to its hopeless bet, ensuring that its eventual losses will be even heavier.
中国就像一个沉迷赌博的人，不断增加无望的投注，令它的最终损失更加大。

entries.trans: n. 地平线, 眼界, (天)视地平
example: Therefore, the question of optimal advertising investment is always an analysis of the hot issues for business word and theory horizon.
因此，广告的最优投入问题一直是企业界和理论界的研究热点。

entries.trans: n. 水平线, 水平面, 水平位置；a. 水平线的, 平坦的, 横的；n. 水平；[计] 水平
example: Everyone is a king of the world in their own vertical and horizontal bossy, do not listen to me, but you would not let me listen to you.
每个人在他们自己世界里都是一个专横的国王，你别听我的，但是你也不能够让我听你的。

entries.trans: n. 角, 角质, 喇叭, 号角；a. 角制的；vt. 用角触, 长角于
example: And the long horn above her eyes shone and shivered with its own seashell light even in the deepest midnight.
在她眼睛上方，长着一只长角，即使在最漆黑的深夜中，也闪烁着海贝壳般晶莹的光亮。

entries.trans: a. 可怕的, 遭透的, 极讨厌的
example: Think about the last time that you felt horrible and you had a bit of chocolate to help you feel better. Wasn't it wonderful comfort food?
想想上次你感到郁闷的时候，你是不是吃了点巧克力来缓解呢，它不是一种很棒的舒缓的食品呢？

entries.trans: n. 惊骇, 恐怖, 惨状；[医] 恐怖, 恐惧
example: Is all this to end in trivial horror because so few are able to think of Man rather than of this or that group of men?
难道因为很少有人能考虑整个人类多于这个或那个人群，这一切就会在毫无价值的恐怖行动中结束吗？

entries.trans: n. 马力；[电] 马力
example: The dial on the right indicates how much power is being drawn--the motor makes out at 30 kilowatts, or about 40 horsepower.
右侧的表盘显示多大的权力正在制定-电机马克塞斯了30千瓦，约40马力。

entries.trans: n. 水管, 橡皮软管, 长统袜；vt. 用水管浇
example: She was spattered all over with water from the spray hose on the grass, when she passed through the garden.
经过花园时，她被草地上的灌溉喷管喷了一身水。

entries.trans: n. 款待, 亲切, 殷勤
example: It is to be observed, first of all, that the activities connected with hospitality have become a distraction (v. 40).
首先我们注意到，（在第40节），殷勤好客的种种活动竟然变成分心。

entries.trans: n. 主人, 旅馆老板, 节目主持人；vt. 当主人招待, 作...节目主持人；[计] 主机, 宿主机
example: Any other country in which the company operates is known as a host country.
该公司从事经营所在的其他国家成为东道国。

entries.trans: n. 人质, 抵押品；[经] 人质, 抵押品
example: He said the hostage-taker had wanted to kill himself in the classroom.
Staying on might have turned him into a hostage to those seeking to protect their financial interests.

entries.trans: n. 女主人, 女房东, 女老板
example: It was the kind of party which makes you wonder why the hostess has troubled to bid her guests, and why the guests have troubled to come.
拿这一天的宴会来说，你不能不感到奇怪为什么女主人要请这些客人来，而为什么这些客人也会不嫌麻烦，接受邀请。

entries.trans: a. 敌人的, 怀敌意的, 敌对的；n. 敌对分子
example: This is the female version of the Oedipal problem-the girl is hostile to her mother, in love with her father.
与恋母情结相对应，女孩具有恋父情结——该女孩恨她母亲，爱她父亲。

entries.trans: n. 猎犬；vt. 带猎犬狩猎, 追捕, 激励, 使追逐
example: Located just a half hour's drive from Honolulu, Waimanalo stretches out lazily along the coast like a sleeping hound.
距檀香山处于仅仅半小时的车程，纳罗伸出懒洋洋地沿着像一个沉睡的猎犬的海岸。

entries.trans: n. 一家人, 家庭, 家族, 王室；a. 家庭的, 家常的, 王室的
example: They must be able to go back and forth and fit into each household without disruption of educational and social activities.
他们必须学会在不影响学习和社会活动的前提下融入父母新的家庭，保持和父母双方的交流沟通。

entries.trans: n. 主妇, 家庭妇女
example: It follows that the housewife will also expect to be able to have more leisure in her life without lowering her standard of living.
由此而来的是，家庭主妇也将希望在不降低生活标准的同时能够在生活中获得更多的闲暇。

entries.trans: vi. 盘旋, 翱翔, 徘徊；vt. 孵；n. 翱翔
example: To select and delete the entire table, hover the mouse cursor over the table until you see a Table tab at the bottom-left of the table.
为了选择并删除整个的表格，您可以将鼠标停留在表格上面，直到您看到表格左下部的Table项为止。

entries.trans: adv. 然而, 无论如何, 究竟怎样；conj. 然而, 可是
example: He feared, however, that it would not be too long before the young man headed back to his native Uzbekistan to open his own bakery.
可是，他担心这位年轻的小伙子不久将回到自己的祖国乌兹别克斯坦开自己的面包房。

entries.trans: n. 嗥叫, 吠声, 号叫；vi. 狂吠, 咆哮, 呼啸；vt. 对...吼叫, 狂喊着说
example: Howl continued to build a strong following through his website, word of mouth, and, of course, his music.
哈尔继续努力建立一个强大的，通过他的网站后，口耳相传，以及当然，他的音乐。

entries.trans: n. 杂乱一团, 混乱, 拥挤；vt. 把...挤在一起, 乱堆, 草率了事, 蜷曲；vi. 挤作一团, 蜷缩
example: Terry revealed: "Didier called everyone together before the game for a huddle and a speech. It was a great speech for before the match. "
特里透露：“赛前迪迪尔把所有人叫到一起，进行一个简短的发言，这是一个很重要的发言。”

entries.trans: n. 紧抱, 拥抱；vt. 紧抱, 坚持, 使沾沾自喜
example: Baby, Don't say that you'll love me for ever, what I wanted is only a warm hug. . . baby Don't tell me you will love me a long . . .
宝贝别说你会爱我久久，仅仅给我一个温暖的拥抱这句话求翻…

entries.trans: a. 极大的, 巨大的, 无限的
example: While describing Shanghai as 'the New York of Asia, ' he said basic communication was a huge problem.
虽然把上海称作“亚洲的纽约”，但卡纳说，基本的交流都成了一个大问题。

entries.trans: n. 壳, 皮, 船体；vt. 去壳
example: A popcorn kernel consists of an impervious hard outer hull and a dense starch-and-protein interior surrounding a bit of water and oil.
玉米花仁包括一个不渗透的坚硬外面的船身和内部密集的淀粉和蛋白质围拢一点儿水和油。

entries.trans: n. 嗡嗡声, 哼声, 杂声；vi. 发低哼声；vt. 哼, 用哼声表示；interj. 哼, 嗯
example: I heard the hum of the bees, they seem to say that this flower in ah!
我听到了蜜蜂的嗡嗡声，他们好像在说这花好甜啊！

entries.trans: n. 人, 人类；a. 人类的, 似人类的, 人性的, 有同情心的
example: But he see in the darkness of my first reaction was shouted, as if I were remained dormant for many years the goblins reproduce the human.
可是他在看清黑暗中的我之后第一反应就是哇哇大叫，好像我是一直蛰伏多年的妖精重现人间。

entries.trans: n. 人道主义者, 博爱者, 基督凡人论者；a. 人道主义的, 博爱的, 凡人论的
example: He made it sound not like war but a humanitarian mission with some strong-arm detective work thrown in.
他使得这场战争倒像是人道主义使命，只不过使用了强硬的侦查手段。

entries.trans: n. 人性, 人类, 博爱
example: They began to panic the four she, in a vain attempt to discover the vast sea of humanity lives lover.
他们开始惊惶的四处张望，妄图在茫茫人海中寻找今生的爱人。

entries.trans: a. 低下的, 谦逊的, 粗陋的；vt. 使...卑下, 降低...地位, 贬抑
example: The knowing of it all will humble you to its power yet let the brightness of you shine everywhere it needs to.
知道这个会让你在它的能量前变得谦逊并让你在任何它需要的地方发光发热。

entries.trans: a. 潮湿的, 湿润的, 多湿气的
example: It was a hot and humid day recently and I decided that some of my favorite cold soup would be just the ticket.
这些天又热又潮，来一碗我最爱的凉汤再合适不过了。

entries.trans: n. 湿气, 潮湿, 湿度；[计] 湿度
example: Such a trick could be mimicked using water tanks positioned in the bowels of a building to restore humidity in hot, dry climates.
在炎热干燥的气候条件下，人类可以通过在建筑大楼内部安置水箱来保证湿度。

entries.trans: n. 耻辱, 丢脸, 谦卑
example: The 13-year veteran will be one of the few players on the roster this season who did not go through the Golden State humiliation.
这名13年球龄的老将将是本赛季阵容中少数没有经历过金州蒙羞的球员之一。

entries.trans: n. 幽默, 诙谐, 心情；vt. 迎合, 牵就, 顺应
example: Mm-hmm. -But I think he came out looking wonderful in this. It showed that he had a sense of humor, that he has very fast moves. . .
嗯嗯。-但我们认为他在这件事上看起来很好。这显示了他有幽默感，而且动作灵敏…

entries.trans: a. 富幽默感的, 滑稽的, 诙谐的
example: Exaggerate a component more or less though one is only for a short time humorous, but absolute fault an empty hole invites the wind.
虽然只是一个小幽默，多少有些夸张成分，但绝对不是空穴来风。

entries.trans: n. 幽默, 诙谐, 情绪, 体液；vt. 使满足, 迁就
example: She walked along at his side, and gently accommodating himself to her humour, he said Coketown was a busy place, was it not?
她跟在他的身边走着，他文雅地和着她的兴致，说焦煤镇是个热闹的地方，不是吗？

entries.trans: n. 饥饿, 渴望, 饥荒；vt. 使挨饿；vi. 挨饿, 渴望
example: To go on hunger strike and shed tears on account of one's personal interests may be considered a kind of contradiction among the people.
为个人的利益而绝食，而流泪，这也算是一种人民内部的矛盾。

entries.trans: n. 狩猎, 追捕, 搜寻, 猎区；vt. 狩猎, 打猎, 搜索；vi. 打猎, 猎食, 搜寻
example: It had never been a secret that part of our mission at the Mossad was to hunt for Nazi war criminals.
我们在摩萨德的一部分工作就是搜捕纳粹战犯，这从来就不是什么秘密。

entries.trans: n. 用力的投掷；vt. 用力投掷, 发射, 愤慨地说出, 丢下；vi. 猛投, 猛掷
example: Just as he was about to hurl his briefcase into the window to break it, two of the police officers grabbed him from behind.
正当他要扔公文包打开窗户时，两个警察从后面抓住他。

entries.trans: n. 欢呼声, 骚动, 欢乐；v. 欢呼, 呼万岁, 以欢呼迎接；interj. 万岁
example: Maybe this Christmas was his last hurrah , and he'll start cutting back in1988 he said.
他说：“这个圣诞节可能是他最后一次欢乐。1988年他就要削减开支了。”

entries.trans: n. 飓风, 暴风, 暴风雨
example: President Bush has said he would devote his coming week to overseeing the relief operation in the states hit by Hurricane Katrina.
布什总统说未来一周他会专心察看营救行动于各州其袭于可吹了飓风。

entries.trans: n. 伤害, 创伤, 损害；v. 伤害, (使)伤心, 危害, 刺痛
example: When you feel deeply hurt, and tears are about to drop down , then please take a glance at the sky that used to belong to you.
当你的心真的在痛，眼泪快要流下来的时候，那就赶快抬头看看，这片曾经属于你的天空；

entries.trans: n. 肃静, 安静, 沉默；vt. (使)肃静, (使)安静, (使)缄默；interj. 嘘, 别作声
example: Hush! The boss is quite mad. He said he's going to fire any juiceless player.
嘘！老板在大发雷霆呢。他说得无精打采的球员撵走。

entries.trans: n. 小屋, 茅舍, 临时军营；v. (使)住在茅舍
example: I stood and stared at the blazing hut, trying not to think of the smoldering body of the little girl inside it.
我站在这里，凝视着燃烧中的屋子，尽力不让自己去想，那在屋中闷烧着的小女孩。

entries.trans: a. 与水有关的, 水力的, 水压的；[电] 水力的
example: Able to know mechanical drawing, hydraulic, lubrication assembly drawing . Have to be aware hydrometric knowledge.
能看懂机械装配图纸，液压，润滑管路安装图。有一定的液压基础知识。

entries.trans: n. 碳氢化合物；[化] 烃; 碳氢化合物
example: The fracturing job was one of the effective way to improve hydrocarbon reservoir's permeability and raise oil and gas well's production.
压裂作业是改进油气层渗透率、提高油气井产量的有效途径之一。

entries.trans: n. 氢；[化] 氢H-2
example: Hydrogen and CO have both been used for estimation of noble metal surface areas.
The heat and light energy from the Sun is due to the fusion of hydrogen atoms at a very high temperature and pressure.

entries.trans: n. 赞美诗, 圣歌；v. 唱赞美歌
example: A hymn had been set to one of his tunes, "For He is the heart of our hearts. "
他把一首颂歌《因为他是我们心里的心》嵌人他的歌调里。

entries.trans: pl. 假说, 前提, 假设, 假定
example: Looking at the graphs, Google's hypotheses about search terms predating disease outbreaks seem to be proven correct.
查看这些图表，证明Google关于搜索词条可预示疾病爆发的假设是正确的。

entries.trans: n. 假设；[化] 假设
example: He made a black hole emitting radiation (now called Hawking radiation) is now the prophecy is a generally accepted hypothesis.
他提出黑洞能发射辐射（现在叫霍金辐射）的预言现在已是一个公认的假说。

entries.trans: n. 歇斯底里症, 不正常的兴奋, 癔病；[医] 癔病, 歇斯底里
example: The method is often clinically applicable to crying with grief and hysteria as well as diseases due to excessive grief.
这种方法临床主要用于过度悲伤引起的恸哭、歇斯底里等症状。

entries.trans: a. 歇斯底里的, 异常兴奋的；[医] 癔病的, 歇斯底里的
example: The armament race between the U. S. A. and the U. S. S. R. , originally supposed to be a preventive measure, assumes hysterical character.
开始于美国苏联两国之间的军备竞赛最初是一项预防措施，现在具有了歇斯底里性质。

entries.trans: adv. 也就是
a. 冰淇淋的, 乳白色的
a. 冰的, 冰冷的, 冷淡的, 滑溜的
example: It seemed as if an icy wind had touched my face and enfolded my body from head to foot; I could feel the stir of it in my hair.
好像一阵冰一样的风触碰到我的脸，把我的身体从头到脚都卷了进去；我也感觉到头发被它搅动起来。

entries.trans: n. 理想, 典范, 观念, 思想, 最后目标；a. 理想的, 完美的, 空想的, 观念的, 唯心论的
example: The recent "Agile Roots" conference in SLC was an attempt to highlight this difference and return to the quality ideal.
最近在盐湖城举行的“敏捷之根”会议，凸显了这种分歧，并试着回归到高质量理想中来。

entries.trans: n. 唯心主义, 观念论, 唯心论, 理想主义
example: He may talk to you as if he were a pessimist beyond redemption, but his own activities are always prompted by unblenching idealism.
他可能会像个无药可救的悲观主义者那样跟你谈话，但是他自己总是被坚定的理想主义催着前进。

entries.trans: adv. 完美地, 理想地
example: Ideally, Reeves said, he would convert the three-level control center into a new home.
理想状态下，李维斯表示，他会把三层楼高的控制中心改造成他的家。

entries.trans: a. 同一的, 恒等的, 完全相同的；[医] 同一的, 同等的
example: If multiple users have identical files, they may be unable to restore a file, as their file permissions do not allow this.
如果多个使用者拥有完全相同的文件，他们可能因为「他们的文件权限的不允许」而无法回复一个文件。

entries.trans: n. 识别, 身份证明, 认同；[化] 鉴定; 鉴别; 鉴别法; 认证
example: A brick masonry staff dormitory of two stories framework at the bottom needs to have safety identification for the use of a longer time.
某员工宿舍楼为底部两层框架的砖混结构，由于使用时间较长，需要进行强度校核和安全性鉴定。

entries.trans: vt. 识别, 认为...等同于, 确定, 使参与；vi. 一致, 认同
example: Be able to identify at least three reactive sources of data and three proactive sources of data for your project ?
This example (Figure 8) has a table and a small piece of text on the page to identify the field and lay it out neatly.

entries.trans: n. 身份, 相同, 一致, 特性, 恒等式；[计] (打)标记, 标识
example: As for the identity of the 75 guests, Prince Robert kept it a secret to the last.
至于75位来宾的身份，罗伯特王子则保密至最后一刻。

entries.trans: n. 思想体系, 意识形态, 观念学, 空论；[医] 观念学, 观念形态
example: At the moment, Iran, with its radical ideology and burgeoning nuclear program, is one of Washington's biggest headaches.
众所周知，伊朗自始至终推行的极端主义思想体系以及其国内目前进行的如火如荼的核计划，让美国非常的头疼。

entries.trans: n. 习语, 成语, 惯用语法, 方言
example: If,  I said, I might use the American idiom I would say that he has said a mouthful.
我说，“如果我可以借用美国的成语，那么，我要说他说得恰到好处。”

entries.trans: n. 白痴, 极蠢之人；[医] 白痴者, 痴子
example: But even an idiot such as me can see that money, as a whole, doesn't really seem to be working any more.
不过，即便如我这般愚笨的人，也可认识到，就总体而言，金钱似乎已真得风光不再。

entries.trans: a. 懒惰的, 闲散的, 停顿的, 空闲的, 无用的；vi. 无所事事, 闲散, 浪费, 空转；vt. 虚度, 使闲散, 使空转；n. 空转, 空闲时间；[计] 空闲时间
example: It was because he had made a serious affair of an idle matter, by thinking of it as if it were of any consequence.
这是由于他把一桩不关紧要的小事看得太严重，以为会产生很大影响的缘故。

entries.trans: n. 懒惰, 闲散, 失业；[化] 空载
example: She had encouraged her mother in her idleness.
How much time has been lost in delusions, in errors, in idleness, in ignorance of how to live.

entries.trans: vt. 点燃, 使灼热, 使兴奋
example: To help ignite your excitement about this idea, I thought I'd share a few strategies on how to do this.
为了帮你点燃这个激动人心的想法，我愿分享一些方法。

entries.trans: n. 无知, 愚味；[法] 无知, 不知情, 愚昧
example: Even though I was entrenched in the mode of ignorance, I felt fortunate to have been able to hear transcendental history being recorded.
即使我深受愚昧属性的控制，我还是为自己能听到超然的历史被录下来而感到幸运。

entries.trans: a. 无知识的, 不知道的, 由无知产生的；[法] 无知的, 愚昧的, 不知情的
example: Ignorant girl is often led on by her irresponsible lover.
That seems to be an ignorant statement to make when this flu bug is already known as a potential killer.

entries.trans: vt. 不理睬, 忽视, 驳回, 忽略；[计] 忽略
example: It is easy to ignore manners when we get too close, but he is always the same as when we first met, no matter how much time passes.
当人们太亲近时就会容易忽视礼仪，但无论时间如何流逝，裴勇俊的举止永远如我们初次见面时一样。

entries.trans: a. 违法的, 不合规定的；[经] 非法的, 犯规的
example: It is one of 22 "right to work" states where such compulsion is illegal (and to which millions of jobs have migrated).
南加州是22个”适合工作“的州之一，在这样的州中，诸如此类的强制加入被认定为非法（正因为如此，成千上万的职位移居到了这里）。

entries.trans: n. 文盲；a. 目不识丁的, 没受教育的
example: But disreputable, illiterate and ignorant though he was, Fegelein seems to have been possessed of a simon-pure instinct FOR survival.
菲格莱因虽然声名狼藉，愚昧无知，但似乎仍具有贪图活命的单纯本能。

entries.trans: n. 疾病, 恶意；[医] 病
example: If it had, we would have seen a decrease in the amount of illness and pathology in society.
如果有，我们就应看到社会上疾病数量的减少和发病率的降低；

entries.trans: vt. 照明, 用灯装饰, 阐明, 说明, 使灿烂；vi. 照亮, 用灯装饰
example: I would beg you to try to illuminate with your pocket torch what the position of the obsessional is in this regard.
我将请求你们设法以你们的手电筒，去照亮关于这一点，偏执狂的位置在哪里。

entries.trans: n. 幻影, 错觉, 幻想；[医] 错觉
example: Using sophisticated computer animation to create the illusion of color seems to be the focus of the mainstream film world real.
用高超电脑动画特技创造的虚幻焦色俨然成了电影世界真正的主流。

entries.trans: vt. 举例说明, 作图解, 阐明；vi. 举例说明
example: To illustrate why IP systems tend to get out of balance, imagine a simple society including you and me.
为说明知识产权体制为何易于失衡，请想象一个简单的社会，其中只有你和我。

entries.trans: n. 例证, 插图；[化] 插图
example: Its purpose is not to do a meaningful calculation, but to provide an easy-to-understand illustration of our solution.
它的目的并不是做有意义的计算，而是为我们的解决方案提供一个易于理解的说明。

entries.trans: n. 影像, 肖像, 想象, 图像, 形象, 翻版；vt. 作...的像, 反映, 想象, 象征；n. 图像；[计] 图象
example: At the same time, the image of the murderer is wiped off the human side and made to be an absolute villain.
凶手的形象在电影中也被抹去人性的一面而塑造成彻底的反面人物。

entries.trans: a. 想像的, 虚构的, 假想的
example: He sits, his eyes locked to hers, as she says, "You vill eat, mein little schweinhund" and upbraids him for imaginary transgressions.
他往那一坐，当她用一口德式英语说“你必须吃饭，我的小猪”，谴责想像中的不听话时，他的眼睛直勾勾地盯着那女人的眼睛。

entries.trans: n. 想像, 听觉, 想像力；[医] 想像
example: Imagination Such similar ruins can only provide me with a brilliant imagination.
《遐想》像很多类似这样的废墟，只能给我提供曾经辉煌的遐想。

entries.trans: a. 想像的, 虚构的
example: She bore on her breast, in the curiously embroidered letter, a specimen of her delicate and imaginative skill.
她胸前佩戴的那个绣得十分绝妙的字母，就是她精致和富于想象力的技艺的一个样品；

entries.trans: vt. 想像, 设想, 猜测；vi. 想像起来
example: Imagine an animal living in an environment where, over the course of a day, he might hear some rustling in the leaves or maybe in the grass.
设想一只动物居住在这个样的一个环境，在一天当中它可能会听到树叶或者是草丛的沙沙声。

entries.trans: vt. 模仿, 效法, 冒充, 仿造
example: Reading this chapter, you don't fool so much to bend yourself to imitate the actions of these successful men of practice.
读了庄子这篇文章，可别傻到专门去学这些修行有成的人的样子。

entries.trans: n. 模仿, 效法, 冒充, 赝品；[医] 模仿, 仿制, 仿制品
example: Unable to suppress their instinctive impulse to dance, the two members busted out in an imitation of each others choreography.
无法抑制自己的本能冲动，舞蹈，捣毁了两名成员在彼此的舞蹈模仿。

entries.trans: a. 立即的, 直接的, 接近的；[医] 直接的, 立即的
example: He praised the board for its immediate action but it never followed up "and there was no real check on my wife or me" .
他称赞委员会行动迅速但它绝不会寻根究底，也没有对我妻子或我进行真正的检查。

entries.trans: adv. 直接地, 立刻, 立即
example: The number must follow the name immediately; don't put a space between them.
Immediately, a few of his scouts came out of thestables, with horses and went out to seek Saul's Family.

entries.trans: a. 极广大的, 无边的, 非常好的
example: At no time has Gaddafi thought he is a dictator, even if he blithely confuses the immense resources of his country with his own wealth.
卡扎菲即使无所挂虑地将国家的庞大资源混同于自己的财产，也从来没认为自己是个独裁者。

entries.trans: vt. 沉浸, 使陷入；[医] 浸[入]
n. 移民；a. 移入的, 移民的
example: This anti-immigrant demonstration in Athens earlier this year was one of many to turn violent.
许多游行最后都演变成暴乱，今年年初雅典举行的反移民游行即是其中一个案例。

entries.trans: vt. 使移居入境；vi. 移入
example: Knowing I was at risk, and advised by American friends, I decided to leave my home in Rwanda and to immigrate to the United States.
认识到自己的危险处境之后，我接受了美国朋友的建议，决定离开我在卢旺达的家，移民到美国。

entries.trans: n. 移民, 移居；[医] 移民
example: He has no plans for tougher immigration or asylum controls, and is proud that his government made it legal for asylum-seekers to work.
对于移民和收容所管理，他没有更强硬的计划，他为其政府使得庇护寻求者工作合法化而骄傲。

entries.trans: n. 不朽人物, 神仙；a. 永远的, 不死的, 长久的
example: Sink to the seabed some background on the accident at the end of the moment the announcement of his eternal immortal.
沉入海底的背影在结束的一瞬间就意外的宣告了他的永恒不灭。

entries.trans: a. 免疫的, 免除的, 不受影响的；n. 免疫者
