example: Echinacea has been used for centuries to help support strong immune systems.
紫锥花几个世纪以来一直用于支持强有力的免疫系统。

entries.trans: n. 免疫, 免疫性, 免除；[化] 免疫性
example: But his parliamentary immunity has been lifted, at his own request, and he says he expects to be arrested over the casino deal.
但在他自己的要求下，其司法豁免权已被取消，他认为他可能会因赌场投资案被逮捕。

entries.trans: n. 冲击, 冲突, 影响, 效果；vt. 挤入, 撞击, 压紧, 对...发生影响
example: These have been around the construction of Qingdao was the impact of the construction is considerable.
这些建筑对周围已经后来青岛建筑的影响是相当大的。

entries.trans: vt. 损害, 减少, 削弱；[法] 损害, 伤害, 减少
example: No one shall be subject to coercion which would impair his freedom to have or to adopt a religion or belief of his choice.
二任何人所享保有或采奉自择之宗教或信仰之自由，不得以胁迫侵害之。

entries.trans: vt. 给予, 传授, 告知
example: Ustane, by the way, was also blindfolded, I do not know why, unless it was from fear lest she should impart the secrets of the route to us.
顺便提一句，不知道为什么尤斯坦也被蒙上了眼睛，大概是怕她会把秘密路线泄露给我们吧。

entries.trans: a. 公平的, 不偏不倚的；[法] 公正无私的, 不偏袒的, 公平的
example: If I were a teacher, I should be fair and impartial carefully, even if mistakes squad, and no different from ordinary students punishment.
假如我是一位老师，我的心地要公正无私，即使班长犯错，与普通学生处罚毫无两样。

entries.trans: a. 不耐烦的, 着急的, 急切的
example: He seems to me to be rather impatient.
He told me that he had been impatient of the long wait.

entries.trans: n. 命令, 必要的事, 规则, 祈使语气；a. 命令式的, 急需的, 势在必行的, 强制的
example: To be free, in the sense of autonomous, requires that I act not out of a hypothetical imperative but out of a categorical imperative.
为了获得自由，在自主的范畴内需要我的行为，不是出于“假言命令”，而是出于“定言命令”。

entries.trans: a. 帝王的, 宗主国的, 至尊的, 壮丽的；n. 特等品
example: The GAT is one of the smallest Imperial Navy vessels to be equipped with a hyperdrive, providing class two hyperspace performance.
Gat是帝国海军中装备超空间推进器的最小的船只，推进器赋予它二级超空间性能。

entries.trans: n. 动力, 推动力, 动量；[医] 冲动, 动能, 起始(病)
example: She stood naked except for her bra, which hung by one strap down the side of her body; she had not the impetus to shrug it of.
除了乳罩，她一丝不挂地站着。乳罩挂在她身体的一侧；她没想抖落乳罩。

entries.trans: n. 工具, 器具, 手段；vt. 实现, 使生效, 执行
example: This also means that XML-based IoC allows you to implement and test the business logic of each of the tasks of your workflow independently.
这也就意味着基于XML的IoC允许您对工作流程中的每一个任务的业务逻辑分别进行实现和测试。

entries.trans: n. 牵连, 含义, 暗示；[法] 推断, 含蓄之意, 暗示
example: The implication of governance conception emerged that referred to a new change notion of administration reform in public sector.
概念的出现，意味著政府部门从事改革思维的一种演变。

entries.trans: a. 暗示的, 含蓄的, 固有的, 绝对的；[经] 不讲明的, 含蓄的
example: This conversion is called implicit cursor conversion, and is sometimes referred to as cursor degradation.
这种转换被称为隐式游标转换，有时也称为游标降级。

entries.trans: vt. 恳求, 哀求
example: Still be on your guard as the final acts of the dark Ones play themselves out, and as we so often implore you, do not give in to fear.
请依旧保持警觉，因为黑暗势力在做最后的挣扎而依旧是出局的结局，并且作为我们这么经常的“恳求”你们，不要跌入“恐惧”中。

entries.trans: vt. 暗示, 意味；[计] 隐含
example: Financial globalisation itself, they imply, ought to be seen not so much as a bad thing, but as too much of a good one.
他们认为，金融全球化本身不应该看作一件坏事，而是一件好事。

entries.trans: n. 进口货, 进口, 输入, 含义, 重要性；vt. 输入, 引入, 进口, 含...的意思, 重要；vi. 有关系；[计] 引入
example: I don't think you truly understand the full import of your position and place in all of this.
我不认为你们真的了解你们所处位置的全部重要性，并且（以此）安排一切。

entries.trans: n. 重要, 重要性, 重要地位, 自大；[机] 重要, 重要性
example: Also, Italian fashion is more internationally acclaimed and French fashion has no longer the importance it had in the 40s, 50s, and 60s.
此外，意大利时装更国际知名的法国时尚已不再重视它在40年代，50年代和60年代曾。

entries.trans: vt. 征(税), 把...强加于, 以...欺骗；vi. 利用, 欺骗, 施加影响
example: First came the post-Iraq realisation that it is not that easy to impose them at the point of a cruise missile.
先是西方在伊拉克战争过后认识到，依靠巡航导弹把价值观强加给别人并没那么容易。

entries.trans: a. 不可能的, 难以置信的, 令人无法忍受的
example: Once god came up to me & granted me a wish. I asked for world peace. That's impossible, he said.
有一次上帝来到我面前答应了我一个愿望。我说我要世界和平。“那是不可能的”他说。

entries.trans: vt. 使贫穷, 耗尽...的力气
example: I don't think we were at war against Indonesia, or simply trying to impoverish the Philippines.
我并不认为我们并不是在跟印度尼西亚战斗，也不仅仅是为了榨取菲律宾。

entries.trans: n. 印象, 特征, 印记；vt. 使有印象, 印, 铭刻, 传送, 影响, 强征；vi. 给人印象
example: Your desire to impress this person will cause you to do all that you can to be at your very best.
你要给这个人带去好印象的希望会让你尽力做到自己最好。

entries.trans: n. 印象, 意念, 盖印, 印记, 印数, 底色, 效果；[医] 压迹, 印模, 印象, 影响
example: My own impression at the time was that nobody really needed comfort or reassurance, except the pundits who complained.
那个时候我个人的印象是，没有人真正需要宽慰和保证，除了那些怨声载道的专家们。

entries.trans: a. 给人深刻印象的, 威严的
example: Most impressive was the Shanghai sisters friendship, in order to let me quickly into them, I must transform into a Shanghai native.
最受感动的是上海姐妹的情谊，为了让我很快融入她们当中，一定要把我改造成地地道道的上海人。

entries.trans: vt. 使下狱, 关闭, 拘禁, 限制；[法] 关押, 监禁, 限制
example: So fearful was Cronos of the Oracle's prediction that his own children would rise against him that he decided to imprison all in his belly.
他非常害怕女祭祀的预言，他的孩子成长后会推翻他，所以他决定把他们全部囚禁在自己的肚子中。

entries.trans: a. 不合适的, 错误的, 不成体统的, 不道德的；[法] 不适当的, 不合适的, 不正确的
example: Due to improper use or other man-made houses or neighbors responsible for compensation of losses or to repair.
因使用不当或其他人为原因造成房屋或邻里损失的，乙方负责赔偿或给予修复。

entries.trans: vt. 改良, 提高...的价值, 改善, 利用；vi. 变得更好, 增加
example: Such a commitment would significantly improve access to clean technology by those who need it most but are least able to pay.
这种承诺将显著改善那些最需要清洁能源技术但是最无法购买它们的人们对这些技术的获取。

entries.trans: n. 进步, 改善, 利用；[医] 改善, 好转, 进步
example: 'It's not a competition about how much cash you have, ' but about 'product improvement' and 'end-user experience, ' he said.
他说，这里比的不是你有多少钱，而是产品优化和终端用户体验。

entries.trans: n. 冲动, 驱使, 刺激, 推动, 冲力, 建议, 脉冲；vt. 推动
example: I held it tightly between my toes, and, acting on an impulse, made a wild sort of scribble with it on the slate.
我的脚趾紧紧地夹住那支粉笔，然后凭着一时的冲动，用它在石板上使劲地乱画了一下。

entries.trans: n. 杂质, 不洁, 不纯；[化] 杂质
example: And sexual immorality, impurity, and greed have no place in a Christian's exercise routine.
而荒淫、不洁和贪婪的行为，更不应出现在基督徒的日常生活中。

entries.trans: a. 难得到的, 难接近的, 难达成的
example: Unfortunately, that is often inaccessible as blocked by the desire to be shocking or to defend some special interest.
不幸的是，只能望洋兴叹由愿望，令人震惊，或保卫阻止一些特殊的兴趣。

entries.trans: a. 错误的, 不准确的；[化] 不精确
example: Federal investigators have found a significant error rate because information in the database is sometimes inaccurate or outdated.
联邦调查员发现，由于数据库中偶尔的信息错误或过期会产生很高错误率。

entries.trans: a. 不充分的, 不适当的；[法] 不充分的, 不适当的
example: The Japanese had launched against the Philippines an air attack that quickly reduced our inadequate air forces to practical impotence.
日本已向菲律宾采取空中攻势，使我们原极薄弱的空军丧失其战斗力。

entries.trans: adv. 因...之故, 在...范围内
example: We have much admiration for you all inasmuch that you took on the challenge of duality, knowing it would be a an extremely hard experience.
我们对你们非常的钦佩，因为你们承担了二元性的所有挑战，并且我们明白这确实是一种极端困难的体验。

entries.trans: vt. 开始, 举行...就职典礼
example: He said it was a historic event and that he is certain it will inaugurate a new era and a new relationship between the two countries.
卡尔德隆总统说，这是一次历史性会晤，他坚信这次会晤将开启一个新的时代，以及两国间新的关系。

entries.trans: a. 白热的, 闪闪发光的, 辉耀的, 灿烂的；[医] 白炽的, 白热的
example: The resulting hybrid LED gives off a warm white light with a slightly yellow cast, similar to that of the incandescent lamp.
这种合二为一的发光二极管发出带有轻微黄色的柔柔的白光，效果和白炽灯一样。

entries.trans: a. 无能力的, 不能的；[机] 不能行的, 耐不住的
example: For a decade before he took over in 2005 his party looked incapable of governing, even when it was still nominally doing it.
在他2005年成为保守党党魁之前的十年，保守党一直有名无实地参与国家的治理，没有能力执政。

entries.trans: n. 香, 香气, 奉承；vi. 焚香；vt. 用香焚, 使发怒
example: Memory is the smell flowers, all filled with the color of lavender, people run the eyes and ears of the heart lit incense, warm heart!
记忆就是阵阵花香，处处弥漫着薰衣草的颜色，润人耳目，点燃心香，温暖心房！

entries.trans: n. 动机；a. 激励的
example: There was no mechanism or incentive to protect knowledge and their research networks have limited interaction with industry.
没有机制或者激励用于保护知识，而它们的研究网络限制了与工业界的互动。

entries.trans: n. 英寸, 身高, 小岛；vi. 慢慢前进, 慢慢移动；vt. 使缓慢地移动
example: He was absolutely inch-perfect in qualifying, when it was very easy to make a mistake on the tyres as we saw other drivers were doing.
他几乎在排位赛上表现完美，而我们常常看到其他车手在轮胎上犯错误。

entries.trans: n. 发生, 发生率, 影响, 负担者, 入射, 倾角；[医] 入射, 发生率, 发生数
example: Fungous infection occupy a portion of patients with dermal ulcer and easy to be neglected due to its low incidence rate.
真菌感染在皮肤溃疡中占一定比例，由于其不常见，而易被忽视。

entries.trans: n. 事件, 事变, 小事；a. 附带的, 易于发生的, 外来的, 入射的
example: In a statement, the president said he 'was shocked and deeply saddened' by the incident.
奥巴马发表声明称，他对这起事件感到震惊和深切悲痛。

entries.trans: adv. 伴随地, 偶然, 顺便
example: Testicular epidermoid cyst is usually incidentally found during a physical check-up. It is an uncommon intratesticular benign tumor.
睪丸表皮样囊肿通常由身体检查时意外发现，是一种不常见的睪丸内良性肿瘤。

entries.trans: n. 倾向, 趋向, 倾斜度, 点头；[化] 倾角
example: When sales slump due to a slow economy, a business owner's first inclination is often to cut the marketing budget.
在经济萧条的时候，各个行业的公司主管通常最倾向于削减市场宣传方面的预算。

entries.trans: n. 倾斜, 斜坡, 斜面；vt. 使倾向于, 使倾斜；vi. 倾向, 倾斜, 爱好, 易于
example: Incline not my heart to any evil thing, to practise wicked works with men that work iniquity: and let me not eat of their dainties.
求你不要容我的心偏向恶事，免得我和作孽的人一同行恶，也不要使我吃他们的美食。

entries.trans: vt. 包括, 把...算入, 包住；[计] DOS内部命令:在CONFIG.SYS文件的一个配置块中包含另一配置块的内容
example: You can include none at all if the function is being used as a procedure and has no useful return value.
如果函数被用作一个过程，并且没有任何有用的返回值，那么可以不包含return语句。

entries.trans: a. 包含的, 包括的
example: It is not just a question of teaching British history in a clear and inclusive way, but of improving education across all subjects.
不仅是教授全面清晰的英国历史，同时也要加强所有科目的教育。

entries.trans: n. 收入, 收益, 流入；[经] 收益
example: Income You should never ask how much someone's salary is.
Nearby discharge more of a strong 1045, the Great Music has no income, the air has been filled with casual attitudes of gunpowder incense.

entries.trans: a. 不相容的, 不能并存的, 矛盾的；[化] 不协调
example: Safety is not the only area in which managers are required to balance incompatible and incommensurable factors .
安全并不是唯一需要管理人员平衡不兼容和不可比因素的领域。

entries.trans: a. 不完全的, 未完成的, 不完善的；[机] 不完全的
example: But the euro was an incomplete currency: it had a central bank but no treasury.
然而，欧元并非完整的货币：欧元区设有央行却没有金库。

entries.trans: a. 合并的, 组成公司的, 一体化的；vt. 吸收, 合并, 使组成公司, 体现；vi. 合并, 混合, 组成公司
example: Many current DTDs incorporate ways to deal with some of these issues, but the breadth of the issues leads to more than just a DTD.
许多当前DTD合并了处理这些问题的方法，但这些问题所涉及的范围往往超出了DTD。

entries.trans: a. 不正确的；[法] 不正确, 错误的, 不适当的
example: If you were experiencing incorrect or unexpected behavior in your current level of DB2, it might have been due to a product defect.
如果您在当前级别的DB2中遇到不正确的或意料之外的行为，那么可能是由于某项产品缺陷。

entries.trans: n. 增加, 增进, 利益；vt. 增加, 加大；vi. 增加, 繁殖
example: Start slowly and increase your activity as you feel up to it.
当你感觉自己已经准备好了，就可以开始循序渐进的增加活动量。

entries.trans: adv. 逐渐地, 渐增地
example: The way we heard it framed was that people feel increasingly that Chinese society has no moral compass.
制定这道法令的情形是，人们感到中国社会正在陷入一种道德迷失。

entries.trans: a. 难以置信的
example: It was incredible to see how his talent for technical construction ran in parallel with his desire to make women look beautiful.
令人难以置信的是，他在制作手艺层面的才华，与他那种为女人带来美丽的渴望是并驾齐驱的。

entries.trans: vt. 招致, 蒙受, 遭遇；[经] 招致, 蒙受, 担负
example: This enables you to ask "what-if" about a particular set of physical design structures before you incur the overhead of implementing them.
这样一来，您就可以在发生应用这些结构产生的开销之前，对一组特定物理设计结构组作出假设分析。

entries.trans: adv. 的确, 实在, 真正地, 甚至
example: After a few more verification runs, and a bit of self shame, I realized it indeed was my problem and got out the debugger.
在经过更多次的核实以后，让我感到有些羞愧，我意识到这确实是我的问题。

entries.trans: a. 模糊的, 不确定的, 无限的；[法] 不确定的, 无限制的
example: To visitors, the indefinite beast of a room will seem to be out of control.
对于客人说来，这让人捉摸不定的房间怪兽似乎是不受控制的。

entries.trans: adv. 无期限地
example: I'm just trying to say: Being single is an option. It's a valid option: temporarily, or indefinitely.
我只是想说，单身是一种生活选择，一种暂时或者永远的选择。

entries.trans: n. 独立, 自立, 自主；[医] 自主性, 独立性
example: Sometimes the parents need to give the child certain independency, like this can the better exercise child's independence.
有时父母需要给孩子一定的自主性，这样才能更好的锻炼孩子的独立性。

entries.trans: n. 独立自主者, 无党派者；a. 独立的, 有主见的, 不须依赖的, 不受约束的
example: To secure control he had to agree to abide by a series of editorial standards, to be policed by an independent special committee.
为了获得控制权，他不得不同意遵守由一个独立的特别委员会制定的一系列编辑标准。

entries.trans: n. 索引, 指针, 指数, 指标；vt. 编入索引中, 指出；vi. 做索引；[计] 下标; 附标; 变址; 索引; 编索引
example: Columns of a unique index are allowed to be NULL, while columns in a unique constraint are not.
唯一索引的列可以为NULL，而唯一约束的列不能为NULL。

entries.trans: n. 印度
example: What blew their mind was the first one took place in India, it was the party of a Hindu God.
出乎他们意料的是，第一个故事实际上发生在印度，那是一个信印度某位神灵的组织。

entries.trans: n. 印度人, 印第安人, 印第安语；a. 印度的, 印度群岛的, 印第安语的
example: American scientists and businessmen note enviously that religious and moral considerations do not seem to inhibit Indian biotechnologists.
美国科学家和商人有点嫉妒意味的指出，宗教和道义上的考量似乎并没有妨碍印度的生物学家们。

entries.trans: vt. 显示, 象征, 指示, 指出；[医] 指示
n. 指示, 象征, 暗示；[医] 指示, 指征, 适应征
example: We have no real indication that the science of just a small amount [of] more fructose matters,  Popkin says.
波普金说。“我们还没有真正的科学证据表明，仅仅多了一点果糖，就会有什么了不起的事情发生。”

entries.trans: a. 指示的, 象征的, 表示...的；[经] 指标的
example: Williams said he welcomed it as "indicative of the kind of relationship for which we yearn in all parts of the world" .
Williams对此表示欢迎，称这意味着“我们在世界各地都渴求的一种友好关系”。

entries.trans: a. 漠不关心的, 无重要性的, 中立的；[医] 中性的, 无作用的, 无亲和力的, 淡漠的
example: As for people who love us but whom we do not love, we may be indifferent, or at least would not harbor such a deep overall concern.
至于爱我们但我们不爱的人，我们可能是不关心的，或者至少不会怀有这样一种深切的全面关心。

entries.trans: a. 愤怒的, 愤慨的
example: Do you think you are right?  she said in an indignant tone.
“你认为你做得对吗？”她用愤慨的腔调说。

entries.trans: n. 愤怒, 愤慨, 义愤
example: That is in the past and whipping yourself into a state of moral indignation does not help your team and does not buy you a place in heaven.
那属于过去，迫使自己处于一种义愤的状态，不会对你的团队有所帮助，也不会帮你买到天堂的一席之地。

entries.trans: a. 间接的, 非直截了当的, 不坦率的；[医] 间接的
example: She was extremely surprised at such a question because in the British culture it would be regarded as an indirect invitation to lunch.
她对这样的问话感到特别的吃惊，因为按照英国的文化，这样的话题将被认为是间接的邀请对方共进午餐。

entries.trans: adv. 无差别, 任意地; 不分青红皂白地; 滥; 不分皂白
example: The hospital chief executive said the attackers just barged in and fired indiscriminately.
这家医院院长表示，袭击者冲进来，乱枪扫射。

entries.trans: n. 不可缺少之物；a. 不可缺少的, 责无旁贷的, 绝对必要的
example: The work lawyers do is in fact indispensable for our society. What is more, studying law is often the first step to a career in politics.
律师的工作对于我们的社会来说是非常必要的。再说，学习法律往往是从政的第一步。

entries.trans: n. 人, 个人, 个体；a. 个别的, 个人的, 独特的
example: The individual soldiers in the war zone are the most adaptable unit out there,  he said.
“作战区域的士兵个体是那里适应力最强的单元，”他说。

entries.trans: a. 户内的, 室内的
example: Its unique eight frame design at indoor monorail station makes it a modern masterpiece.
它在室内轻轨车站上独特的八框架设计使它成为了一件现代建筑杰作。

entries.trans: adv. 在户内
example: In such a weather of sleet, people would rather stay indoors for a whole day than going out if there was nothing urgent and imperative.
在这样雨雪交加的日子里，如果没有什么紧要事，人们宁愿一整天足不出户。

entries.trans: vt. 引诱, 招致, 归纳出, 感应；[医] 诱导, 感应
example: I was not able to induce the Admiralty to send the armoured brigade, or at least their vehicles, through the Mediterranean.
我未能说服海军部取道地中海运送装甲旅或至少运送该旅的车辆。

entries.trans: n. 归纳法, 感应, 就职, 入门；[计] 归纳法
example: Since Hume, the problem of induction had been a puzzle that baffled western empiricist scientists and philosophers.
自休谟以来，归纳问题一直是困扰西方经验主义科学家和哲学家的难题。

entries.trans: vt. 纵情于, 使高兴, 放任, 迁就；vi. 沉溺
example: Who says a girl can't indulge a bit on her birthday? Realitystar Kim Kardashian enjoyed French fries for her birthday lunch.
谁说女孩不能在自己之生日尽情享受呢？吉姆·卡戴珊在她之生日午餐中享用炸薯条。

entries.trans: a. 工业的, 供工业用的, 工业高度发展的, 产业的；n. 工业工人, 工业股票
example: Any fewer, he said, would trigger a 'hollowing out' of the company's industrial base.
他说，一旦少于300万辆，就会引发公司产业基础的“空洞化”。

entries.trans: vt. 使工业化；vi. 实现工业化
example: Without exports small countries would not be able to industrialize their economies, regardless of the cost involved.
如果不依靠出口，小国家根本无法实现经济工业化，无论他们的成本有多低。

entries.trans: a. 勤勉的, 刻苦的
example: Youth is a dream, flying above the playing. run against the wind, the industrious sweat makes you to pursue steps.
青春是一种梦想，梦想在赛场上飞翔。迎风奔跑，辛勤的汗水化做你追求得脚步。

entries.trans: n. 勤劳, 工业, 企业, 产业, 有组织的劳动；[经] 工业, 实业
example: Artists of 'Post-Graffiti' bring her to the field of cultural industry with latest technology and a variety of materials.
艺术家运用新的科技与多元媒材开创具体的形式概念，将涂鸦艺术带向文化产业的领域。

entries.trans: a. 无效率的, 无能的；[医] 无效的, 无效力的
example: And though they have demonstrated that this goal is possible, the means for doing so have been inefficient and expensive.
有些科学家已经证实过这样做是可以实现的，但是方法一度效率低下且成本昂贵。

entries.trans: n. 惯性, 惰性, 迟钝；[化] 惯性
example: Eextremecclyfirst has wonderful potential power , moreover, it's easy to be covered by habit , dimmed by time or idle apart in inertia.
每个人都有潜在的能量，只是很容易被习惯所掩盖，被具体时间所迷离，被惰性所消磨！

entries.trans: a. 不可避免的, 必然的；[法] 不可避免的, 无法规避的, 必然的
example: At this point, the cabal is fully cognizant of the fact that a positive first contact by the Galactic Federation is inevitable and underway!
在这一点，黑暗势力充分认识到事实，那就是一个正面的第一次接触，与银河联邦的，是不可避免的并且正在落实！！

entries.trans: adv. 不可避免地
example: And I'd love for it to be true that big increases in the money supply inevitably cause inflation, but it is not true.
我也很希望货币供给会不可避免地导致通货膨胀这种事是真的，但是事实并非如此。

entries.trans: a. 便宜的, 不贵重的
example: The two-passenger hybrid aims to be fuel efficient, easy to repair, safe to drive and inexpensive to own.
这辆双座位的混合动力汽车的目标是省油，容易维修，驾驶安全，并且购买价格低廉。

entries.trans: a. 无耻的, 不名誉的, 声名狼藉的
example: The latest version of TweetDeck has become somewhat infamous for how much memory it often eats up after a few hours of continuous usage.
TweetDeck的最新版本有些声名狼藉，因为在使用一段时间后，TweetDeck会用掉不小的内存。

entries.trans: n. 幼年, 初期, 幼儿期；[医] 婴儿期(一足岁以内)
example: He said that rushing meals was a behaviour that might have been learned in infancy, and could be reversed, although this might not be easy.
吃饭快可能是婴儿期学会的一种习惯，尽管改掉这个习惯不太容易，但也可能有办法使这个习惯相反。

entries.trans: n. 婴儿, 儿童, 初学者；a. 婴儿的, 幼稚的
example: But the infant will hold her place in Hollywood history as the very first infant wax figure at Madame Tussauds Wax Museum in New York City.
但是这个婴儿将留名于好莱坞历史，因为她是纽约杜莎夫人蜡像馆里首个婴儿蜡像人物。

entries.trans: vt. 传染, 感染；[医] 传染, 感染
example: CONTAGIOUS diseases are usually dealt with by isolating the patient, lest he infect anyone else, and then by trying to treat the illness.
一般来讲，得了传染病的病人会被隔离，以免他将病菌传染给他人，然后再想办法对其治疗。

entries.trans: a. 有传染性的, 易传染的；[医] 传染性的
example: Their results were clear: in regions with a greater variety of infectious parasites, the diversity of religions also tends to be greater.
其结果是明确的：在传染性寄生虫种类繁多的区域，宗教的多样性也往往会更明显。

entries.trans: vt. 推论出, 推断；vi. 作推论
example: By comparing the two forecasts it is possible to infer how realistic the bank judges market expectations to be.
比较两个预测可以看出，英格兰银行对市场预期的判断是很现实的。

entries.trans: n. 推论；[法] 推论, 推理, 推断
example: Describes how the inference process translates the node types encountered in an XML document into a schema structure.
描述推断过程如何将XML文档中遇到的节点类型转换为架构结构。

entries.trans: a. 次等的, 较差的, 下方的, 下级的；n. 部下, 次品, 下标(符号)
example: It had some advantages when microwave induced hyperthermia were used to treat inferior femora and superior shinbone tumor.
阵列式天线置入诱导高温灭活治疗股骨下端、胫骨上端的肿瘤具有先进性。

entries.trans: n. 自卑, 次等；[医] 下位, 下级, 次级, 劣等
example: Even the French, who for decades ran the EU as equal partners with the Germans, are acquiring something of an inferiority complex.
就连几十年来一直在欧盟事务中作为平等伙伴的法国也在德国面前感觉到了自卑。

entries.trans: n. 无限, 神；a. 无穷的, 无限的, 极大的
example: I wondered: in a city like New York, with its infinite possibilities, has monogamy become too much to expect?
我不禁想到：在纽约市这样一个充满无限可能的城市里，一夫一妻制是否是一种奢求？

entries.trans: adv. 无限地, 无数地, 庞大地
example: It seemed to me, as I kept remembering all this, that those times and those summers had been infinitely precious and worth saving.
对我来说，因为我不断回忆往昔的一切，那些时光那些夏日是无穷宝贵而永远值得怀念的。

entries.trans: n. 无限大, 无限；[计] 无穷
example: There was no third person to come between them, and all the infinity around them only seemed to press their hearts closer together.
有第三者介入他们中间，而他们周围无限的空间似乎把他们的心贴得更紧了。

entries.trans: vt. 使膨胀, 使得意, 使通货膨胀, 使充气；vi. 充气, 膨胀
example: Water walking ball to the player to climb into a large, clear plastic ball, then through the zipper mouth to inflate the ball.
水上步行球是要游戏者爬入一个大的、透明的塑料球中，随后通过拉链口对球进行充气。

entries.trans: n. 胀大, 夸张, 通货膨胀；[化] 充气吹胀; 膨胀
example: An interest-rate increase big enough to squeeze inflation back down in short order would cause a needlessly large rise in unemployment.
一次足够大的力度的利率升息的力量能迅速挤压通胀回落，同时也造成了不必要的失业人口的大量增多。

entries.trans: vt. 施以, 加害, 使承受；[法] 处, 加, 予以
example: Or, to put it more bluntly, he ordered his army to inflict starvation on every man, woman and child in Misrata.
再把这句话说得更直接点，他命令他的军队对米苏拉塔的每个男人、女人和孩子实施饥饿攻势。

entries.trans: n. 影响力, 权力, 势力；vt. 影响, 改变
example: Still, there are concerns about how much influence the governor's office could have on the new parole board.
但是，还是有些人关注州政府对于新的假释委员会的影响力。

entries.trans: a. 有影响的, 有势力的
example: Just a few resume highlights for someone considered to be the most influential scientist in history.
仅仅对他几个亮点的回顾，我们认为他是历史上最具影响力的科学家。

entries.trans: vt. 通知, 使了解, 使充满；vi. 提供资料, 告发
example: And the cables provide a glimpse into how much politics inform relations between the world's two largest economies.
同时，从电文中对政治如何影响世界上最大的两个经济体之间的关系也可略见一斑。

entries.trans: n. 基础结构, 基础设施；[经] 基础设施
example: The infrastructure, which would have been a cost-center, suddenly becomes part of the business model for the enterprise.
该基础结构以前可能是一个成本中心，现在突然变成了企业业务模型的一个组成部分。

entries.trans: n. 注入, 泡制, 注入物；[化] 浸渍; 浸泡
example: The invention relates to a negative-pressure infusion method and a negative-pressure infusion device for a cut flower preservation pipe.
本发明涉及一种切花保鲜管负压式灌注方法及其装置。

entries.trans: a. 灵敏的, 精巧的, 聪明的
example: It was quite ingenious , but not the sort of thing you usually associate with fighting a war .
李子干是一种独创的秘密武器，不是你所见的常规战争武器。

entries.trans: n. 心灵手巧, 精巧, 精巧设计
example: With regular expressions, your imagination and ingenuity are virtually the only limits to what you can achieve.
正则表达式几乎无所不能，也许惟一的限制因素就是您的想象力和创造力了。

entries.trans: n. 成分, 因素；[化] 配合剂; 拼料; 成分; 组分
example: Brandy is excellent as a cocktail ingredient, but is often enjoyed solo, as an after dinner drink.
白兰地是鸡尾酒最精彩的组成原料，但是通常被单独用作餐后酒。

entries.trans: vt. 居住于, 占据, 栖息
n. 居民, 居住者；[医] 居民
example: She was a young queen, a virgin in a tower; she was the previous inhabitant, the girl with all the energies.
她是年轻的女王，是塔里的贞女；她是之前住在这里的女孩，能量无限的女孩。

entries.trans: a. 固有的, 与生俱来的；[医] 固有的, 生来的
example: Charms is also something of a catch-all for spells which aren't Transfiguration (spells which change the inherent nature of an object).
咒语也是一种包罗万象的符咒，不过区别于变形术（通过咒语把一个物体的固有性质改变）。

entries.trans: vt. 继承, 遗传；vi. 接受遗产
example: Mere gratuity, also be like the boss, most as a miser, and may not develop to inherit the family business, the cause bigger.
仅仅算小账，也就只能像老大一样，最多做一个守财奴，而不可能发展性地继承家业，把事业做大。

entries.trans: vt. 禁止, 抑制；vi. 起抑制作用
example: American scientists and businessmen note enviously that religious and moral considerations do not seem to inhibit Indian biotechnologists.
美国科学家和商人有点嫉妒意味的指出，宗教和道义上的考量似乎并没有妨碍印度的生物学家们。

entries.trans: n. 字首, 首字母；a. 开始的, 最初的, 字首的；vt. 用姓名的首字母签名
example: Without a confession, initial investigations quickly become a question of the accuser's credibility.
由于没得到被告的认罪，初步调查很快变成了原告可信度的问题。

entries.trans: adv. 最初, 开头
example: The suspect had been on the bus about an hour and initially did not sit near the victim, Caton said.
卡顿说凶犯在车上最初的一个小时内并没有坐在受害者的身旁。

entries.trans: n. 入会, 开始；a. 新加入的；vt. 开始, 传授基本知识给
example: He's got to rebound the ball and do the things he does for us, and that's initiate our offense,  Jackson said.
“他必须抢好篮板，必须做好他平常都为球队贡献的事情，那就是成为我们进攻的发起点”，菲尔说。

entries.trans: n. 主动行动, 首创精神, 主动权；a. 自发的, 起始的
example: Up to this point, the initiative process had been described as a "safety valve" . Now it became an industry and a circus.
在这之前，创议制被认为是一个“安全阀”，现在它成了一个产业，一个马戏团。

entries.trans: vt. 注射, 注入, 使入轨；[医] 注射
example: An out-of-the-box scan might be able to inject code that might disrupt the operations of the web application you are trying to scan.
一个外部扫描可能会对你试着去扫描的web应用注入恶意代码扰乱它的操作执行。

entries.trans: n. 注射, 注射剂；[化] 注入; 注射
example: A little bit. He took an injection and is resting at home now.
Fueled in part by this massive injection of liquidity, housing prices that had started dropping due to the recession began to soar again.

entries.trans: vt. 伤害, 损害, 使受冤屈；[医] 损伤
example: One should enjoy his property in such a manner as not to injure that of another person.
享有自已的财产应以不损害他人的利益为限。

entries.trans: n. 伤害, 侮辱；[医] 伤, 损伤
example: 18 million, but a knee injury restricted his involvement and he did not start in the Premier League until late December.
膝伤限制了他的上场时间，直到十二月底他才在英超赛场上亮相。

entries.trans: n. 墨水, 墨汁；vt. 涂墨水于, 签署, 加墨水
a. 内陆的, 国内的；n. 内地
example: Channel is in inland, lakes, harbor etc. such a water aerial for the ship security navigable.
航道是指在内河、湖泊、港湾等水域供船舶安全通航的的通道。

entries.trans: n. 进口, 插入物；[化] 入口; 进口; 投料口; 供料口
example: The air distribution mechanism is composed of an air inlet pipe, a housing, and a burning cylinder.
The air inlet filter should be maintained in a clean state, there is no dust and litter stays on the surface.

entries.trans: n. 旅馆, 客栈；vi. 住旅馆
example: The old seaman stayed at the inn for many months. The sea-chest in his room was always locked. Nobody knew what was in it.
老海员在客房一住就是好几个月。在此期间，他那口箱子总是锁得严严的，没有人知道那里头藏着什么东西。

entries.trans: a. 先天的, 天生的；[医] 先天的, 生来的
example: Piero shows himself to be the eccentric master of addressing to visual language and of communicating innate spirit quality.
他是那个时代注重视觉语言，传达内在精神质值特立独行的大师。

entries.trans: a. 内部的, 内心的；n. 内部
example: But it may only be during a time of emotional inner turbulence that you can summon the strength to unchain yourself.
但它可能只在感情波动的某一时期如此，这样你就能集中所有力量来解放你自己。

entries.trans: a. 无罪的, 不懂事的, 无知的；n. 天真的人, 笨蛋
example: We were all thinking that this seemingly innocent Chinese student is destined for greatness.
我们都认为这个看起来很单纯的中国姑娘前途不可限量。

entries.trans: n. 改革, 创新；[法] 创新, 改革, 刷新
a. 无数的, 数不清的
example: It was not through the cities that this main stream flowed, but through innumerable little country towns and villages.
这一主流还不在城市，而是在乡村，在不计其数的村镇中。

entries.trans: a. 无机的, 无生物的, 非自然形成的；[医] 无机的
example: At the same culture time, the content of cadmium in cultured shrimp in inorganic cadmium group was more than organic cadmium group.
同一养殖时间内无机镉饲料组养殖对虾对镉的蓄积量要大于相应浓度的有机镉饲料组。

entries.trans: n. 输入, 输入电路；vt. 输入；[计] 输入
example: Rather than simply examining the THD produced by a single tone sinewave input , it is often.
胜于仅仅用一个输入的单一状态正弦波检测总谐波失真。

entries.trans: v. 询问, 问明, 查究
example: But none of the disciples dared to inquire of Him, Who are you? knowing that it was the Lord.
门徒中没有一个敢问他，你是谁？因为知道是主。

entries.trans: n. 质询, 探索, 调查, 询盘；[计] 询问; 查询
example: A judicial inquiry into a matter usually held before a jury, especially an inquiry into the cause of a death.
Goldman Sachs slid 2. 5 percent as the Financial Crisis Inquiry Commission said the bank had not complied with requests for documents.

entries.trans: a. 患精神病的, 极愚蠢的；[医] 神经错乱的
example: His wife's leaving him drove him so mad that he had to be put in an insane asylum for a while.
他妻子的离开使他变得如此发疯，他只好被暂时送往精神病院。

entries.trans: n. 疯狂, 愚顽, 精神错乱；[医] 精神病
example: Love? This wasn't love! This was madness. Insanity. He was crazy. He'd taken something of beauty and twisted it into macabre reality.
爱？这不是爱！这是病态的。他是个疯子。他将美好的事物撕烂，丢进了这残酷的现实中。

entries.trans: n. 昆虫, 卑鄙的人；[医] 昆虫
example: And this crossing here, of the ocean is the only truly regular transoceanic crossing of any insect. A quite incredible feat.
而且这个跨越大洋的飞行，是在所有昆虫中唯一真正有规律的越洋飞行，一个非常了不起的壮举。

entries.trans: n. 插入物；vt. 插入, 把(人造卫星)射入(轨道), 添写；vi. 附着；[计] 插入
example: As you can see, it looks like any other DB2 INSERT statement and uses parameter markers for your four input column values.
如您所见，它看起来与任何其他DB2INSERT语句一样，并对四个输入列值使用参数标志符（marker）。

entries.trans: n. 内部, 内脏, 内幕；a. 内部的, 秘密的, 户内的；adv. 在里面；prep. 在...之内
example: They prepared a very nice and airy room for me, Just coming inside, on a small table I found a vase of roses----my favorite flower.
他们准备了一个很好的和空气，就来帮我把房间内，小桌子上我发现了一个花瓶的玫瑰——我最喜欢的花。

entries.trans: a. 隐伏的, 阴险的, 狡猾的；[医] 隐袭的
example: Yes beloveds, the dark ones who have cast a most insidious cloud of light on your beloved planet and you of light, are now beyond jeopardy.
是的，亲爱的，投射出一片笼罩着你们挚爱的星球与你们光之人的极其阴险的乌云的黑暗势力，现在远超出危难。

entries.trans: n. 察看, 洞察力, 见识；[医] 自知力, 洞察, 顿悟
a. 无关紧要的, 无意义的, 琐碎的
example: People can earn up to US$15 a week, which isn't insignificant in a poor country like Burkina Faso,  says Andrea Micconi of LVIA.
“人们每周最多能挣15美元，而这对像布基拉法所这样的贫困国家而言并不是一笔小数，”LIVA的安德利尔.米考尼说。

entries.trans: v. 坚持, 坚决主张, 强调
a. 坚持的, 迫切的
example: They were guests of the BioCruiser, and he never liked to start out a mission by being insistent.
他们是生态游艇的客人，他也不想在执行任务时显得过于急躁。

entries.trans: vt. 检查, 检阅, 检验；vi. 检查
example: I used to ring them and try to persuade them to let me come and inspect their desks, their family photos and their bookshelves.
我给他们打电话，试着说服他们，允许我去参观其办公桌、家庭照和书架。

entries.trans: n. 检验, 检查, 视察；[医] 检查, 视察, 监督, 望诊
example: Documentation reviewed during this inspection as well as the last inspection showed extremely low counts on your environmental monitoring.
从此次检查以及上次检查中审阅的文件中可以看出你们在环境监控设备方面及其不足。

entries.trans: n. 检查员, 巡视员；[化] 检查员
example: If you do not know whether your document contains hidden text, you can use the Document Inspector to search for it.
如果您不了解文档是否包含隐藏文字，可以使用“文档检查器”来搜索隐藏文字。

entries.trans: n. 灵感, 鼓舞人心的人或物, 妙计, 吸气；[医] 吸[气]
example: I truly love all of you. I am recording tonight, for all of you, you are my true inspiration forever. I am living for you, and the children.
我真心的爱着你们每一个人，今晚我正在为你们而录制这首歌，你们永远是我心灵深处真正的源泉，我为你们及所有的孩子们而生。

entries.trans: vt. 使感动, 激发, 启示, 吸入, 鼓舞, 产生, 使生灵感；vi. 吸入, 赋予灵感
example: The following 10 date ideas should help put you in the mood and may even inspire you to come up with a few on your own.
以下10个约会点子应该可以帮助到你，让你融入浪漫的气氛；甚至激发你设计出一些你自己的浪漫。

entries.trans: n. 不安定, 不稳定；[医] 不稳定性
example: It seemed to me that we ought occasionally to be reminded of instability beneath our feet.
对我来说它意味着我们应该偶尔提醒自己脚下是不稳定的。

entries.trans: vt. 安装, 安置, 使就职；[计] 安装, 安装程序; DOS内部命令:安装常驻程序
example: He said government institutions are dissolved, and that the military will install a committee to run the country.
他说，政府机构已经解散，军方将设立一个委员会来管理国家。

entries.trans: n. 安装, 装置, 就职；[医] 结构, 装置, 设立
example: You see a screen as shown in Figure 4 that prompts you to choose the language to use for the installation process.
现在会看到一个如图4所示的屏幕，它提示您选择安装过程使用的语言。

entries.trans: n. 就职, 装设, 分期付款；[经] 分期付款
example: Bay, who has directed both of the immensely popular Transformer movies said he was working on a third installment in the series.
湾，谁已经指示了极大的欢迎变压器电影都表示，他对在系列的第三部分工作。

entries.trans: n. 建议, 情况, 例子, 场合；vt. 引以为例, 举例说明
n. 立即, 瞬间；a. 紧急的, 立即的, 即时的
example: With Microsoft Word, your readers can have instant access to information in another part of a document or to a web page.
使用MicrosoftWord2000，可以让读者立即访问文档的另一部分或某一Web页。

entries.trans: a. 即时的, 瞬间的, 猝发的；[机] 瞬时的
example: The results are instantaneous because the system has created a database (also known as an index) to tell you where files are located.
结果是即时的因为系统已经创建了一个数据库（也被称为索引）来告诉你文件存储在何处。

entries.trans: adv. 立即地, 即刻地
example: Harry knew instantly that this was what had been watching him out of the garden hedge that morning.
哈利马上想到，这就是早上在花园树篱外看他的那双眼睛。

entries.trans: n. 本能, 直觉；a. 充满着的
example: Used for a purpose, the imitative instinct may, like any other instinct, become a factor in the development of effective action.
模仿的本能，如果为了一个目的加以运用，也许能和任何其他本能一样，成为发展有效的行动的一个因素。

entries.trans: adv. 本能地, 直觉地
example: I don't think so. I stuffed everything carefully with cotton, " replied Li, as he began instinctively opening the drawers. "
李梅亭嘴里说：“我想不会，我棉花塞得好好的，”手本能地拉抽屉了。

entries.trans: n. 学会, 学院, 协会；vt. 创立, 开始, 制定, 任命
example: At the beginning of 2008 the Beatson Institute moved into a new state-of-the-art building - further information can be found here.
2008年开始，比森研究所搬迁到一座新的大厦，进一步信息可在这里发现。

entries.trans: n. 机构, 惯例, 制度；[医] 机关, 机构, 设施
example: Provided that this Contract shall not be in force until its authorization by the Examining and Approving Institution or other department.
但是，本合同须得到审批机构或其它审批部门批准后方可生效。

entries.trans: vt. 教, 教育, 命令, 通知；[法] 托办, 指导, 指示
example: It would be advisable for you to instruct a credit agency to investigate the matter.
贵方指示信用调查机构调查这件事是明智之举。

entries.trans: n. 指令, 教导, 命令；[计] 指令
example: The next button, the wizard will try to correct the problems per your instruction. if you do not wish to continue, click cancel.
在单击“下一步”按钮时，这个向导将根据您的命令试图纠正问题。如果不希望继续，请单击“取消”。

entries.trans: n. 教员, 讲师；[法] 指导者, 教员, 讲师
example: I find the opportunity to ask questions of a knowledgeable instructor and hearing the class discussion invaluable.
我认为，向知识渊博的教师请教问题并聆听课堂讨论，这样的机会是非常宝贵的。

entries.trans: n. 工具, 手段, 仪器；[化] 仪器
example: We view the sale of every one of our Instrument as the start of a long term relationship.
我们认为，光谱仪器销售的每一个我们的仪器只要启动一个长期的关系。

entries.trans: a. 仪器的, 器具的, 可作为手段的；[医] 器械的
example: Putting undue emphasis on the education's social-instrumental value was easy to leave the education losing its independence.
认为片面强调教育的社会工具价值取向容易使教育丧失独立性。

entries.trans: a. 不够的, 不能胜任的, 不充足的；[法] 不足的, 不充分的, 不能胜任的
example: Freedom seems to be a necessary but insufficient condition for innovation; any mechanism that could promote it should be welcomed.
自由是必要的，但没有足够的条件去创新，任何能有促进作用的机制都应该被欢迎。

entries.trans: vt. 使绝缘, 隔离；[医] 绝缘
example: Sitting on a nest like that only made sense if it had feathers to gently insulate its young, says Sues.
“像这样的端坐在巢中，它身上肯定长有能为幼兽保温的羽毛，只有这样才说得通，”苏伊士说。

entries.trans: n. 绝缘体, 从事绝缘工作的工人；[化] 绝缘体; 绝缘器; 绝缘子; 隔离剂
example: And a Y-type waveguide coupler on silicon-on-insulator(SOI)wafer used for an Intergrated optoelectronic Model was designed.
设计了一种Y型SOI波导耦合器，用于光纤陀螺光收发模块。

entries.trans: n. 侮辱, 无礼, 损害；vt. 损害, 侮辱, 攻击
example: What I saw today was an insult to all of the former greats that have worn purple and gold.
我今天所看到的事情，是对所有披过紫金战袍的伟大前辈们的侮辱。

entries.trans: n. 保险, 保险业, 保险费；[医] 保险
example: Meanwhile, insurance companies are also beginning to make preliminary investigation for claims settlement.
与此同时，保险机构也开始进入理赔前期的调查阶段。

entries.trans: vt. 保险, 确保；vi. 投保
example: It is usually the bank's duty to insure that receipts and payments of foreign currency are generated by valid legal transactions.
保证外汇收支的合法交易是中国人民银行的职责。

entries.trans: a. 尚未被人碰过的, 原封不动的, 完整的；[医] 完整的, 无伤的
example: So far, those supply chains seem to be intact, partly helped by the sharp drop in the price of oil.
截止至目前，全球供应链似乎还完好无缺，一定程度上受到石油价格的剧烈下跌的帮助。

entries.trans: n. 入口, 吸入, 吸入量；[医] 摄取量
example: The two groups that had not restricted their caloric intake during the test period did not show more cortisol production.
而在实验期间没有被控制能量摄入的两组被试者没有表现出更高的皮质醇产生率。

entries.trans: n. 整体, 积分, 整数；a. 固有的, 整体的, 整数的, 积分的；[计] 积分
example: Awareness and equality mind are the two wings of a bird as the integral parts. A cart needs at least two wheels to move forward.
觉知与平等心，两者缺一不可，就好像鸟儿需要双翅才能飞翔，推车需要双轮才能移动。

entries.trans: vt. 综合, 使完整, 使成整体；vi. 成一体；a. 完整的, 完全的
example: OSS is often easier to integrate with other solutions as OSS code can be customized to allow disparate systems to interoperate more easily.
OSS往往易于与其它方案集成，由于OSS代码可定制，让两种或多种根本不同的系统更容易互操作。

entries.trans: n. 正直, 廉正, 完整；[计] 完整性
example: He was a man of integrity, but unfortunately he had a certain reputation. I believe the reputation was not deserved.
他是个诚实正直的人，但却不幸有某种坏名声。我相信他不该有这个坏名声。

entries.trans: n. 智力, 出众的才华, 知识分子；[医] 智力, 才智
example: Dombey didn't seem to be absolutely blinded by the light let in upon his intellect, but he made Miss Blimber a little bow.
董贝似乎没有被照到他才智上的亮光完全夺去了目力，但他向布林伯小姐稍稍鞠了个躬。

entries.trans: n. 有知识者, 知识分子, 凭理智做事者；a. 智力的, 用脑力的, 聪明的
example: Now, to a large extent the poor quality of Mr. McCain's advisers reflects the tattered intellectual state of his party.
现在，麦凯恩先生的智囊的可怜品质在更大程度上折射出他所在的党的破烂的知识状况。

entries.trans: adv. 智力上；知性上；理智地
example: It is not only the greatest numerically and greatest culturally, but it seems to me the greatest intellectually.
它不仅有最多的人口和最灿烂的文化，在我看来，他们的智力也是最出色的。

entries.trans: n. 智力, 情报, 信息；[医] 智力
example: Some question whether artificial intelligence, which always seems just a few years away, will ever work well enough.
在过去的几年里，总有一些关于人工智能能否一直正常工作的疑问出现。

entries.trans: a. 聪明的, 智能的, 了解的
example: A building controlled by a BAS is often referred to as an intelligent building system.
BAS控制的建筑通常又由被称为智能建筑。

entries.trans: a. 可理解的, 易理解的, 纯概念性的
example: Although its engine works at the lowest possible level, Prisma was designed to be very user-friendly, with an intelligible interface.
虽然它的发动机工程在尽可能最低的水平，prisma设计，可以非常方便用户，与一个理解的界面。

entries.trans: vt. 计划, 打算, 意思是；[法] 想要, 打算, 意旨
example: He said the scientists intend to test earlier pottery from the region for chemical proof.
他说，科学家打算检测来自该地区较早的陶器作为化学证据。

entries.trans: a. 非常的, 强烈的, 紧张的, 热情的；[医] 强的
example: Right now there's intense debate about how aggressive the United States government should be in its attempts to turn the economy around.
当前，人们激烈地争论美国政府正试图如何更有效地摆脱经济衰退。

entries.trans: vt. 加强；vi. 强化
example: The combination of telling individuals that tobacco kills you and trying to intensify that fear with disgust-evoking images backfires.
把告诉个人烟草害人和试图利用增强对反感形象的害怕的结合适得其反。

entries.trans: n. 强烈, 紧张, 强度；[计] 强度; 亮度
example: However, he gave no more details other than saying the reduction in carbon intensity would be "notable" .
然而，除了表示碳排放强度会“显著”下降外，他没有提及更多细节。

entries.trans: a. 加强的, 内涵的, 集中的；n. 加强器
example: Reports of the paper's imminent death are exaggerated, but it would not be much of a stretch to say that the Times is in intensive care.
那些关于《纽约时报》即将寿终正寝的报道是夸大其词了些，不过可以毫不夸张地说：这份报纸已处于重症监护之中。

entries.trans: n. 意图, 含义, 故意；a. 专心的, 决心的, 热心的
example: Sliding the key into some hidden pocket in her robe, Nahti turned around and smiled at him with a face full of passion and intent.
而这时钥匙已轻轻的滑入了娜蒂法袍里的某个隐藏口袋，她转过身对马库斯露出1个充满豪情且诡秘的笑容。

entries.trans: n. 意图, 目的, 含义；[医] 愈合, 意向
example: Talk about intention, he wanted the united states red envelopes, wake up the conscience of the wall street rich.
谈打算，他想去美国发红包，唤醒华尔街富豪们的良知。

entries.trans: a. 故意的, 与目的有关的；[法] 故意的, 有意的
example: They denied any intentional wrongdoing, saying they were only trying to help orphans left destitute by the quake.
他们否认有任何不良企图，并说，他们仅仅是想帮助这些地震中的孤儿摆脱贫困。

entries.trans: vi. 互相影响, 交互作用；n. 幕间剧, 幕间休息
example: Can interact in a simple way provided the other person talks slowly and clearly and is prepared to help.
能在他人缓慢清晰地说话且乐于帮助的情况下进行简单交流。

entries.trans: n. 交互作用, 交感；[计] 交互作用
example: Testing the interaction shown in Figure 2 can be broken out into a number of different scenarios, but two stand out.
图2所示的交互测试可用于多个不同场景，但是其中两种场景最为常见。

entries.trans: vt. 使互相连接
example: Better yet, rsync is available on every flavor of UNIX, including Mac OS X, so it's easy to interconnect virtually any set of systems.
更棒的是，在所有风格的UNIX上都可以使用rsync，包括MacOSX，所以很容易连接任何系统。

entries.trans: n. 交往, 交流；[医] 交际, 往来
example: Their respectability was as dear to her as her own, and a daily intercourse had become precious by habit.
她就像珍惜自己的体面那样珍惜他们的体面，珍惜同他们已经形成惯例的一天一次交往。

entries.trans: n. 兴趣, 嗜好, 利息, 利益, 爱好, 趣味, 势力；vt. 使感兴趣, 与...有关系
example: To do the same thing to sb as they have done to you, but with more force, enthusiasm, etc.
He thought it remarkable that self-interest often promoted the common good, but he never claimed it always did.

entries.trans: n. 分界面, 接触面, 界面；[计] 接口, 界面
example: A GUI provides an easy to use interface for the novice while the command line API is often preferred by the advanced user.
GUI为新手提供容易使用的界面，而高级用户往往更喜欢命令行API。

entries.trans: vi. 妨碍, 冲突, 干涉, 抵触；[医] 干扰, 干涉, 阻碍, 碰腿(马)
example: He also proposed that Congress declare that it had no power to interfere with the slave trade between states.
他还建议，国会应该宣布，它无权干涉州与州之间的奴隶贸易。

entries.trans: n. 冲突, 干涉；[计] 干扰
example: I need you to run interference while I go for the best bargains and to hold all of the bags and packages while I shop. What else?
在我去最大折扣商店血拼时，我需要你帮我抢货。还有帮我拎所有的包和袋子。还有什么？

entries.trans: a. 暂时的, 临时的, 间歇的；n. 过渡时期
example: The board also discussed the company's internal operations under interim Chief Executive Tim Morse, people familiar with the matter said.
据知情人士说，董事会还就公司在临时CEO莫尔斯（TimMorse）领导下的内部运营进行了讨论。

entries.trans: n. 内部, 内政；a. 内部的, 心灵的, 内地的, 内政的
example: FOR power stations on the coast of China, it is often cheaper to import coal by sea from Indonesia than from mines in the interior.
对于中国沿海的发电站来说，从印度尼西亚由海路进口煤炭往往比从内地煤矿运购更划算。

entries.trans: n. 中间物, 调停者, 中级；a. 中间的, 中级的；vi. 起媒介作用；[计] 中级
example: Wherein the intermediate reactor feedstock comprises at least one of a fatty acid and a fatty acid ester.
其中中间反应器原料包含脂肪酸和脂肪酸酯中的至少一种。

entries.trans: a. 间歇的, 断断续续的；[化] 间歇的; 间断的
example: But the intermittent nature of wind power can cause just that sort of variability.
Without this tenacity, this aggression, he would be another intermittent flash of light in a wide area.

entries.trans: n. 实习生, 被拘留者；vi. 作实习医师(教师、实习生)；vt. 拘留, 扣留
example: Monica Lewinsky was a 21-year-old White House intern who delivered pizza to President Clinton, then flirted with him and flashed her thong.
莫妮卡·莱温斯基是一个21岁的白宫实习生，她的工作就是给克林顿总统送比萨饼，然后用她的丁字裤挑逗了他。

entries.trans: a. 内在的, 国内的；[医] 内的, 内部的
example: The internal coaching resource is often stretched owing to lack of trained personnel.
由于缺乏合格的培训人员，内部辅导与培训资源通常会使用过度。

entries.trans: a. 国际的；n. 国别设定；[计] 国别设定
example: GOVERNMENT crises in the Netherlands tend to be played out with little international publicity.
在荷兰，政府危机倾向于做很少的国际宣传。

entries.trans: [计] 因特网, 国际互连网, 网际网络, 互连网络, 广域网
example: He said the city network to the Internet to see, thank you, if you are the one.
就说在同城网网上看到的，谢谢，非诚勿扰。

entries.trans: vt. 解释, 演出, 翻译, 理解；vi. 翻译, 解释
example: We can interpret that the daughter is still not a mother and that the mother(ness) is still one essential source for her, like memory.
只是此刻的说话人似乎还不是一个母亲，因此母亲-母性依然是她一个最根本的源泉，这犹如记忆一样。

entries.trans: n. 解释, 演出, 翻译；[计] 插值; 插值法; 解释
example: The interpretation of facts is often colored by prejudices.
With such a brilliant interpretation and emotions, Sungha no doubt has what it takes to be one of the best guitarists.

entries.trans: n. 直译程序, 解释者, 口译者, 注释器；[计] 注释器
example: In the beginning he said he was not an interpreter of Krishnamurti's teaching but he became one right after that.
在开头他说，他不是克的教诲的解释者，但后面的话证明，他其实是。

entries.trans: vt. 中断, 妨碍, 插嘴；vi. 打断；n. 中断；[计] 中断
example: Since you have already set the (simulated) register values appropriately, the ISR will process normally as if it was a real interrupt.
由于已经正确设置了（模拟）寄存器的值，ISR会正常进行处理，就仿佛它是一个真正的中断。

entries.trans: n. 打扰, 中断, 障碍物；[医] 间断, 阻断, 中止
example: There, shut into her own room as soon as their visitor left them, she could think without interruption of all that she had heard.
客人一走，她就回到自己房里闭门独坐，把刚才所听来的一番话仔细思量。

entries.trans: n. 交集, 十字路口, 交叉点；[计] 逻辑乘; 与
example: However, the trees at the top right are situated close to the intersection of the image, along with the large boulder on the bottom left.
不过，右上方树木的位置就在一个直线的交叉点附近，左下侧巨石也同样如此。

entries.trans: n. 间隔, 距离, 间歇, 间隙；[计] 时间间隔
example: Event count must be at least two when a time interval is specified.
To render the dark scene close to what I saw I took 7 consecutive 15-second exposures in under 2 minutes interval.

entries.trans: vi. 插入, 调停, 干涉；[经] 进场干预
example: But we need to ask more questions, screen more college students, and intervene more definitively when danger seems a real possibility.
但是我们要问更多的问题，选拔更多的大学生，当危险极可能将要到来时作出更具决定性的干预。

entries.trans: n. 插入, 介入, 调停；[经] 干预
n. 面谈, 访问, 接见, 面试；vt. 接见, 对...进行面谈(试)
example: We've got to be much blunter about out plans for public spending,  Byrne said in an interview with the Times newspaper.
Byrne在接受英国泰晤士报采访时表示，“我们必须在公共支出计划上更加坦率。”

entries.trans: a. 亲密的, 私人的, 秘密的；vt. 暗示, 通知, 告诉；n. 至交
example: A woman from Wisconsin wrote to me recently to say that she effortlessly shares intimate feelings with her friends.
最近，一位来自威斯康星州的女性写信给我，说她可以轻易地和朋友分享内心的感受。

entries.trans: vt. 威胁, 恐吓；[法] 恐吓, 威胁, 使恐惧
example: We object to any effort to intimidate US corporations or those of any nation engaged in legitimate economic activity.
美方极力反对任何威胁美国公司或他国企业在该地区从事合法经济活动的行为。

entries.trans: n. 朗诵, 语调, 唱；[化] 声调
example: Like other languages, English has a system of sounds, stress, and intonation that gives it a rhythm and melody all its own.
英语像其它语言一样，有它自己的一套由声音、重音和语调系统形成的英语独有的节奏和旋律。

entries.trans: n. 纷乱, 复杂, 错综
example: Geronimo is one of the more complex projects undertaken by the open source community, comparable to Linux in its intricacy.
与Linux相比，Geronimo是由开放源码社区开发的比较复杂的项目之一。

entries.trans: a. 复杂的, 错综的, 缠结的, 难懂的
example: Compared with other cultures, members of a civilization are organized into a diverse division of labor and an intricate social hierarchy.
和其他文化相比，文明的成员被组织成为不同的劳动类别和错综的社会层次。

entries.trans: n. 阴谋, 复杂的事；vi. 密谋, 私通；vt. 激起...的兴趣, 用诡计取得
example: Adding to the intrigue, it appears the handwriting in the body of the letter differs from that of Mr. Ho's signature.
更让人好奇的是，似乎这封信正文里的手迹与何鸿燊的签名笔迹不太一样。

entries.trans: a. 吸引人的, 有趣的
example: A simple reprisal of that character would make an intriguing turn as the disgusting pimp who controls Iris and clashes with Travis.
作为控制Iris并与Travis冲突的讨厌的皮条客，该角色的一次简单报复行动就能成就一次引人入胜的转折。

entries.trans: a. 本质的, 原有的, 真正的；[医] 内部的, 内在的
example: He did not want to claim social superiority, he would not claim intrinsic personal superiority.
他不想炫耀优越的社会地位，他也不会炫耀他个人出众的内在力量。

entries.trans: vt. 介绍, 引入, 采用, 输入；[法] 引进, 输入, 介绍
example: Otherwise, you might accidentally introduce a bug that only shows up in the Release version of your program.
否则，可能会意外地引入一个只在程序的发布版本中出现的bug。

entries.trans: n. 介绍, 传入, 采用, 初步
example: He made the self-introduction and everyone shook hands with him.
Please be aware that this is only a selection of essential requirements of the organic standards, meant as an introduction.

entries.trans: n. 直觉, 直觉的知识
example: The study found that how much we trust our intuition is influenced by what is physically happening in our bodies.
研究发现我们在多大程度上相信我们的直觉，是受我们身体的生理反应所影响的。

entries.trans: vt. 侵入, 拥入, 侵略, 侵袭；[法] 强入, 侵犯, 侵略
example: After a week or two, they invade red blood cells and reproduce thousands of times.
两个星期后，它们侵入红细胞并繁殖成千上百倍。

entries.trans: n. 病人, 残废者；a. 有病的, 无效的
example: Invalid data has been used to update the list item. The field you are trying to update may be read only.
用于更新此列表项的数据无效，您试图更新的域可能只读。

entries.trans: a. 无价的, 价值无法衡量的
example: I find the opportunity to ask questions of a knowledgeable instructor and hearing the class discussion invaluable.
我认为，向知识渊博的教师请教问题并聆听课堂讨论，这样的机会是非常宝贵的。

entries.trans: adv. 不变化地, 恒定地, 始终如一地
example: A propensity to be saucy was one; and a perverse will, that indulged children invariably acquire, whether they be good-tempered or cross.
莽撞的性子是一个；还有倔强的意志，这是被娇惯的孩子们一定有的，不论他们脾气好坏。

entries.trans: n. 侵犯, 侵入, 侵害；[医] 侵袭, 侵入, 发病
example: The matter was debated further over the next few years, with all talks of invasion stalled by the Warden Khans.
接下来的几年一直在辩论，所有有关入侵的对话都被守望者派可汗停止了。

entries.trans: vt. 发明, 创作, 虚构；[机] 发明
example: It would make sense to take advantage of this expertise instead of trying to re-invent it.
所以，利用这些专家经验，而不是设法重新创建一个是有道理的。

entries.trans: n. 发明, 创作能力, 虚构的故事；[经] 发明
example: In the past two years, millions of Americans have suddenly embraced the bicycle as if it were a starling new invention.
在过去的两年中，数以百万计的美国人都突然拥抱自行车仿佛那是一个斯塔林新的发明。

entries.trans: n. 发明家；[法] 发明人, 发明家, 创造者
example: Had the French inventor tried to model his plane on every detail of a bird's wing, he would not have succeeded in flying it.
要是那个法国发明家力图模仿鸟翼的每个细节来造他的飞机的话，他就不会使它飞起来。（虚拟条件）

entries.trans: n. 详细目录, 存货清单；vt. 列入详细目录, 清点存货；[计] 存货清单
example: I think we are going to see a modest increase in inventory over the coming months but still not enough to greatly effect market conditions.
我认为在未来几个月里，房地产的库存总量会略微上升，但这还不足以太太地影响市场状况。

entries.trans: a. 倒转的, 相反的；n. 反向, 反面；[计] 反白, 反色
example: Yet the strength of people's conviction is often in inverse proportion to the amount of robust factual evidence they have.
然而人们的坚信程度，却往往和他们拥有的事实证据成反比。

entries.trans: adv. 相反地；[机] 反的, 反对
example: Parkinson's Law of Meetings: The time spent in a meeting on an item is inversely proportional to its value (up to a limit).
帕金森会议定律：花在一个会议上的时间与这个会议的价值成反比。

entries.trans: a. 转化的；vt. 使反转, 使颠倒, 使转化；n. 颠倒的事物；[计] 倒置; 反转
example: There is also a possibility not to invert part of the sentence. As you treat me, so I shall treat you.
The T wave showed invert in inferior and anterior leads after episode that easy to be diagnosed as ischemia.

entries.trans: vt. 投资, 花费, 笼罩, 授予；vi. 投资, 利用
example: There he discovered it was more lucrative to invest the money he controlled directly than to take fees on transactions for others.
保尔森在贝尔斯登时发现，把自己所管理的资金拿来直接投资，要比收取其他人的交易费用更加赚钱。

entries.trans: v. 调查, 审查
example: He says he is confident about his own integrity, and hopes the judicial system will quickly investigate the matter.
他也强调对自己的操守有信心，希望司法尽快侦办。

entries.trans: n. 调查, 审查；[医] 调查, 调查研究
example: Mr. Obama may fear an investigation could inflame the kind of partisan divisions he has said he wants to avoid.
奥巴马可能担心，调查会进一步引发党派分歧，而他自己一直表示希望避免这种党派纷争。

entries.trans: n. 投资；[医] 包埋料, 围模料, 包埋法, 围模法
example: Tone down and put some of that hard earned cash into a safe, long-term investment.
把辛苦挣来的钱用到一个安全的长期的投资。

entries.trans: a. 看不见的, 无形的；[经] 无形的, 表面上看不见的, 未列在公开帐目的
example: Queen Clarisse my expectation in life is to be invisible and I'm good at it.
女王克拉利瑟我期望在生活中是看不见的，我很擅长。

entries.trans: n. 邀请, 请柬, 引诱；[经] 邀请, 招待, 吸引
example: When he joined some chat forums, sometimes people wanted to meet him: but he never accepted the invitation.
他在论坛上和别人聊天，有时候，有聊得来的人想见他，但他从未接受。

entries.trans: vt. 邀请, 请求, 引起, 招致；n. 邀请
example: It is daring of Mr Kelly to invite such a direct comparison of his theories to the ramblings of a madman.
凯利竟胆敢将自己的理论直接比作一个疯子的乱七八糟的布局。

entries.trans: n. 发票, 发货单；v. 开发票, 记清单
example: If it is exporting project, proforma invoice, custom declaration and inspection declaration files must be prepared about this time.
如果是出口项目的活还需准备形式发票、报关和报检方面的文件资料。

entries.trans: vt. 包括, 使陷于, 潜心于, 包围；[医] 累及, 牵涉, 包含
example: They served as Azmodan's hands, performing acts that he would not, could not involve himself in.
他们为罪恶之王阿兹莫丹效忠，为他做他所不能将自己置身其中的事情。

entries.trans: a. 内心的, 向内的, 本来的；[医] 向内的
example: She bit her lips; she seemed to hesitate, as though a prey to some sort of inward conflict.
她咬着自己的嘴唇，似乎拿不定主意，内心在作斗争。

entries.trans: n. 离子；[化] 离子
example: It has developed lithium-ion batteries that are unusually cheap and easy to make.
它研发的锂离子电池（注），不但非常便宜而且易于生产；

entries.trans: n. 铁, 熨斗, 铁器, 坚强, 烙铁, 镣铐；vt. 烫平, 熨, 用铁包；vi. 烫平
example: He saved his mother and other lions and became king of his tribe . He is a lion of great determination and iron will. He is a really Hero!
他拯救了他的母亲和整个狮群，成为了部族的王。他是一只有着坚定决心和钢铁意志的狮子。他是真正的英雄！

entries.trans: adv. 冷嘲地, 挖苦地, 讽刺地, 令人啼笑皆非地
example: It plods along sweetly and could be the sort of track that you might bop, albeit ironically, to at an indie disco.
它带着种甜蜜的吟唱，就好象你置身于独立音乐的迪斯科舞池中，这听上去似乎有点扯。

entries.trans: n. 反语, 讽刺, 具有讽刺意味的事
example: These times make it especially necessary to be in touch with the absurdity, the ridiculous, the funniness, and the irony of the everyday.
这些时候使得与日常的荒谬、好笑、滑稽和讽刺相联系特别有必要。

entries.trans: n. 不规则物, 不合规格之物；a. 不规则的, 不整齐的, 不合法的
example: The oil-water contact is not always a flat horizontal surface, but instead might be tilted or irregular.
油-水界面并不总是一个平坦的水平面，而可能代之以倾斜的或不规则的界面。

entries.trans: n. 不规则, 例外, 违反规则的行为；[化] 不匀度
example: This will enable us to inform you of any irregularity with a flight on which you are booked.
如果您预订的航班有任何异常，这将使我们能够通知您此情况。

entries.trans: a. 不顾的, 无关的, 没关系的
example: Do not ever go below your standard for a mate irrespective of your age, peer pressure, societal pressure or even family pressure.
尽管你的年龄，同辈的压力，社会压力甚至家庭压力，都不要因为这些而降低你对配偶的标准。

entries.trans: n. 灌溉, 冲洗；[医] 冲洗法, 灌溉
example: Simply putting farmers in control of the irrigation network, and allowing them to decide how much water they needed, cut consumption by 30%.
然而，仅是让农民控制灌溉网，使他们自己决定所需水量，就能减少30%的耗水量。

entries.trans: vt. 激怒, 使发怒, 使兴奋, 使发炎；vi. 引起不快
example: Precautions: Do not breath the dust particles as it will irritate the throat, nose, lungs, eyes and skin.
注意事项：不要吸进灰尘，因为它会刺激咽喉，鼻子，肺部，眼睛和皮肤。

entries.trans: n. 伊斯兰教
example: Moses, Jesus and Muhammad are the descendents of Abraham, making the followers of Judaism, Christianity and Islam "cousins, " he said.
他说，摩西、耶稣和穆罕默德都是亚伯拉罕的子孙，因此犹太教、基督教和伊斯兰教信徒都是“表兄弟”。

entries.trans: n. 岛, 岛屿, 孤立地区, 安全岛；vt. 使成岛状, 孤立
example: It's not known at this point whether Ryanair, famed for flying to out-of-town airports, plans on opening up a route to the new-born island.
此时此刻，不知道以飞外地小型机场闻名的爱尔兰瑞安航空是否计划在新出现的小岛上开设一条航线。

entries.trans: vt. 使隔离, 使孤立, 使绝缘；n. 隔离种群
example: Are these factors, which create a demand or lack of demand, for a particular currency easy to identify or isolate?
对某一特定货币来说，影响其供求大小的因素是否很容易单独挑选出来？

entries.trans: n. 发行, 问题, 后果, 流出, 出口, 争端；vi. 发行, 流出, 造成...结果, 传下；vt. 使流出, 放出, 发行, 发布, 发给
example: It's the magazine's art issue, and art shouldn't provide an easy answer. But at least it makes you think.
杂志在搞艺术，艺术没有简单答案，但至少它让你想到了什么。

entries.trans: n. 意大利人, 意大利语；a. 意大利的, 意大利语的
example: I grew up in a large Italian family, and as the youngest of five, I was always part of a team.
我成长于一个意大利大家庭，是五个孩子中最小的那个，从小就是孩子团的一员。

entries.trans: n. 项目, 条款, 一则, 项；[计] 项
example: As the item falls within the scope of our business, we shall be pleased to enter into direct business relations with you.
由于该商品属于我们的业务范围，我们将很高兴地与贵方直接建立业务关系。

entries.trans: n. 象牙, 乳白色；a. 象牙制的, 乳白色的
n. 插座, 千斤顶, 男人；vt. 抬起, 提醒, 扛举, 增加, 提高, 放弃；a. 雄的；[计] 插座
example: 15, the men adjourn to smoke cigars and discuss business, but Jack declines. On his way out of the dining room, he slips Rose a note.
绅士们退到另一间房间吸烟，或者讨论经济大事。杰克没有参加。离开餐厅时，他塞给露丝一张纸条。

entries.trans: n. 夹克, 外套, 护套；vt. 给...穿夹克, 给...装护套
example: Future aviators will love to be wrapped up in this jacket while they daydream of one day being a pilot in the sky.
未来的飞行员将爱情被包裹在这件夹克，而他们遐想有一天，天空中的一个试点。

entries.trans: n. 监牢, 监狱, 拘留所；vt. 监禁, 下狱
example: A convict broke out of jail in Washington DC, then a few days later accompanied his girlfriend to her trial for robbery.
华盛顿一家监狱的一名犯人越狱，几天后他女朋友上庭受审，他陪着一起去了。

entries.trans: n. 果酱, 拥塞之物, 堵塞, 困境；vt. 挤进, 使塞满, 混杂, 压碎, 使堵塞；vi. 堵塞, 轧住, 拥挤
n. 广口瓶, 震动, 刺耳声；vi. 震惊, 冲突, 发刺耳声, 不一致；vt. 震动, 刺激
example: A teacup, a grenade, a pair of glasses, a frozen pig's tail and a peanut butter jar have all been removed from the male rectum by doctors.
一只茶杯，一个手榴弹，一副眼镜，一条冷冻猪尾巴还有一罐花生酱都曾被医生从男性直肠内取出过。

entries.trans: n. 颚, 颌；v. 闲谈, 教训, 唠叨
example: Takeru "Tsunami" Kobayashi said he can only open his mouth to make a gap the size of a fingertip after being diagnosed with jaw arthritis.
日本大胃王表示呢，现在他的下巴被诊断患有严重的关节炎，现在嘴只能打开指尖那么大。

entries.trans: n. 爵士乐, 喧闹；a. 爵士乐的, 喧吵的；vi. 演奏爵士乐, 跳爵士舞, 游荡；vt. 奏爵士乐, 使活泼
example: Opera, orchestral performances, chamber music, jazz concert is often shown on television. Most watch TV at home for leisure.
歌剧，管弦乐队的表现，室内乐和爵士乐音乐会在电视上经常被提出，如此大多数休闲为看电视在家使用。

entries.trans: a. 嫉妒的, 羡慕的, 留心的, 戒备的
example: I also think she was jealous of the fact that Marguerite had so much more courage than herself and someone truly loved her.
我也认为她也对玛格丽特有这么大的勇气以及有人真正的爱玛格丽特而深表嫉妒。

entries.trans: n. 妒忌, 猜忌, 羡慕；[法] 妒忌, 嫉妒, 猜忌
example: Sometimes it takes a little extra effort to push a great idea through the cloud of politics and jealousy into the light for everyone to see.
有时候，您只需付出一点额外的努力，去拨开那些嫉妒和政治偏见的乌云，将您伟大的思想呈现在人人都能看见的阳光之下。

entries.trans: n. 牛仔裤, 牛仔布, 斜纹棉布
example: In this peaceful street where he had taken refuge, Jean Valjean got rid of all that had been troubling him for some time past.
冉阿让躲在这条僻静的街巷中，渐渐摆脱了近来使他惶惑不安的种种苦恼。

entries.trans: n. 工装裤, 牛仔裤
example: You've got to know how to wear skinny jeans and a skinny jacket, and then put a bow tie with it.
你必须认真对待领结，你必须知道如何穿紧身牛仔裤和紧身夹克，然后用领结与之搭配。

entries.trans: n. 果冻, 果冻甜食, 胶状物；v. (使)结冻, (使)成胶状
example: When the food arrived, it came in a bowl and was a cold, dark brown liquid with a consistency somewhere between soup and jelly.
食物端上来了，是装在碗里的冰冷的棕色液体，浓度在汤和果冻之间。

entries.trans: vt. 危害, 使受危困, 使陷危地
example: There's a real danger that you will jeopardize your own relationship with the person you are trying to help.
你可能会破坏自己与这个你试图帮助的人之间的关系，这种危险是确实存在的。

entries.trans: n. 性情古怪的人, 急拉, 肌肉抽搐, 牛肉干；vi. 痉挛, 急拉, 急推；vt. 猛拉
example: Teacher: Hey! We're trying to do a little "Romeo and Juliet" here! We don't need no insensitive jerk, messing it up.
教练：现在是在朗读罗密欧与朱莉叶懂吗？不需要无动于衷的蠢货来煞风景！

entries.trans: n. 耶稣
example: I envied him for his faith and he told me if I just would believe in Jesus as my Savior, He would give me faith too.
我羡慕他的信，他告诉我若我相信耶稣是我的救主，他也会叫我信。

entries.trans: n. 喷射流, 喷嘴, 煤玉；v. 射出, 迸出, 喷射；a. 黑而发亮的, 墨黑的
example: Brazilian officials said the debris including metal fragments , plane seats as well as the jet fuel slick.
巴西官员称：残骸包括金属碎片，飞机座位和漏的燃油。

entries.trans: n. 珠宝, 贵重物, 镶珠宝的饰物；vt. 饰以珠宝, 镶以宝石
example: Tom got out his chiefest jewel, a brass knob from the top of an andiron, and passed it around her so that she could see it, and said.
74汤姆把他最珍贵的宝贝，一个壁炉柴架顶上的铜把手，拿出来从她背后绕过去给她看，说。

entries.trans: n. 宝石, 贵重饰物, 珠宝, 宝石饰物, 受珍视的人/物, 宝贝, 有价值的人/物
example: Jewellery in a retail environment is locked up in a glass case,  says Jessica Herrin, the company's chief executive and founder.
“零售的首饰通常放在玻璃橱窗内，”公司CEO兼创始人杰西卡•赫林（JessicaHerrin）说。

entries.trans: a. 犹太人的, 犹太族的
n. 叮当声；v. (使)作叮当声, (使)押韵
example: Do not let your bracelets jingle when, lamp in hand , you lead him in .
如果你提着灯引他进门时，不要让你的手躅叮当作响。

entries.trans: n. 轻推, 轻撞, 慢跑；v. 轻推, (使)蹒跚行进, (使)慢跑
example: Middle-aged folks work out in gyms and jog down the street, trying to delay the effects of age.
而中年人则在体育馆里锻炼，在马路上慢跑，尽量不让岁月过早地留下痕迹。

entries.trans: n. 连接处, 接合, 关节；a. 共同的, 联合的, 连接的, 合办的；vt. 连接, 接合, 使有接头；vi. 贴合, 长节
example: And, usually you won't know if this joint is weak until the piece is done and has been used for a while.
并且，在完成胶结并使用一段时间之后你才能发现这个节点的胶不牢固。

entries.trans: n. 笑话, 玩笑, 笑柄；v. 开玩笑, 取笑, 作弄
example: In a society that celebrates spending and credit, this behavior is usually looked upon as a joke rather than a serious problem.
在一个秀支出和信贷的社会里，这种行为常被看成一个笑话，而不是一个严重的问题。

entries.trans: a. 愉快的, 高兴的, 宜人的；vt. 恭维, 使高兴, 取笑；vi. 开玩笑；adv. 非常, 极为
example: ''Tis no use for you to be in love with him any more than me, Retty Priddle, ' said jolly-faced Marian, the eldest, silly.
“你跟我一样，爱他是没有用的，莱蒂·普里德尔，”说话的人名叫玛丽安，年纪最大，长着一张快活脸。

entries.trans: n. 日记, 杂志, 日报；[化] 轴颈
example: If you're heading towards any sort of long-term goal, a simple journal can be a very powerful tool.
如果你正朝向一个长期目标前进，那么一本简单的日记就是一个非常有效的工具。

entries.trans: n. 新闻记者, 从事新闻杂志业的人
example: But a journalist with People's Daily said the new ambassador will understand "the tradition and way of Chinese dealing with issues. "
《人民日报》的一位记者说，骆家辉会理解中国传统以及中国处理问题的方式。

entries.trans: n. 旅程, 旅行, 行程；vi. 旅行；vt. 游历
example: Our journey to the sky is as a fiction. But real-life scientists in real-life laboratories are working to make it a reality.
我们到天上的旅行只是一种假设，但是在现实实验室里的现实科学家正在研究使其变为现实。

entries.trans: n. 欢喜, 乐事, 高兴；vt. 使快乐, 令人高兴；vi. 欢喜
example: All the grief always leaves a joy to a clue, all sorry they leave a place in the corner of the perfect.
所有的悲伤总会留下一丝欢乐的线索，所有的遗憾总会留下一处完美的角落。

entries.trans: a. 欢喜的, 高兴的, 令人高兴的
example: Why does he want me to be full of joy? It's a great advertisement for Jesus Christ. Joyful Christians are a positive testimony.
神为什么要我们充满快乐呢？这是一个为耶稣基督作的大广告。快乐的基督徒是主正面的好见证。

entries.trans: n. 法官, 裁判员, 审判官, 鉴定人；vt. 审理, 鉴定, 判断, 判决, 裁定；vi. 下判断, 作评价
example: Management who are so greedy that they judge investors exclusively on how much equity they receive often regret their choice.
管理层如果过于贪婪，只根据自己得到多少股权这一点来对投资者进行评判，事后往往会后悔莫及。

entries.trans: n. 审判, 判决, 判断；[经] 判定, 审定, 鉴定
example: It is not your own prudence or judgement that has enabled you to keep your place in the trade.
你能够在买卖上维持你的地位，并不是靠你的谨慎稳重或者深谋远虑。

entries.trans: n. 水壶, 监牢, 模仿夜莺的叫声；vt. 放入壶中, 炖, 关押；vi. 模仿夜莺叫
example: They made a dummy, dressed him in clothes, used a milk jug for the head, and put a hat on him.
他们给我做了个假人，给它穿上衣服，用牛奶瓶作头，还戴上了帽子。

entries.trans: n. 连接, 会合处, 交叉点；[医] 接[合]处, 接点.[接]界
example: Encounter of two fish at a junction, as if by magic, one day casual, they met several times.
两条鱼在某个路口相遇后，仿佛被施了魔法，一天不经意，就碰见好几次。

entries.trans: n. 丛林, 杂乱的一堆, 弱肉强食的地方
example: Back in the jungle, the lieutenant says he's received word that LRA fighters are heading his way.
回到丛林，中尉说他刚收到消息，圣灵抵抗军正朝他的方向行进。

entries.trans: n. 年少者, 地位较低者, 大学三年级学生；a. 年少的, 下级的, 后进的

谷神星结果只是众多绕着火星和木星的卫星中的一颗，而并非什么行星。

entries.trans: n. 正义, 公平, 公正, 正确, 司法, 审判

一司法部发言人表示，一切还没有最后拍板，但是，“在未来几天，应该会发布有关此事的声明”。

entries.trans: n. 辩护, 证明正当, 释罪；[计] 调整
example: If I seem to be surprising this evidence upon the court, I offer as my justification for this.
如果认为我是猛不提防地走向法庭上提出这个证据来的话，那我就说明理由，解释一下。

entries.trans: vt. 替...辩护, 证明；vi. 证明合法；[计] 段落重排, 两端对齐
example: Economists do not know enough about growth, he says, to justify their obsession with it, however important it may be.
经济学家对增长缺乏了解，这将使得他们无法证明为人笃定的随机实验，将有怎样的重要性。

entries.trans: a. 锋利的, 敏锐的, 强烈的, 敏捷的, 热心的, 渴望的；n. 挽歌, 痛哭；v. 唱挽歌, 痛哭
example: The best way is to pretend to see nothing, nothing to listen to understand, but also keen to help her find a "spinach" to receive points.
最好的办法就是假装什么都没看见，什么都没听明白，还要热心地帮她找“菠菜”接收点。

entries.trans: n. 监护人, 管理人, 看守人；[机] 保管人, 看守人, 保持片
example: Inspiring pool and a keeper as I will open it up again to let people play if they feel up to it after I announced the winners.
在获奖名单宣布之后，如果大家青睐这些招贴画，我将以管理员的身份再次打开图库，以供大家赏玩。

entries.trans: n. 核心, 中心, 精髓, 内核；[计] 内核
example: Debugging high-level code often requires you to understand the system calls and kernel behavior of your operating system, too.
调试上层代码同样需要你理解系统调用和操作系统的内核特性。

entries.trans: n. 茶壶, 罐；[化] 釜体釜; 锅
example: As soon as his mother opened the door he said, ``Is the kettle boiling? ''
老母亲一开门，他就急忙问：“水烧好了吗？”

entries.trans: n. 键盘；[计] 键盘
example: With just a few clicks on your keyboard, you can find business opportunities that won't break the bank.
只要在你的键盘上面按几下，你就可以发现经商的机会，而又不需要耗费你很多的钱。

entries.trans: n. 踢, 反冲, 后座力, 凹底；vi. 踢, 反抗, 反冲；vt. 踢, 反冲
example: To continue to hurt sb when they are already defeated, etc.
If you are on offense, then put the ball back in the basket or kick it out to another player.

entries.trans: n. 小山羊, 小山羊肉, 小孩, 欺骗；a. 小山羊皮制的；v. 哄骗, 嘲弄
example: A few silent seconds passed. "We'll shop around a bit more, " he said, dragging the kid with him. I watched him all the way out the door.
几秒钟的沉默过后，“我们再逛逛看。”父亲边说边拽着孩子离开。我看到他们头也不回地走出了门。

entries.trans: vt. 绑架, 诱拐, 拐骗；[法] 拐带, 诱拐, 绑架

她又提到璃茉被绑架，父母一定很痛心一个如此漂亮的孩子被绑架。

entries.trans: n. 肾, 个性；[医] 肾
example: At seventeen, Snoopy had a bit of a heart condition and some kidney problems, and the family worried about her.
斯努皮已经17岁了，心脏不太好，肾也有些问题，因而托普斯全家都为它担心。

entries.trans: n. 杀, 杀戮, 小河；vt. 杀, 破坏, 消灭, 使终止, 抵消, 否决；vi. 杀死；[计] 删除
example: To destroy sth that would make you rich, successful, etc.
Could it be that this experiment in imitation, this experiment in a second replicator, is dangerous enough to kill people off?

entries.trans: n. 千克, 公斤；[医] 千克, 公斤
example: Lobster prices in Australia have fallen by half to less than A$25 a kilogram from A$50 since the trade row began, he said.
特雷罗根说，自从贸易纠纷出现以来，澳大利亚国内的龙虾价格已下降一半，从每公斤50澳元降至不到25澳元。

entries.trans: n. 千米, 公里；[医] 千米, 公里
example: Then, we circled an inlet and, after a while, saw a little house. This place was in a kilometer-and-a-half from the enemy strongholds.
在绕过了一个水湾后我们找到一个小房子，这里距离敌人据点大约有1.5公里的样子。

entries.trans: n. 千瓦；[医] 千瓦[特]
example: It's not as simple as using less salt or sugar as though you were cutting down on your kilowatt hours.
但是健康饮食和电费单不同，这不仅仅是像减少千瓦时用电一样食用更少的盐或糖那么简单。

entries.trans: n. 亲戚, 同族, 血缘关系, 家族；a. 有亲属关系的, 性质类似的, 同类的

但他没有宣布任何近亲或关系在他的所有正式文件，包括他的银行存款的文件。

entries.trans: vt. 点燃, 使着火, 引起, 照亮；vi. 着火, 激动, 发亮
example: Should Amazon join forces with Google and develop an Android Kindle, or should the company stick to its own platform?
是否亚马逊应该加入谷歌Android的大军，开发基于Android平台的Kindle，还是应该坚持自己的平台呢？

entries.trans: n. 仁慈, 亲切, 和蔼
example: However big tiger seems to be, remember that he wants as much kindness as roo.
无论跳跳虎看上去多复杂，请记住他需要的关切和小豆一样多。

entries.trans: a. 运动的, 运动引起的, 动力学的, 活动的；[医] 运动的, 动的, 动力的

entries.trans: n. 国王, 君主；vt. 使...成为君主；vi. 君临, 统治
example: And King Solomon gave to the queen of Sheba all that she desired, whatever she asked besides what she had brought to the king.
所罗门王按示巴女王所带来的，还他礼物，另外照他一切所要所求的，都送给他。

entries.trans: n. 王国, 领域；[医] 界(动物,植物,矿物)
example: Their teardrops fall on my hand, as if I were leaving them for a long journey to the kingdom of death.
他们便都把眼泪滴到我手上，好像觉得我就要长远的离开他们而走向死之国一样。

entries.trans: n. 吻；vt. 吻；vi. 接吻
example: But when she found herself wondering what it would be like to kiss a guy who chewed tobacco she began to think she was fooling herself.
但是，当她发现自己总在琢磨跟一个爱嚼烟草的人接吻会是什么感觉时，才明白自己以前的感觉只不过是自欺欺人罢了。

entries.trans: n. 装备, 工具箱, 成套工具；[计] 成套部件; 成套零件

我想购买此油冷却器套件3套。多少将总成本是+传送到新加坡吗？任何折扣？

entries.trans: n. 风筝, 筝帆, 空头支票, 骗子；vi. 象风筝一样飞, 轻快地移动, 使用空头支票；vt. 使上升, 骗钱
example: As for a kite unable to fly, even if it's beautiful, there's always a little loneliness and pity which can't be wiped away from its heart.
无法飞翔的风筝纵然美丽，却总有那么一丝挥之不去的落寞和遗憾。

entries.trans: n. 膝, 膝盖；vt. 膝行, 用膝盖碰

检举人同时也确认了AMD对潘尼的所为并不知情，从中也没有任何获益。

entries.trans: n. 实验室, 研究室；[医] 凝乳酶

我担任实验室助理，而我的老板有点像个暴君。

entries.trans: n. 标签, 称号, 商标, 标志；vt. 贴标签于, 标注；[计] 标志; 标注; DOS外部命令:用于建立改变或删除磁盘卷标号
example: I don't like to label my experiences but I can freely say that I'm in a loving relationship with a guy whose only goal is to make me happy.
我不喜欢给我的经历贴上什么标签，但是我可以坦率的说我和唯一目标就是让我快乐的人相爱。

entries.trans: n. 实验室, 研究室, 化工厂；[医] 实验室, 检验室, 化验室

这是近期以色列一个游戏室（同时也充当社会科学实验室）里进行的一次实验的基本方案。

entries.trans: n. 劳动, 努力, 工作, 劳工, 分娩；vi. 劳动, 努力, 苦干；vt. 详细分析, 使厌烦

entries.trans: n. 悲叹, 哀悼

我们再一次看到了凯尔特最佳奖杯是一个敌人，甚至悔恨值得赞扬和头部。

外核加热地幔底部岩石，使其变成具有浮力的灰泥，灰泥涌向地壳上方。

“我曾问我们的房东要一品脱‘难以置信这竟然不是水’，然后这句话就在酒吧里传开了，直至千家万户。”他说。

酒店工作人员告诉你从“地下铁茶餐厅”步行至这里不到5分钟，但是请你做好心理准备，抄小巷也至少要10分钟。

entries.trans: n. 灯笼, 提灯, 航标灯；vt. 装上提灯

这个挖掘的洞很深，也很暗，导致我需要一盏灯才能看清结构层。

entries.trans: n. 膝盖, 舔, 一圈, 下摆, 衣兜, 山坳；vi. 重叠, 围住, 轻拍, 舔；vt. 包围, 抱...在膝上, 使重叠, 舔, 拍打, 泼溅；[计] 链接访问程序

有人断言说这种高能效在很大程度上是重工业发展突然减速的结果，只是暂时性的。
