example: The only hint of menace was the number of people wearing face masks. But that was to keep off flu, not to resemble the Arab street.
唯一的威胁感来自若干带口罩的民众，但他们只是为了防流感，并不是仿效阿拉伯世界的街头起义。

entries.trans: a. 心智的, 精神病的, 心理的, 颏的；n. 精神病患者
example: Some courses have no prerequisites, like "The Science of Happiness, " which focuses on college student mental health and wellness.
有一些课程是不需要任何基础的，像“幸福的学问”，这门课主要聚焦大学生的身心健康。

entries.trans: n. 商品, 货物；v. 交易, 买卖
example: It never occurred to me that the best way to escape the lure of mountains of Chinese-made merchandise would be moving to China.
我从未想到过的是，避免被排山倒海般中国制造产品所诱惑的最好办法竟然是搬到中国来。

entries.trans: n. 商人, 店主；a. 商业的, 商人的
example: The original contract the Pilgrims had with their merchant-sponsors in London called for everything they produced to go into a common store.
在清教徒们同伦敦的赞助商贩最初签订的合同里，要求他们把所有生产的物品都放进公共商店里。

entries.trans: a. 仁慈的, 慈悲的
example: Merciful and gracious God has given us so much hope. Have we received them all? How much have we done for this hope?
满有恩慈的神，给了我们那麽多的盼望，你我能否全数得著？为这个期盼我们付出了多少？

entries.trans: n. 水银, 汞, 使者；[化] 汞Hg
example: In a time-lapse film, a Saguaro grove would seem to creep across the desertscape like a pool of mercury.
我们将画面定格到某一时间，会发现巨人柱树丛似乎蔓延至沙漠景观中，就像一池水银。

entries.trans: n. 仁慈, 宽恕, 慈悲, 怜悯, 幸运；[法] 权宜处置权, 决定权, 宽恕
example: She believed she was performing an "act of mercy" , but she also admitted knowing that what she did was against the law.
虽坚信此举“出于仁慈”，她也承认知道自己的所作所为触犯了法律。

entries.trans: n. 小湖, 池塘；a. 仅仅的, 只不过的
example: If this had been a mere financial crisis, it would be over by now.
如果这仅仅是一场金融危机，那么到现在就该已经结束了。

entries.trans: adv. 只
example: It merely reflects the light of the sun, like a huge mirror hung in the sky.
这表明月亮本身不发光，它只是反射太阳光，象悬挂在天空中的一面镜子。

entries.trans: vt. 使合并, 使消失, 吞没；vi. 合并, 渐渐消失；[计] 合并
example: TUI Travel is now planning to merge its French operations to create one brand in the hope that this will turn around its weakest unit.
途易旅游现在正计划把旗下的法国业务合并成一个品牌，希望以此来拯救那些经营惨淡的分支。

entries.trans: n. 优点, 功绩, 价值, 功过, 真相；vt. 值得；vi. 应受
example: Speaking in Moscow, Jeremy Huck, president of BP Russia, said the company believed the actions were "without merit" .
BP俄罗斯总裁杰里米•哈克（JeremyHuck）在莫斯科表示，该公司相信以上行动“毫无道理”。

entries.trans: a. 快乐的, 愉快的, 嬉戏作乐的
example: Laura and I wish every American family the blessings of this season, happy holidays, and a merry Christmas.
我和劳拉祝愿所有的美国家庭节日好运、假期愉快、圣诞快乐。

entries.trans: n. 网孔, 网丝, 网眼, 网状物, 圈套, 陷阱, 啮合；vt. 以网捕捉, 啮合, 使缠住；vi. 落网, 相啮合
example: The mesh should be removed at least once a year and thoroughly cleaned.
而且这种渗透网至少要每年更换一次并进行彻底的清洁。

entries.trans: n. 食堂, 伙食, 用膳, 一份食品, 混乱, 乱七八糟, 困境；vt. 将...弄糟, 妨碍, 使紊乱, 使就餐；vi. 陷入困境, 搞乱, 用膳
example: Grandma, what is wrong with me? There is nothing wrong with you. And don't call me Grandma. Oh, I'm such a mess.
外婆，我到底出什么问题了？你没有出问题还有，别叫我外婆噢，我真是一团糟。

entries.trans: n. 消息, 通讯, 讯息, 教训, 预言, 广告词；vt. 通知；vi. 通报, 报告, 报信；[计] 报文; 消息; 信息
example: He said the alliance also gave a message for their least popular member, Burma, officially known as Myanmar.
他说，东盟还对最不受欢迎的成员国--缅甸发出了信息。

entries.trans: n. 报信者, 使者；[经] 使者, 送信者, 通信员
example: So they decided to send a messenger to humans to ask for a little piece of it.
所以他们决定发送一个信使人的问经过很短的距离它的片。

entries.trans: a. 变化的, 变形的, 新陈代谢的；[医] [新陈]代谢的
example: Fresenius said the machine can deliver dialysis services to a variety of patients, regardless of the patient's size or metabolic needs.
费森尤斯说机器可以把实现透析服务给各种病人，不管病人的尺寸或变化的需要。

entries.trans: n. 金属, 金属制品, 合金, 本质, 质料；a. 金属制的；vt. 以金属覆盖
example: Mining executives say that metal consumers are trying to economise, using new alloys or moving into plastics whenever possible.
矿业高管表示，金属消费者正力求节约，尽可能采用新合金材料或改用塑料。

entries.trans: a. 金属的, 含金属的, 产生金属的；[经] 金属的
example: Methods: 15 cases of esophageal malignant stricture were treated with radiotherapy for a week followed by metallic stent implantation.
方法：15例食管恶性狭窄病人行镍钛合金记忆支架术，治疗前一周均行放疗。

entries.trans: n. 冶金学, 冶金术；[化] 冶金
example: The conventional formula cannot be used for designing the basin with a great amount of wastewater intake (e. g. metallurgy wastewater).
水量调节是水质调节的前提，对于冶金企业这类污水循环量大的系统，常规调节设计计算方法不能适应。

entries.trans: n. 陨星；[化] 陨石; 陨铁
example: Meteorite hunters are on the look-out for space rock in Ireland, after a fireball was spotted blazing across the sky on Wednesday night.
在周三晚上发现一个燃烧的火球横过天空中后，陨石猎人都在爱尔兰瞭望寻找太空石。

entries.trans: n. 方法, 办法, 条理, 秩序；[医] [方]法
example: The great decision I am talking about is method and curriculum. That seems to be the next step after deciding to teach your child at home.
这一伟大决定是有关家教的方法以及课程，这似乎是我决定自己在家教孩子以后的第二步计划。

entries.trans: n. 公尺, 格律, 韵律；[医] 米, 公尺
example: An Israeli military spokesman said the two-metre-high wall was no longer needed.
以色列军方一名发言人表示，现在已经不再需要这座两米高的水泥墙了。

entries.trans: a. 公尺的, 公制的, 计量的；[医] 测量的, 米制的, 公制的
example: The volume of Chinese ore imports has rapidly expanded and the price per metric ton is now about double the level of a year ago.
中国的铁矿石进口量迅速增长，目前每吨铁矿石的价格大约是一年前水平的两倍。

entries.trans: n. 大都市居民, 都主教, 宗主国的公民；a. 大都市的, 都主教区的, 宗主国的
example: He said that if he were in New York , he would visit the current exhibition at the Metropolitan Museum.
他说，如果他在纽约的话，他会去参观正在大都市博物馆举办的展览会。

entries.trans: n. 微电脑, 微机；[计] 微型计算机; 微计算机
example: The speed with which your microcomputer executes programs will vary linearly with the speed of your clock signal.
你的微型计算机执行程序的速度将与你的时钟信号的速度成线性关系。

entries.trans: n. 扩音器, 麦克风；[医] 扩音器, 传声器
example: International meetings began to sound like a pledge banquet with a pass-around microphone.
国际会议开始象在宴会上传送麦克风举杯祝酒那样发出了声音。

entries.trans: n. 微处理器；[计] 微处理器; 微处理机
example: State-of-the-art microprocessor technology charges batteries up to two times faster than conventional linear chargers.
州的最先进的微处理器技术，电池充电2倍速度比传统的线性充电器。

entries.trans: n. 显微镜；[化] 显微镜
example: Made of two tiny tin beads usually used to calibrate electron microscope lenses, the snowman was built by the National Physical Laboratory.
这个雪人由英国国家物理实验室制造，使用的材料是通常用来校准电子显微镜透镜的锡珠。

entries.trans: a. 显微镜的, 用显微镜可见的, 微观的, (非正式)极微小的, 细微的；[计] 微观的
n. 微波；[计] 微波
example: With microwave technology, microelement amino acid chelates can be rapidly synthesized, which has no pollution and low cost.
而利用微波技术，可以快速合成微量元素氨基酸螯合物，工艺简单、无污染、成本低。

entries.trans: n. 正午, 中午；a. 正午的
example: What I would like to see is a little headline on the midday or evening news on television to go over the phrases,  he said.
他说：“我希望能在午间或晚间的电视新闻中看到一条小标题，来温习这些习语。”

entries.trans: n. 午夜, 子夜, 半夜；a. 午夜的, 半夜的
example: She favours a midnight blue pinstriped suit paired with a fitted satin shirt and black patent heels for her professional life.
她喜欢将深蓝色细条纹西服，配上合身的丝绸衬衫和黑色漆皮高跟鞋作为其职业装。

entries.trans: n. 中间；prep. 在...中间
example: An important football game is often played in the midst of an immense ritual.
重大的橄榄球比赛常常在盛大的典礼中进行。

entries.trans: n. 力量, 权力；aux. 可能, 也许
example: Most countries have got at least somewhere on this, chiefly in what might be called i-government: the provision of information.
许多国家在这方面至少有了一些进展，主要在被称为信息政府（i-government）的信息提供方面。

entries.trans: n. 有势力的人；a. 有势力的, 强大的, 有力的；adv. 很, 极
example: Their lovely faces and forms vanished in a flash, revealing monstrous creatures of wood and vine, swinging arms like mighty cudgels at him.
她们那可爱的面孔和形体一下就消失了，变成了由树木和蔓藤混合的恐怖怪物，挥舞着手臂似乎要抽打他。

entries.trans: n. 候鸟, 移居者；[法] 移居者
example: But for a Chinese migrant with a heavy accent to become a stand-up comedian in the US it's more like a fantasy.
但要是一位有着浓重地方口音的华裔移民在美国摇身一变成了单口相声演员，这听上去更像是一场白日梦。

entries.trans: vi. 移动, 移往, 随季节而移居；[计] 迁移程序
example: My prime target this visit to Singapore was one of the two species of Bee-eaters that migrate here.
我这次回新加坡的主要目标是迁徙到该处的两种食蜂鸟之一。

entries.trans: a. 温和的, 温柔的, 淡味的, 适度的, 轻微的, (肥皂等)软性的；[医] 轻的, 缓和的
example: A navy pilot on a routine flight had given in to mild curiosity and dipped his aircraft to inspect what he thought was an oil slick.
海军一名飞行员在例行飞翔途中，看见海面上似乎有浮油，微觉奇怪，忍不住稍稍低飞察看。

entries.trans: n. 英里, 很大距离；[机] 英里, 哩
example: A quarter of a mile up in the sky someone was dancing.
When the bullet struck just a few inches above his head, i couldn't help saying to myself: a miss is as good as a mile.

entries.trans: a. 好战的
example: The militant nature of the western and northwestern tribes is vividly expressed in an elegant and impressive ax blade.
让人印象深刻的是，西部和西北部落尚武的特性被生动的表现在一面优雅的斧刃上。

entries.trans: n. 军队；a. 军事的, 军人的, 适于战争的
example: The last explosion threw him from an armoured vehicle and wounded his leg, putting him in a military hospital for two weeks.
最近一次爆炸把他从装甲车上掀了下来，伤到了腿，在军队医院躺了两周。

entries.trans: a. 乳状的, 乳白色的, 柔和的
example: Her skin was pink and tender, and a pale milky fluid was leaking from her cracked palms, but her burns were healing.
她的皮肤变得粉红而又娇嫩，一丝淡淡的乳白色液体从她碎裂的手掌中渗漏出来，但是她烫伤的部位在逐渐愈合。

entries.trans: n. 压榨机, 磨坊, 制造厂；vt. 碾磨, 磨细, 搅拌, 使乱转；vi. 乱转, 被碾磨
example: From Saturday morning the rumour mill was working and Mark must have realised it was his last game. It was a terrible position to be in.
从周末早晨流言就在到处传播，休斯一定知道这就是他的最后一场球。他的处境一定很难。

entries.trans: n. 毫米；[机] 公厘
example: We'll be able to look at millimetre movements over the time span of a year.
我们将会可以察觉在一年的时间里指距上的毫米运动。

entries.trans: n. 百万富翁, 大富豪；[经] 大资本家, 巨富, 百万富翁
example: Philanthropy is where the power (and the fun) is. And you don't have to be a billionaire (or millionaire, for that matter) to participate.
散财意思是去做慈善，慈善的力量和乐趣是非常大的，参与慈善并不需要你必须是亿万或百万富翁。

entries.trans: n. 矿工, 开矿机, 坑道工兵；[经] 矿工
example: The prevalence of silicosis led some men to grow what is called a miner's mustache, in an attempt to intercept as much dust as possible.
在试图拦截尽可能多的灰尘，矽肺患病导致一些男性到什么是所谓的一个矿工的胡子增长。

entries.trans: v. (使)混合
example: But you might mingle with other young people,  his mother reproved him, but felt a kindness in her heart.
“但是你也许可以和其他人年轻人一样。”他的母亲责备他道，然而却是语重心长的。

entries.trans: n. 缩图, 小画像；a. 小规模的, 纤小的
example: Modern technology, in the form of miniature cameras, smartphones and the internet, means stealing and sharing answers has never been easier.
微型摄像头，智能电话和互联网等高科技手段让抄袭和分享别人的答案变得愈发容易。

entries.trans: a. 最小的, 极微的, 最小限度的；[医] 最小的, 最低的
example: So far, probably thanks in part to its relatively hidden location, there have been minimal lines despite a no-reservations policy.
到目前为止，尽管实行不可预订政策，餐厅仍没有多少排队等位现象，部分原因可能是餐厅位置相对隐蔽。

entries.trans: vt. 将...减到最少；vt. 最小化；vi. 最小化；[计] 最小化
example: On the journey, Navy Captain William Parsons had armed the bomb, which had been left unarmed to minimize the risks during takeoff.
在途中，海军上校威廉·帕森斯将为了在起飞时将风险最小化而加了保险的炸弹解除了保险。

entries.trans: a. 最小的, 最低的；n. 最小值；[计] 最小值
example: The Californian conference also heard details of a laser-based eye test that could pick up the disease when damage is still at a minimum.
在加州举行的这次会议上还讨论了一种基于激光手段检测眼睛的方式，在损害非常微小的时候将疾病发现。

entries.trans: n. 部长, 牧师, 公使；vi. 服侍, 救助, 主持宗教仪式
example: West Bengal Chief Minister Buddhadeb Bhattacharya, a key national Communist leader, says the American president "has gone out of his mind. "
印度西孟加拉邦首席部长布达戴布.巴塔恰吉是印度共产党的一位全国性领袖，他说，布什总统简直“不知所云”。

entries.trans: n. 部, 内阁, 服务；[经] 部
example: Despite his inclination to be a farmer, John Adam's schooling prepared him for college and a career in the Ministry.
尽管约翰.亚当想当农场主，但他所受的教育为他上大学以及在内阁任职做好了准备。

entries.trans: n. 未成年人, 副修科目；a. 较小的, 二流的, 未成年的；vi. 副修；[计] 次要
example: I wanted to send a thank-you note as I'd been raised to do, to feel as if I could return the gift in some minor yet tangible way.
我也想过寄一封感谢信，正如我的教养所要求的，去感受一下可否我以某些微小而又实质的方式，回馈礼物。

entries.trans: n. 少数, 未成年, 少数民族；a. 少数的, 属于少数派的
example: Yanbian one of the state and national economic development compared to other ethnic minority areas, and always among the best.
其中延边州国民经济发展与全国其它少数民族地区相比，始终名列前茅。

entries.trans: n. 薄荷, 造币厂, 巨额；vt. 铸造, 铸币, 制造
example: Newton proved himself equally intolerant of chicanery, when, in his waning years, he took a position as Master of the Mint.
牛顿本人同样也不能容忍欺诈行为，在他晚年的时候，他担任了皇家铸币厂的主管官员。

entries.trans: n. 负号, 不足；a. 减的, 负的, 阴性的；prep. 减, 缺；[计] 负差
example: Minus the size of an integer. to set any other value, specify one of the following.
One day, the teacher inquired Peter: "How much is four minus four? "

entries.trans: n. 奇迹, 奇事
example: It was a miracle that Angel was born and weaned from her mother just in time for us to take her home that day!
天使的出生，以及她及时的断奶，刚好让我们那天能带她回家，这整个安排真是神奇！

entries.trans: n. 镜子, 写真, 典范；vt. 反映, 映出
example: Casting a mirror image from her good eye, Barron created a prosthetic device that she can pop in whenever she goes out in public.
Barron以她健康完好的右眼为模型，为她制作了假体，使她可以随时戴着出门。

entries.trans: n. 损害, 伤害, 灾祸, 恶作剧, 淘气；[法] 损害, 伤害, 危害
example: Miss Su was up to mischief, no doubt. And if she didn't come, so much the better as that would leave just Miss T'ang and himself.
苏小姐无疑地在捣乱，她不来更好，只剩自己跟唐小姐两人。

entries.trans: n. 守财奴, 吝啬鬼, (石油工程上用的)锥钻头
example: If my uncle was certainly a miser, he was one of that thorough breed that goes near to make the vice respectable.
如果说我的伯伯是个不折不扣的吝啬鬼，他倒是这帮人物中出类拨萃的一位，几乎使人对那种坏习惯也感到可敬。

entries.trans: a. 悲惨的；痛苦的；卑鄙的
example: However, due to frequent abortions, she said she was always miserable and depressed, besides feeling guilty over what she had done.
然而，由于频繁的流产，她说她总是感到痛苦和沮丧，除了在她做了什么罪。

entries.trans: n. 痛苦, 悲惨, 不幸, 穷困
example: A few deep gulps of fresh air was all she dared allowherself, and now she retreats to the misery of her stuffy little house.
她只敢享受几大口新鲜空气，又退回到她那可怜而又闷热的小屋子里。

entries.trans: n. 不幸, 灾祸, 坏运气；[法] 不幸事故, 不幸, 灾祸
example: However, a few days later, when I was sure that I hadn't been discovered, I started to feel guilty for her misfortune.
然而，几天后，当我确定我没有被发现时，我开始对她的不幸感到愧疚。

entries.trans: vt. 误导
example: I argued that I did not like to deliberately mystify people or mislead them. His reply was that I misled everybody anyway.
我辩解说我不喜欢故意把事情神秘化或误导人，他的回答是，其实我还是在用各种方法误导每一个人。

entries.trans: n. 发射物, 导弹, 飞弹, 火箭；a. 可发射的
example: North Korea broke the rules once more by testing a rocket that could be used for a long-range missile,  Obama said.
奥巴马说，朝鲜试验可能用于远程导弹火箭的行为再一次破坏了相关决议。

entries.trans: a. 不见的, 缺少的；[法] 行踪不明的, 失踪的, 遗失的
example: Chen was concerned about missing the touring concert for doctor had told him to rest his voice for half a year.
陈楚生非常担心他将会失去这次巡回演唱的机会，因为医生告诉他要让他的嗓子休息半年。

entries.trans: n. 任务, 代表团, 使命, 传教团；vt. 派遣, 向...传教
example: If elected, Patten said her first mission would be to call for a royal commission into child sex abuse in religious institutions.
佩顿还称竞选，头等大事是成立委员会，调查宗教机构中儿童遭受性侵的问题。

entries.trans: n. 传教士, 负有任务者, 工作人员；a. 传教的, 传教士的
example: It had to be somebody,  she said to the erect, austere missionary.
“总要有人来做，”她对坐得笔挺的严肃的传教士说。

entries.trans: n. 雾, 迷蒙, 朦胧不清；vt. 使模糊, 使蒙上雾；vi. 变模糊, 下雾
n. 先生
example: Mister Gordon uses words from hip-hop songs to help young people, especially those who grew up with poverty and abuse, as he did.
戈登先生采用希普霍普歌曲中的歌词来帮助年轻人，特别是帮助那些和他曾经一样生活在贫穷和受虐待的环境中的年轻人。

entries.trans: n. 主妇, 女主人, 情妇
example: And he went in unto Hagar, and she conceived: and when she saw that she had conceived, her mistress was despised in her eyes.
亚伯兰与夏甲同房，夏甲就怀了孕。她见自己有孕，就小看她的主母。

entries.trans: vt. 误解, 误会
example: In other words, the interpreter brings to the text his own set of presuppositions which causes him to misunderstand the text.
换句话说，解释者将他自己的一些先入为主的想法带进他要解释的文本，从而造成误读。

entries.trans: n. 连指手套, 拳击手套
example: She said that she had been given the mitten.
The lover, tells if my , my do not know love , lets you be changed into a frozen mitten to my love from fervency .

entries.trans: n. 混合物, 混乱, 糊涂；vt. 使混合, 弄混, 使结合, 混淆；vi. 相混合, 交往, 参与
example: The singer recorded an interesting mix of hip-hop and Chinese opera, creating a distinctive new sound ready to challenge listeners.
这位歌手将京剧和嘻哈音乐做了有趣地结合，从而创造出了独特的新听觉以挑战听众的耳朵。

entries.trans: n. 混合者, 混合器, 搅拌机, 搅拌器, 混频器, (非正式)交际家, 与人相处的人；[计] 混频器, 音装置
example: The conveyer device is structurally characterized by also comprising a contraction and expansion pipe mixer and an air compressor air duct.
其结构特点是，它还包括缩扩管混合器和空压机输气管。

entries.trans: n. 混合, 混淆, 混合物；[化] 混合物
example: But we've just figured it out our expressions for mu A and mu B, our chemical potentials of each constituent in the ideal liquid mixture.
但我们刚刚计算出，μA和μB的表达式，在理想液体混合物中，每种组分的化学势。

entries.trans: n. 呻吟, 悲叹；vi. 呻吟, 抱怨, 悲叹；vt. 呻吟着说
example: To hear her call her child, and raise her head and listen a whole minute at a time, then lay it wearily down again with a moan.
她呼唤着孩子的名字，有时头抬起来整整有一分钟时间那么长听着，然后无力地呻吟着一头倒在床上。见此情形，大家都说真叫人心碎。

entries.trans: n. 暴民, 民众, 暴徒；vt. 大举包围, 蜂拥进入, 围攻；vi. 聚众生事
example: It embraced him, in Guinness's grand postwar decade of Ealing Studios comedies The Man in the White Suit, and The Lavender Hill Mob.
对他在二战后十年伊林顿电影制片厂的喜剧片《白衣人》和《赖文德山暴民》中的出色表演，更是拍案叫绝。

entries.trans: a. 移动的, 易变的, 机动的；n. 活动物体
example: Mobile will finally take its place as king, a position to which it has rapidly been ascending the last several years.
手机终会称王。手机已朝着这个地位前进了多年。

entries.trans: n. 可动性, 流动性, 机动性；[化] 迁移率
example: The money is not the key here,  said Oliver Hazimeh, head of the global e-mobility practice and a partner at PRTM.
“这边，钱不是问题。”奥利弗（OliverHazimeh），全球移动电子应用的总裁，同时也是PRTM的合伙人。

entries.trans: vt. 动员, 调动, 使流通；vi. 动员
example: With major backing and a first tier partner, the question is whether Knewton can mobilize quickly enough to meet demand.
有了重大支持和一流合作伙伴作为后盾，现在剩下的问题是，Knewton是否能以足够快的速度行动起来，满足市场的需求。

entries.trans: n. 嘲笑, 戏弄, 模仿；a. 假的, 伪造的, 模拟的；adv. 虚伪地；vt. 嘲弄, 模仿, 使失望, 欺骗, 挫败；vi. 嘲弄
example: It would be easy to mock Chinese aspirations to climb the value ladder.
Alice did not feel encouraged to ask any more questions about it, so she turned to the Mock Turtle, and said 'What else had you to learn? '

entries.trans: n. 模态, 调式, 样式, 文体, 状态, 方式, 风尚；[计] 方式; DOS外部命令:设定各种设备命令
example: She was already familiar with the group: in fact, it was Taobao that had inadvertently prompted her to start the Miss de Mode brand.
她对这家企业已经颇为熟悉：实际上是淘宝网无意间激发她创立了“摩登小姐”品牌。

entries.trans: n. 模型, 模范, 模特儿；a. 模范的, 作模型用的；vi. 做模型, 做模特儿；vt. 使模仿, 塑造；[计] 模型
example: This section shows you how to do this using a physical model and its objects. A similar approach can be used for logical models as well.
本节展示如何使用一个物理模型及其对象来实现这个目标——对于逻辑模型也可以使用类似的方法。

entries.trans: a. 适度的, 稳健的, 中等的, 节制的；vt. 节制, 减轻, 使缓和；vi. 变缓和, 主持会议
adv. 适当地, 适度地, 中庸地
example: The body should be moderately short with ribs extending well back into a short, strong loin, deep flanks and very muscular hindquarters .
身体适度的短，肋骨扩张良好，后面是短、结实的腰部，较深的侧腹和肌肉发达的后躯。

entries.trans: a. 谦逊的, 羞怯的, 端庄的, 适度的；[经] 适当的
example: She listen'd with a flitting blush, With downcast eyes and modest grace; For well she knew I could not choose But gaze upon her face.
她听的时候眼光没抬去，脸一红的神情谦恭优雅；因为她清楚知道：我怎能让自己不去凝视她。

entries.trans: n. 谦逊, 质朴, 羞怯
example: The Judge: Deciding what is true and what isn't now seems to me. . . a lack of modesty.
法官：决意什么是真相而且现在对我而言什么不像是…一种虚心的缺乏。

entries.trans: n. 修正, 修饰, 修改；[化] 修饰; 修改
example: Also, the multiplatform installer makes it easy to upgrade existing RealTime activities without user modification.
此外，多平台安装程序使得升级现有RealTime活动很容易，无需用户修改。

entries.trans: vt. 修正, 变更, 修饰, 缓和, 减轻；vi. 被修改；[计] 修改
example: It is original in structure, easy to modify, and can be widely used in teaching.
实验台结构新颖，调整方便，适用范围广泛。

entries.trans: vt. 调整, 使转调, 控制；vi. 转调, 调制
example: By varying the concentration of the two phases it is possible to modulate the mechanical and injectability properties of the material.
通过改变所述两相的浓度，可以调整材料的力学特性和可注射性。

entries.trans: n. 组件, 模数；[计] 模块
example: We have also expanded upon the concept of a flow as a "reusable, self-contained application controller module" .
我们也已将流程的概念扩展为一个“可重用、自包含的应用程序控制器模块”。

entries.trans: a. 潮湿的, 多雨的, 感伤的, 含泪的；[医] 湿的
example: There will always be a time of healing wounds, tears will also be airing, moist place always see the sun.
伤口总会有痊愈的时候，泪水也会被风干，潮湿的地方总会见到阳光。

entries.trans: n. 湿气, 水分, 降雨；[化] 含水量; 含湿量
example: Well, moisture content ranging from people, we must quickly Teng underground kinds, or to miss the next season harvest.
二嘛，墒情不等人，必须赶快腾地下种，要不就误了下一季的收成。

entries.trans: a. 分子的, 由分子组成的；[医] 分子的
example: Super Collagen is enzymatically processed into its amino acid form with a very low molecular weight, which can be utilized 100% by the body.
超级胶原蛋白是酶加工成的氨基酸形成一个非常低分子量，可被人体利用100%。

entries.trans: n. 分子, 些微；[化] 分子
example: You don't see a description of how, you know, Molecule A, you know, comes up and docks with this other molecule.
你看不到这样的描述，也就是关于分子A，靠近并与另外一个分子对接。

entries.trans: a. 瞬间的, 刹那间的
example: What now? A momentary flame of fury burst in Dooku as he thought of his old friend on his ship, laughing at how he'd outmaneuvered him.
现在怎么办？一想到他的老朋友现在正坐在自己的飞船内嘲笑他的失算，一瞬间，狂怒之火突然在杜库心中爆发燃烧。

entries.trans: n. 动力, 动量；[化] 动量
example: He noted China-Pakistan relations have maintained a momentum of sound development since the new government came into office in Pakistan.
巴基斯坦新政府执政后，中巴关系继续保持良好发展势头。

entries.trans: n. 帝王, 统治者, 元首；[医] 单原型(植)
example: 1837 - Queen Victoria of the United Kingdom moves into the first Buckingham Palace in London and is the first British monarch to live there.
1837年的今天，英国维多利亚女王搬进了伦敦的第一个白金汉宫，并成为住在那里的第一个英国君主。

entries.trans: a. 货币的, 金钱的；[经] 货币的, 金融的
example: After all, there was no legal mechanism for a country like Greece to leave the monetary union.
毕竟还没有一个合法的机制让希腊这样的国家离开欧元货币联盟。

entries.trans: n. 监督器, 级长, 监听员, 班长, 监视器, 告诫物；v. 监视, 监听, 监督；[计] 监视器, 监视程序; 监视
example: Since this has never been used or may never be used by MS we will adopt a wait and see approach and continue to monitor for its usage.
因为这从未使用过或可能永远不会使用的MS，我们将采取等待和观望的做法，并继续监测其使用情况。

entries.trans: n. 修道士, 僧侣, 和尚
example: I told her that it must be the boy in my dream who had a happy face and chubby cheeks. And he looked like a little monk without any hair.
我告诉她，她所怀的男婴一定是我梦中那个笑容满面并有张圆胖脸颊的男孩，而且他没有头发，看起来就像个小和尚。

entries.trans: n. 猴子, 猿, 打桩锤；vi. 淘气, 胡闹；vt. 嘲弄
example: Not laughing at you, Chen Bin, you say his face like a monkey's butt . . .  She said with a smile.
“没有笑你，笑陈滨，你说他的脸像猴子屁股……”大妈笑着说道。

entries.trans: n. 垄断, 专卖权, 独占事业；[经] 垄断, 专利品, 垄断(权)独占
example: Although Nestle is the backbone of the city's financial revenue, the local government has no right to help it establish a monopoly.
尽管雀巢公司是该市财政收入来源的骨干力量，但是当地政府没有权利帮助它建立垄断地位。

entries.trans: n. 怪物, 恶人, 巨物；[医] 畸胎
example: Everywhere you seem to turn there's a monster,  he sings. Paparazzi got you scared like a monster.
“每处转弯都有怪兽，”他唱到，“狗仔队象怪物一样让你恐惧。”

entries.trans: a. 巨大的, 畸形的, 怪异的；[法] 巨大的, 异形的, 畸形的:荒诞的
example: Their lovely faces and forms vanished in a flash, revealing monstrous creatures of wood and vine, swinging arms like mighty cudgels at him.
她们那可爱的面孔和形体一下就消失了，变成了由树木和蔓藤混合的恐怖怪物，挥舞着手臂似乎要抽打他。

entries.trans: n. 月刊；a. 每月的, 每月一次的
example: Remember that you are not just forecasting a long term trend, you are trying to do a realistic forecast of the monthly movements.
记得你没有在仅仅正在预测一个长期趋势，你正在尝试做每月的运动一个现实的预测。

entries.trans: n. 纪念碑, 纪念物, 石碑
example: A haze that hung over the wall made it difficult to see parts of the famous monument.
长城笼罩在一片雾气中，很难看清这个著名景观的一些地段。

entries.trans: n. 心情, 气氛, 生气, 基调；[医] 心境
example: 'The challenge is to manage this without carrying into the overall relationship and souring the overall mood, ' he said.
他说，挑战在于在解决这一争端的同时又不会升级至总体关系，也不会令整体局势恶化。

entries.trans: n.荒野；旷野；Moor: 摩尔人.；v.系住；停泊
example: My landlord hallooed for me to stop, ere I reached the bottom of the garden, and offered to accompany me across the moor.
我还没有走到花园的尽头，我的房东就喊住了我，他要陪我走过旷野。

entries.trans: n. 拖把, 鬼脸；vt. 用拖把洗擦, 擦, 拭；vi. 做鬼脸；[计] 维护操作协议
example: It was like trying to mop up a lake with a bath sponge.
Simple Fix: Wet-mop floors at least once a week to keep dust to a minimum.

entries.trans: n. 道德, 品行, 寓意；a. 道德的, 品性端正的, 精神上的
example: Yet any moral superiority New Yorkers may feel should be tempered by the behaviour of the American embassy in London.
不过，美国大使馆在伦敦的行为会让纽约人可能产生的任何道德优越感都荡然无存。

entries.trans: n. 道德, 教训, 品行；[法] 道德, 道义
example: Morality, said the court, cannot be divorced from the constitution.
Politics' nature of uncertainty also makes the political ideology unable to be the sound base for morality.

entries.trans: adv. 而且, 此外
example: Moreover, some parties have not got what they had hoped for out of the project, notably Japan, which had wanted to host the reactor.
此外，有些参与方并没有从这个项目中得到所期望得到的东西，尤其是日本，其本希望成为该反应堆的东道主的。

entries.trans: n. 生物, 人类；a. 不免一死的, 人类的, 临终的
example: By this elevation to a status parallel to that of the Hindu Brahma, the Buddha receded far beyond the reach of mortal man.
这个晋升状态相似的印度教梵天，佛陀下降超出了的人类的人。

entries.trans: n. 抵押, 约束性义务, 抵押借款；vt. 抵押, 以...作担保, 把...许给
example: The move will follow the Wall Street bank's admission last week that it had lost almost $8bn in its mortgage-backed securities business.
此前，这家华尔街投资银行上周承认，其抵押贷款证券相关业务损失近80亿美元。

entries.trans: n. 穆斯林；a. 穆斯林的, 伊斯兰教的
example: The calendar in his hands is not a common one, but a Moslem calendar.
Genghiz Khan decided to leave southern China alone and swing westwards, through central Asia, to- wards the rich Moslem kingdom of Persia.

entries.trans: n. 清真寺
example: My translator suddenly dashed out of the mosque, told me to grab my bag and, seconds later, we were roaring off in a car.
这时我的翻译突然从清真寺里冲了出来，他让我抓起自己的包，几秒钟后，我们驱车飞快逃离了这里。

entries.trans: n. 蚊子；[医] 蚊
example: The mosquito turned out to be a man with an electric saw cutting down a tree in my neighbor's yard. My sleep was over.
蚊子原来是一个人用电锯在砍我的邻居的庭院的树。我的睡眠已经结束。

entries.trans: n. 苔藓, 泥沼；vt. 使长满苔藓
example: All that Edmond had been able to do was to drag himself about a dozen paces forward to lean against a moss-grown rock.
爱德蒙所能做的也只是把自己向前拖了十几步，靠在一块长满苔藓的岩石上。

entries.trans: adv. 大概, 大部分, 主要；[经] 大部份
example: Actually, only for a year. I'm mostly a mid-western girl. I've lived all over the mid-west.
实际上，只住了一年。我算是个中西部女孩。我一直住在中西部。

entries.trans: n. 汽车旅馆
example: Of course, most people who rent motel rooms for a fixed time don't bother with the concept of marriage at all.
当然，多数按照固定时间租住汽车旅馆的人根本不用理会婚姻的概念。

entries.trans: n. 移动, 手势, 动作, 意向, 请求, 提议；v. 打手势
example: Its smooth, swift motion around the sun carries such a square as this every hour.
就像现在一样，它永远驼着这片土地绕太阳平衡而快速地转动着。

entries.trans: vt. 给与动机, 刺激, 提高...的学习欲望, 促动；[经] 促动, 激发, 激励
example: Able to motivate encourage and negotiate with suppliers to meet the company requirements.
能够与供应商商讨并且激发鼓励他们去满足公司的要求。

entries.trans: n. 动机, 目的, 主题, 基调；a. 运动的, 成为动机的
example: Almost all the initiatives related to startups you see in the Philippines are in fact driven by a selfish ulterior motive,  he said.
你在菲律宾看到的几乎所有与创业搭上边的，实际上都是由内心私利引发的。

entries.trans: n. 马达, 发动机, 原动力, 汽车；a. 马达的, 发动机的, 汽车的, 发动的；vt. 推动, 以汽车载运；vi. 乘汽车, 驾车
example: And the British International Motor Show opens in London, showcasing new environmental models.
还有英国国际车展在伦敦展开展出新型环保车款。

entries.trans: n. 高速公路
example: A homemade banner, made of sheets, hangs over the main motorway in Reykjavik, tied to the railings of a bridge.
一条用被单自制的横幅悬在雷克雅未克高速公路主干道上，系在一座桥的栏杆上。

entries.trans: n. 模子, 模制品, 松软沃土, 霉；vt. 形成, 浇铸, 用泥土覆盖；vi. 发霉
example: Look, these neatly lined terra cotta warriors seem to be made with a single mould.
你看，这么多兵马俑都站得整整齐齐的，像是一个模子刻出来的。

entries.trans: n. 乘骑用马, 框, 衬纸, 山；vi. 乘马, 爬上, 增长；vt. 爬上, 使上马, 装上, 装裱, 安放, 制作...的标本, 设置, 上演；[计] 安装
example: Since both the assembly location and the document location must have sufficient evidence to execute, this attack is not easy to mount.
由于程序集位置和文档位置都必须具有足够的证据才能执行，所以并不容易发起这种攻击。

entries.trans: a. 多山的, 如山的, 巨大的
example: Since the Eleventh century, there has been a sizable Druze presence, concentrated in rural, mountainous areas east and south of Beirut.
从11世纪开始，就已经有大量的德鲁士出现，主要集中在乡村地区，东部山区和贝鲁特南部。

entries.trans: v. 哀悼, 忧伤, 服丧
example: After her mother died the beautician also comes to mourn, she said that "we did not think her this has the goal behavior. "
在她母亲死后美容师还前来哀悼，她说，“我们不觉得她这是有目的的行为。”

entries.trans: n. 老鼠, 胆小羞怯的人, 鼠标；vi. 捕鼠, 窥探；vt. 探出；[计] 鼠标
example: Introduction: Panda moved with the mouse or the friends who can jump up to avoid rocks or bad, The first skeleton in the sky Do not touch.
用鼠标移到熊猫或它的朋友们身上就可以跳起来躲过石头或是坏人，天上的骷髅头不要碰。

entries.trans: n. 一口, 满口
example: Even if it were their last bite, their last mouthful, they would not eat without having shared, if there were someone to receive their gift.
如果有人需要他们的施物，即使是剩最后一嚼、最后一口之量，他们也不会只顾自已吃而不分享。

entries.trans: n. 运动, 动作, 运转, 移动, 倾向, 变化, 活动, 乐章；[医] 运动
example: A city is a symphony, to hear it is to follow every note and beat of every movement.
城市是一首交响乐，聆听她，就像在用心感受乐章的每一个音符与节拍。

entries.trans: n. 电影
example: Bite the bullet. Have a specific activity or plan in mind, like going to a movie or dinner, and simply ask if he'd like to go with you.
鼓足勇气。提前设计好特定的活动或计划，例如看电影或共进晚餐，直接问他是否赏光。

entries.trans: n. 泥, 诽谤；vt. 弄脏
example: He did not want it to become frightened and struggle against the wall of rock he was building in the mud.
他不想让马害怕，以至于挣扎起来踢坏他在泥里建好的石壁。

entries.trans: a. 泥泞的, 浑浊的, 模糊的；vt. 使污浊, 使沾上泥污
example: As I taxied over the muddy steel matting of the runway, I got a wave and a grin from my wingman Lt. Rex Barber.
当我驾驶着飞机在泥泞的钢垫跑道上滑行时，我的僚机驾驶员向我边笑边挥手。

entries.trans: n. 有柄大杯, 脸, 苦读者；vt. 给...拍照, 攻击, 苦读；vi. 拼命用功
example: She dumped the mug and scooped up the warm, wet keys, wiping them against her jeans as she hurried back to the front door.
她把优胜杯倒了倒然后把那暖暖湿湿的钥匙铲起来，在她牛仔裤上擦了擦便急急忙忙向正门走去。

entries.trans: n. 倍数, 并联；a. 多样的, 许多的, 多功能的
example: Since Ant allows multiple targets to be defined in one file, you can modify the file content and combine two or more files into one.
由于Ant允许在一个文件中定义多个目标，您可以修改文件内容并将两个或多个文件合并到一个中。

entries.trans: n. 乘法, 增加, 乘法运算；[医] 增殖; 倍增
example: She had not imagined that such a multiplication of wakefulness was possible.
We may begin with one, and that "a little one, " and yet it will "become a thousand. " The LORD is great at the multiplication table.

entries.trans: v. 繁殖, 乘, 增加；[计] 乘
example: N what happens if i take a unit normal n and i multiply it by the length of my other normal big n?
如果我取一个单位法向量，然后用乘上另一个较长法向量N的模长，会怎样呢？

entries.trans: n. 多数, 群众
example: Perhaps in an effort to make up for lost time, the historic law would put an end to a multitude of alarming practices.
也许这是为了弥补失去的时间，这部具有历史意义的法律将结束人们对实践的担忧。

entries.trans: a. 市政的, 自治区的, 内政的；[经] 市政的, 市的
example: A novel composite biofilter patent technique has been used to treat odors produced by municipal solid wastes in this paper.
笔者采用自主开发的复合生物滤池专利技术处理垃圾恶臭气体。

entries.trans: n. 谋杀；vt. 谋杀, 损毁, 破坏；vi. 犯杀人罪
example: Novick recommends that Palmer's presence at the building will send the wrong signal even if it was not a murder.
诺维克劝告他，即使这不是一起谋杀，帕默出现在事故现场也会使人产生不好的误解。

entries.trans: n. 凶手, 杀人者, 谋害者；[法] 谋杀犯, 凶手
example: Don't you think that man's face is similar to that of the murderer wanted by the police?
'Well! 'he said to us, biting the side of his finger. 'So you've decided the accused was the murderer, have you? '

entries.trans: n. 低语, 低声的怨言；vi. 低语, 低声而言；vt. 低声说
example: Above me, above them, I could make out a low wave of moaning, like the murmur of a congregation at litany in church.
在他们之上，在我之上，我可以听到一声低吟，好像是教堂集会时诵经的声音。

entries.trans: n. 肌肉, 臂力；[医] 肌
example: Lack of blood flow through the arteries to certain portions of the heart muscle result in the death of that muscle.
通过动脉到达部分心肌的血液流动不够，导致那些心肌坏死。

entries.trans: a. 强壮的, 肌肉发达的, 有力的；[医] 肌的; 肌肉发达的
example: His aggressive style, flowing hair, and muscular build have made him a fan favorite as well.
他咄咄逼人的风格，流畅的头发，肌肉和建设，使他成为球迷最喜爱的好。

entries.trans: n. 沉思, 冥想；v. 沉思, 冥想, 若有所思地凝望或说
example: Long Qi, or my real strenght differ with you many, but, I muse, you definitely understand, the evil clan reasons of the disability is what!
龙琦，或者我的实力与你差着许多，但是，我想，你一定知道，魔族最致命的弱点是什么！

entries.trans: n. 博物馆
example: A museum committee recommended that the murals be returned. the ministry said the move would be implemented immediately.
周五，博物馆委员会建议归还壁画。内阁表示归还会即刻实行。

entries.trans: n. 蘑菇形物, 蘑菇, 暴发户；vi. 迅速生长, 迅速增加, 采蘑菇；a. 蘑菇形的, 迅速生长的
example: Sixty years of the changes, China has undergone tremendous change in a tower the ground into the sky, like a mushroom, urban face-lift.
六十年的巨变，中国发生了翻天覆地的变化，一座座高楼平地而起，就像雨后春笋，城市面貌焕然一新。

entries.trans: n. 音乐片, 音乐舞台剧；a. 音乐的, 声音美妙的, 喜爱音乐的
example: Musical arts, as an important carrier and a way of performance of culture, are the direct influential power to build a harmonious society.
作为文化的重要载体和表现形式之一的音乐艺术，是构建和谐社会直接而重要的精神动力。

entries.trans: n. 音乐家, 乐师, 作曲家
example: In my own research for an image collection, I used the VIAF to find the name of a Puerto Rican musician called Eddie Santiago.
我自己在VIAF里搜索一张图像的收藏，我查找一位叫做EddieSantiago的波多黎各的音乐家。

entries.trans: n. 芥末, 芥菜, 强烈的兴趣；[医] 芥子; 芥属植物
example: Cut the mustard To perform up to expectations or to a required standard.
收割芥菜行动起来以求符合期望或达到预定标准。

entries.trans: n. 哑子, 哑音字母, 弱音器；a. 哑的, 无声的, 沉默的；vt. 减弱...的声音；vi. 排泄
example: Our new neighbors were a pair of deaf-mute couples, their garden was the best in the whole block.
新家的邻居有一对聋哑夫妇，家里的菜园是整个街区最好的。

entries.trans: n. 喃喃低语；vi. 喃喃自语, 作低沉声；vt. 出怨言, 抱怨地说
example: Turkish generals started to mutter that they might have done better in Brussels if they had joined the Warsaw Pact, not NATO.
土耳其将军们开始抱怨，如果当年加入的不是北约，而是华约的话，也许他们在布鲁塞尔的命运将会更好一些。

entries.trans: n. 羊肉
example: A smile oozed out on Gradman's face, greasy with countless mutton-chops, the smile of a man who sits all day.
格拉德曼那张被无数羊肉片养得油光刷亮的脸上挤出一点微笑来，那是一个成天伏案的人的微笑。

entries.trans: a. 相互的, 共有的；[经] 相互的
example: Thank you for your proposal and we hope to work with you to our mutual village.
The exact nature of the collateral should be disclosed on a regular basis, like the main investments in a mutual fund's portfolio.

entries.trans: a. 神秘的, 难解的, 不可思议的
example: There was one of these mysterious female passengers on every car, all leaning forward, urging their drivers to follow the moon.
每一辆汽车上都有这样一位神秘的女乘客，身体向前倾斜着，催促着她们的司机去追逐月亮。

entries.trans: n. 秘密, 神秘, 奥秘
example: How exactly he cultivated an information network remains a mystery, but rampant rumors claim that it rivals that of the Bothans.
他到底是如何建起一个情报网的依然是个谜，但流言蜚语声称他的情报网能跟博萨情报网匹敌。

entries.trans: n. 神话, 虚构的事, 虚构的人
example: Myth's river-where his mother dipped him, fished him, a slippery golden boy flow ed on, his name on its lips.
神话之河———他母亲浸泡、捞取他的地方，一个滑溜溜的金童流过，他的名字在其唇上；

entries.trans: n. 钉子, 指甲；vt. 用钉钉牢, 使固定, 截住, 揭露
example: Then he gave his son the hammer and told him to pull out the nail.
然后他将锤子拿给儿子，要儿子将钉子拔出来。

entries.trans: a. 天真的, 纯真的, 幼稚的
example: Naive blokes like me continued to think men were supposed to be handsome.
只有像我这样天真的人还认为男士应该英俊潇洒。

entries.trans: a. 裸体的, 无装饰的, 无保护的, 赤贫的；[医] 裸露的
example: Donkey: [seeing Shrek naked in the bed] Aahh! You know, you really need to get yourself a pair of jammies!
驴子（看到史莱克一丝不挂地躺在床上）：啊，你知道吗？你真的需要给自己穿上一条宽大的睡裤！

entries.trans: adv. 即, 就是, 换句话说
example: She saw where she had put herself in a peculiar light , namely , that of agreeing to marry when she was already supposedly married.
她意识到自己的处境有点不尴不尬-一方面她让人把自己看做已婚女子，另一方面她又答应嫁人。

entries.trans: n. 小睡, 稍睡, 细毛, 孤注一掷；vi. 小睡, 疏忽；vt. 使拉毛, 打盹度过, 预测...为获胜马
example: Experienced the whole night suffer from insomnia, the second day after the pain can do remedial work, must be trying to take a nap at noon.
经历了整晚失眠的痛苦之后，第二天能做的补救工作，就是一定要想方设法在中午打个盹。

entries.trans: n. 餐巾, 餐巾纸, 尿布
example: As they were waiting for their meal to arrive, he began doodling a crude picture of a casket on his paper napkin.
在等着饭菜被端上来的时候，他开始在他的餐巾纸上粗糙地画着一口棺材。

entries.trans: n. 叙述, 故事, 叙述文；[法] 陈诉, 原告陈述者事实
example: But Mr. Knight took exception to the book's unadorned dialogue, prose that he says might have used a bit more narration from Mr.
但奈特不喜欢这本书里朴实无华的对话，他认为对话可能让海明威多费了一些笔墨。

entries.trans: n. 叙述, 故事；a. 叙述的, 叙事的, 故事体的
example: The case study of Wan-ji implies one of the multiple ways for practicing queer politics by the queer narrative and its textual corpus.
透过此个案分析，本文指出圈圈的酷儿叙事与其文本身体是酷儿政治多样性的实践方式之一。

entries.trans: n. 狭窄部分, 隘路；a. 狭窄的, 仔细的, 有限的, 勉强的, 狭隘的, 手紧的；vi. 变窄；vt. 使变狭窄
example: Charlotte felt greatly relieved to see him go. It had been a narrow escape.
他走了以后，夏洛蒂长长的松了一口气，终于死里逃生了。

entries.trans: a. 污秽的, 下流的, 险恶的
example: Now they're in the process of a nasty divorce and I feel like I' m on the eggshell every time I talk to either one of them.
现在他们正处于严重的即将离婚的状态并且我自己感觉处在一个两难的境地每次我对他们中的任何一个人说话时。

entries.trans: n. 国家, 民族；[法] 民族, 国家
example: We Irish are too poetical to be poets; we are a nation of brilliant failures, but we are the greatest talkers since the Greeks.
At this point it's hard to see how the nation can escape from this death spiral into default.

entries.trans: a. 国家的, 国立的, 全国性的, 民族的；[经] 全国性的, 国家的, 国民的
example: I ask these questions of my own poem, and invoke such an exacting comparison for it, partly in light of a new national concern with a date.
我也对自己的诗提出这些问题，由此引发了一番如此苦心的对比，或多或少是因为全国对某一个日期难以忘怀。

entries.trans: n. 国籍, 国家, 民族性；[法] 国家, 民族, 国民
example: And I am very proud of it, so please, to those of you who are spreading senseless things about my nationality, give it a rest!
我很骄傲自豪，麻烦那些在我国籍上无聊炒作的人，你们歇歇吧！

entries.trans: n. 本地人, 土产, 当地人；a. 本国的, 与生俱来的, 自然的
example: He was able to retire to his native town and spent the last few years of his life in comfort there.
他得以退休回到他的家乡，在那里他在优于的环境中度过了一生的最后几年。

entries.trans: n. 白痴；a. 自然的, 自然界的, 本能的, 天然的, 物质的, 正常的, 原始的, 自然数的
example: Again, this loss does not show up in the FAO's figures, and the resulting emissions are considered to be natural, not man-made.
又一次，其损失数额没有出现在联合国粮农组织的统计中，导致的温室气体排放被看作是自然现象，而不是人为造成的。

entries.trans: adv. 自然地, 以自然力, 天生地
example: It said the company's "deceit thus would, naturally and inevitably, lead to significant injury or death. "
判决认为，由于“该公司的欺骗，自然而然地、不可避免地导致了重大伤害或死亡。”

entries.trans: n. 自然, 大自然, 本性, 性格, 性质；[医] 自然, 大自然; 本性, 性能
example: Given the busy nature of our lives, it's to be appreciated that we even find the time to indulge in matters of the heart.
生活本忙碌，所以，我们抽出时间满足自己的心灵，这本身就是一件值得赞许的事情。

entries.trans: a. 顽皮的, 没规矩的, 不适当的, 下流的
example: George was sometimes naughty, but he made Nora laugh a lot, and she loved him and she was always very nice to him.
乔治有时顽皮，但他诺拉笑了很多，她爱他，她总是很不错了。

entries.trans: a. 海军的, 军舰的, 有舰队的；[法] 海军的, 军舰的, 船的
example: It comes as something of a surprise to hear that Peter Weir has made a historical naval epic.
当我知道彼德威尔执导了一齣有关海军的史诗式电影，实在有点惊讶。

entries.trans: n. (教堂)中殿, 中央广场, 轮毂；[机] 轮毂
example: It was not so much that I had earlier been nave. It was that I took him on trust.
Nave: Main part of a Christian church, extending from the entrance (the narthex) to the transept or chancel (area around the altar).

entries.trans: n. 航行, 航海, 导航；[经] 航空, 航海, 航船
example: Your navigation bar should appear in the same place on every page, usually horizontally across the top or vertically along the side.
那么，导航条须放在每页的相同位置，通常在水平放在顶部，或者垂直放在边上。

entries.trans: n. 海军, 海军人员, 海军军力, 烟蒂
example: The United States Navy is ready,  Pug shot back. I've been working like a bastard all day on a general operation order for convoy.
“美国海军已经准备好了。”帕格反击说。“我象孙子似的整天在起草一份护航总行动的训令。”

entries.trans: a. 附近的, 近旁的；adv. 在附近, 近旁地；prep. 在...附近
example: Luckily the frog, who had been hunting butterflies nearby, saw him and with all his strength pushed him back into the pond.
幸运的是，青蛙正好在附近捕蝶，他看见了鲦鱼，于是用尽全力把他推回到了池塘中。

entries.trans: a. 整洁的, 巧妙的, 匀称的, 简洁的；n. 牛
example: It was one guy who somehow got it in his head it would be a neat idea and put Church of Scientology San Diego on the list,  Davis told me.
“就是一个家伙不知为何脑袋里冒出个好主意，把圣地亚哥山达基教会放进了名单里，”戴维斯告诉我。

entries.trans: adv. 必然地, 必须地, 必要地
example: Depositor protection can help restore confidence, although it tends to be costly and does not necessarily speed up economic recovery.
尽管储户保护政策代价昂贵且对经济恢复是非必要的，但这种保护政策有助于恢复信心。

entries.trans: vt. 迫使, 使成为必需, 需要
example: Make sure the system has no failing components, particularly those like the motherboard that might necessitate retiring the entire machine.
确保系统没有出现错误的组件，特别是主板这样导致整个机器被淘汰的重要组件。

entries.trans: n. 需要, 必需品, 必然；[法] 必要性, 必然性, 必要
example: This was done largely out of necessity, as the fiber crops that were previously used for the process were experiencing a shortage.
这样做主要是出于需要，作为纤维作物，以前使用的过程中经历了短缺。

entries.trans: n. 脖子, 衣领, 颈；vi. 拥抱, 拥吻, 收缩；vt. 割颈
example: Neck: The front of the neck from the throat to the point of shoulder should be shaved or scissored short.
颈部：脖子的前面从喉咙到肩膀的高度的毛应当剃掉或剪短。

entries.trans: n. 项链
example: And as for her, one might as well expect her to produce a diamond necklace as to show a spark of passion.
至于这个姑娘，希冀她表现出一丝一毫的激情犹如指望她拿出一条宝石项链一样不切实际。

entries.trans: n. 针, 尖；vt. 用针缝；vi. 缝纫；[计] 探针
example: The retailer said there had been a shift away from traditional trees in favour of more unusual, pine-needle free creations.
该零售商称消费者的购买意向已经从传统的圣诞树转为寻求不同寻常的，没有松针的替代品。

entries.trans: a. 不需要的, 不必要的
example: Needless to say, UCLA won that game as well, 13 to 9, and it proved to be one of the greatest upsets in college football history.
不用说，加利福尼亚队以13：9也赢得那场比赛，这场比赛也成为了大学足球赛史上最伟大的一场颠覆。

entries.trans: n. 否定, 否定语, 负数, 底片；a. 否定的, 消极的, 负的, 阴性的；n. 负数, 负值；[计] 负数, 负值
example: People are more open about their desire to be attractive, and plastic surgery no longer has a negative connotation.
人们更加不避讳谈及变漂亮的渴望，而整形手术也不再有负面联想。

entries.trans: n. 疏忽, 忽略, 漏做；vt. 疏忽, 忽视, 不顾
example: Such retaliation arises from purely personal considerations, to the neglect of the interests of the class and of the Party as a whole.
这种报复主义，完全从个人观点出发，不知有阶级的利益和整个党的利益。

entries.trans: a. 可以忽略的, 不足取的, 无用的；[医] 可不计的, 可忽视的
example: The wind was so light that it had only a negligible effect on the outside temperature.
风这么弱，对外面的温度起不了多大的作用。

entries.trans: vi. 商议, 谈判, 交涉；vt. 谈妥, 转让, 处理
example: Negotiate the specific details of an order. Convince your client to choose your product over that of your competitor.
协商订货的细节。在众多竞争者中说服你的客户选择你的产品。

entries.trans: n. 谈判, 磋商, 交涉；[经] 谈判, 协商
example: What was conceived as a bilateral talk turned instead into a negotiation with an emerging-market block.
原先预计的双边对话变成了一场与”新兴市场集合体“的谈判。

entries.trans: n. 黑人；a. 黑人的
example: It was such a night when it is good to hear from faraway, across the dark fields, the slow song of a Negro on his way to make love.
在这样的一个夜晚，你听到远处越过黑黝黝的田野，传来一个去求爱的黑人的慢悠悠的歌声，你会觉得蛮有意思。

entries.trans: n. 附近, 邻近
example: I've always liked old buildings,  she said. I wanted to be in a real neighborhood, with Chinese people.
“我一直喜欢古老建筑，”她说：“希望和中国人住在一个真实的小区里。”

entries.trans: n. 邻居, 邻接的东西, 邻国, 邻座, 邻人, 世人；a. 邻接的, 邻近的；vi.vt. 邻近, 与...结邻, 邻接
example: A neighbour might switch on a lot of red and a bit of green and blue glow a shocking pink.
而旁边的神经元可能激活大量的红色和少量的绿色及蓝色，就会产生粉色。

entries.trans: n. 邻接, 周围, 附近一带, 邻近, 邻居关系, 地区, 街道, 街坊, 四邻；[计] 邻域
example: By this time the news of what had happened at the Hollow was spread all over the neighbourhood.
这时候，洼地出事的消息已经传遍了邻近一带。

entries.trans: a. 邻近的, 接壤的, 附近的；[法] 邻近的, 附近的, 接壤的
example: In accordance with his stockings, was as white as the tops of the waves that broke upon the neighbouring beach.
他的衬衫，虽然不如袜子那样精致，白得好象冲破在邻近海滩上的浪头。

entries.trans: n. 侄子, 外甥
example: One relative who took the body of his nephew to a hospital said the site of the attack was horrifying.
一个亲戚送自己的侄子赶到医院，他说这场袭击真是太可怕了。

entries.trans: n. 精神, 勇气, 叶脉, 神经；vt. 鼓起勇气
example: To mention a subject that makes sb feel angry, upset, embarrassed, etc.
Speaking out usually involved what was for me a slightly nerve-wracking trip to the front of the class.

entries.trans: a. 神经紧张的, 不安的, 神经的；[医] 神经的; 神经质的, 神经过敏的
example: All day yesterday she had been too nervous to eat, which meant it was some thirty-six hours since her last meal.
昨天一整天她一直心神不宁，没有食欲，从上顿饭到现在已有三十六小时滴水未进了。

entries.trans: n. 巢, 窝, 休息所, 隐匿处；vi. 筑巢, 找鸟巢；vt. 为...设窝, 使套叠；[计] 嵌套
example: Seen from the top, it looks as if the stadium is covered by a gray net of steel, and it looks just like a bird's nest made of tree branches.
从顶部看，体育馆好像是覆盖着一张灰色的钢网，看起来正像是用树枝搭成的鸟窝。

entries.trans: n. 网, 网状物, 罗网, 净利, 净价；a. 净的, 最终的；vt. 用网捕, 撒网, 净赚, 得到；vi. 编网；[计] 网络, 网络分析程序
example: In my mind I had presented the net as a gift to her. I did not tell her that it was a gift.
From there, they can be connected to any of the data-aware components just as if they were getting their data from ADO. NET.

entries.trans: n. 网络, 广播网, 网状物；[计] 网络
example: The path can be to a folder on your local computer or to any folder available on your local area network.
路径可以指向本地计算机上的文件夹，还可以指向局域网上可用的任何文件夹。

entries.trans: n. 神经原, 轴索, 神经细胞；[计] 神经元
example: The neuron is a specific sort of cell and the neuron has three major parts, as you could see illustrated here [pointing to the slide].
神经元是一种特殊的细胞并且神经元有三个重要的部分，你可以看这个演示（指向幻灯片）。

entries.trans: n. 中立者, 中立国, 非彩色, 空档；a. 中立的, 中性的, 无色的
example: At the time, Laos had been declared 'neutral, ' but with a growing communist presence, the CIA saw it as the next front in the conflict.
与此同时，老挝宣布“中立”。然而，随着共产党势力的不断扩大，中情局把它当成下一个战争前线。

entries.trans: n. 中子；[化] 中子
example: Large number of defects can be produced by the neutron irradiation damage shown in the results of Molecular Dynamics simulation.
分子动力学模拟结果表明辐照会产生大量的间隙原子、空位及空位团。

entries.trans: adv. 然而, 虽然如此；conj. 然而
example: Nevertheless , Gorbachev made it a point to exhibit his own strength publicly.
然而，戈尔巴乔夫决心公开展示自己的力量。

entries.trans: adv. 重新, 最近
example: For Miami to even come close to winning an NBA championship, they must first make it out of a newly rejuvenated Eastern Conference.
对于迈阿密，甚至先不要说能不能夺得冠军，要接近NBA总冠军，他们首先要走出一个新兴起的东部。

entries.trans: n. 镍, 镍币, 五分镍币；vt. 镀镍于
example: Worthiness: you spend just a nickel when having a shit in a charged toilet of a tourist resort.
值得：在旅游景点的公厕大便时花了五毛钱。

entries.trans: n. 绰号, 昵称；vt. 给...取绰号, 叫错名字；[计] 绰号
example: 'I heard that in the North my nickname is Acorn Head, ' he said, believing it to be a reference to his short hair.
他听说自己在朝鲜的绰号是“橡果头”，他认为这是指他的短发。

entries.trans: n. 侄女, 甥女
example: One night near the end, while my wife, my niece, and I were by his side, Dad suddenly became very active and tried to get out of bed.
在他临终前的一个晚上，我和妻子及侄女都在他床边。他突然变得很活跃，甚至想下床来。

entries.trans: n. 梦魇, 恶梦, 可怕的事物(或情景、人物)；[医] 梦魇, 恶梦
example: He said in a statement that the ordeal had been a "nightmare" .
卡恩在一份声明中称，这一难受的经历是一场“恶梦”。

entries.trans: num. 十九, 十九个
example: Nineteen sixty-eight was one of the most tumultuous and heartbreaking years in American history.
1968年是美国历史上最为混乱和令人悲伤的岁月中的一年。

entries.trans: n. 氮；[化] 氮N-2
example: In areas of poor soils, within two years of cultivation, synthetic nitrogen and mineral fertilizers have to be applied heavily.
在土壤养分贫乏的地区，经过两年内的种植后就必须很大量应用合成氮肥与矿物肥料。

entries.trans: n. 贵族；a. 高贵的, 高尚的, 贵族的, 辉煌的
example: 'Oh yes! Great things may come of it. No doubt our noble relations will be arriving in their carriages as soon as they find out. '
哦，当然！没准儿能由此产生一些大好事儿呢！毫无疑问，我们那些高贵的亲戚一旦得知此事，就会乘坐马车来看望我们的。

entries.trans: n. 点头, 打盹, 晃动；vi. 点头, 打盹；vt. 点头表示, 点(头)
example: With a nod of his head he indicated to me where I should sit.
Delilah Sterne, " Delilah offered with a nod, the lie coming easily to her lips after years of use. "

entries.trans: a. 嘈杂的, 喧闹的；[机] 噪声的, 嘈杂的
example: On our first date he took me to a noisy nightclub, whereas my Mr Right would have taken me for a romantic candlelit dinner.
第一次约会，他带我去了一个喧闹的夜店，然而我的白马王子应该带我去吃一个浪漫的烛光晚餐。

entries.trans: a. 名义上的, 名字的, 有名无实的, 稍许的；n. 名词性词
example: Note that the nominal inside diameter is not the same as the drift diameter but is always slightly larger.
注意到名义内径并非通径规的直径，但是总是稍大于通径规的直径。

entries.trans: vt. 提名, 任命, 命名；[法] 提名...为候选人, 指定, 推荐
example: I told him Dukakis liked the speech so much, he wanted me to go to the Republican convention to nominate Vice President Bush, too.
我告诉他，杜卡基斯非常喜欢我的演讲辞，他希望我去参加共和党的全国代表大会，为布什副总统做提名演讲。

entries.trans: conj. 然而, 尽管, 不过；adv. 不过, 仍然, 尽管如此, 然而
example: While such a scenario might be popular at the local union hall or on the pages of the Daily Kos, nonetheless it makes no logical sense.
虽然这样的观点在当地工会大厅或每日KOS的网站会受欢迎，但无任如何，它没有学术之感。

entries.trans: n. 无意义的事, 荒谬言行, 荒唐
example: You know I think if I see another piece of nonsense about me and Dennis I think I will. Erm. Lets see. Fall asleep.
你知道吗。我想如果我再看见另一篇关于我和丹尼斯的荒谬报道﹐我想我会。呃。让我想想。入睡。

entries.trans: n. 基准, 模范, 标准, 准则, 平均数；[化] 定额
example: FEARS of a general deflation may be receding but in the rich world's housing markets at least, falling prices are still the norm.
对于通货紧缩的恐惧正在减退，但是至少在富裕国家的房地产市场上，房价的下跌仍然是普遍现象。

entries.trans: n. 常态, 标准, 正常, 普通；a. 正常的, 正规的, 标准的, 师范的, 正态的；[计] 标准, 普通
example: More evidence is emerging that test-tube babies might be just as healthy as normal babies, European researchers said Tuesday.
欧洲研究人员8日称，更多迹象表明，试管婴儿和正常孕育的婴儿同样健康。

entries.trans: n. 常态化, 正常化, 正规化；[化] 归一化; 正态化; 正火; 正火处理
example: There was no doubt that a prompt "normalization" of an intersexual body was always "in the best interest of the child" .
没有人质疑对中间性者所迅即实施的“标准化手术”，却有人堂而皇之地认为手术终究“体现了孩子的最大利益”。

entries.trans: adv. 正规地, 合规则, 正常地
example: In fact that applies all round as you do not normally go through such a period of testing, without making remarkable spiritual progress.
在事实中是围绕在你周围的所有回应是因为你不会简单的就通过这个测试的周期，而是要取得卓越的灵性进程。

entries.trans: n. 东北；a. 东北的, 向东北的, 来自东北的；adv. 向东北, 来自东北
example: The *automation junior at Northeast *Petroleum University has worked as a part-time tour guide for her university for three years.
这位东北石油大学自动化专业的大三学生做校内兼职导游已有三年时间了。

entries.trans: n. 北方人；a. 北方的, 向北的, 自北方来的
example: Yet this softly spoken rugby fan from County Down in Northern Ireland is one of the most experienced climate modellers in the world.
然而，这个来自北爱尔兰唐郡、语调温和的橄榄球爱好者，却是世界上最有经验的气候模型分析专家之一。

entries.trans: n. 北方, 北；a. 向北的；adv. 向北
example: His friend said: "No groom, how capable and strong he may be, can be of any use to you if you stick to going northward. "
他朋友说：“如果你坚持向北方走，虽然有能干强壮的马夫，也是没用的。”

entries.trans: adv. 向北方
example: The south-east of England was the hardest hit at the beginning of the week but the snow is now moving northwards where the chaos continues.
这个星期的一开始，英国的东南部地区是受袭最严重的，但是现在雪已经向北部转移。

entries.trans: n. 西北, 西北方；a. 西北的, 在西北的, 来自西北的；adv. 向西北
example: Chinese police have shot and killed a bus hijacker in northwest China after he took a group of Australian tourists hostage.
中国警方开枪打死一名在中国西北地区劫持一组澳大利亚游客为人质的客车劫持者。

entries.trans: n. 著名人士, 值得注意之事物；a. 值得注意的, 显著的
example: The general, a man by no means notable for docility and long-suffering, flew into a rage.
这位将军，一个从不会顺从或忍耐的人，变得暴跳如雷。

entries.trans: n. 记号, 符号表示法, 注释；[计] 记数法
example: Hungarian notation is often viewed as useful programming practice, one that is not implemented without some effort.
匈牙利命名法通常被看作是一种有效的然而却难以掌握的编程实践。

entries.trans: n. 笔记本, 手册, 期票簿
example: In the last two years of his life, when he was sick, he filled a notebook with his thoughts about me.
爸爸在他生命中的最后两年，在生病的状态中，把他对我的看法都写满在记事本上。

entries.trans: a. 著名的, 显著的, 扬名的
example: In a recent study, it was noted that people who sleep less than seven hours per night are much more likely to be classified as obese.
最近的研究显示，一个人每天晚上少睡7个钟头，那他更有可能会成为一个肥胖的人。

entries.trans: n. 注意, 布告, 通知, 预告, 短评；vt. 注意, 通知, 评论, 提及, 关注；vi. 注意
example: To undress one of these women is like an outing that necessitates three weeks advance notice.
“想把她们的衣服脱掉就像需要提前三个星期通知的郊游”。

entries.trans: a. 显而易见的, 显著的, 值得注意的
example: Since the grammar of JSON is fairly simple, you can implement such a parser easily without any noticeable performance difference.
由于JSON的语法相当的简单，您可以轻易地实现这种解析器，而不会带来显著的性能差异。

entries.trans: n. 通知, 通告, 告示；[经] 通知, 通知书
example: Specifies that this object supports a simple, transacted notification for batch initialization.
指定该对象支持对批初始化的简单的事务处理通知。

entries.trans: vt. 通知, 通告, 报告；[计] 通知
example: You agree to notify Cleverlearn immediately of any unauthorized use of your account or any other breach of security.
如发现任何非法使用您的帐号或帐号出现安全漏洞的情况，您必须立即通知Cleverlearn。

entries.trans: n. 概念, 观念, 想法, 打算, 别致的小东西；[经] 概念, 打算, 想法
example: A notion for a story is for me a confluence of real events, historical perhaps, or from my own memory to create an exciting fusion.
对我来说，一个故事意味着聚集了真实事件，历史上的可能事件或者来自我自己的记忆，汇合而成的一个令人激动的混合物。

entries.trans: a. 声名狼藉的, 臭名昭著的, 众人皆知的
example: Such a notorious person has got to the top of the company. That's more than I bargained for.
这样一个臭名昭著的家伙竟然登上了公司最高层。这个我可没料到。

entries.trans: adv. 虽然, 尽管；prep. 尽管；conj. 虽然
example: Notwithstanding this record of growth and change, the Bank is still ~ing with a relatively small number of projects.
尽管有这些增长和变化的记录，该银行所处理的项目仍然比较少。

entries.trans: n. 没有, 零, 无
example: He tossed his brown curls and laughed. 'My soul is nought to me, ' he answered. 'I cannot see it. I may not touch it. I do not know it. '
他甩了甩棕色的卷发，笑道：“我的灵魂于我毫无用处。我看不见他，我触不到它，我亦与它并不熟捻。”

entries.trans: n. 名词
example: The effect of his overenergetic prose style also becomes wearying: every other noun seems to be in italics.
书中一路高亢的散文式风格也难免让人疲累：似乎每隔一个名词就会蹦出斜体字。

entries.trans: vt. 滋养, 使健壮, 怀有
example: If only there were harbours which could nourish great armies, here was the front on which to strike.
只要我们获得能够容纳庞大军队的港口，这里就是展开攻势的前线。

entries.trans: n. 滋养品, 养料, 营养；[医] 营养, 营养品
example: Next to asense of his weakness man would soon find that of his wants. Hence another lawof nature would prompt him to seek for nourishment.
在软弱感之后，他很快就会发现自己有需要；因此，自然法的第二法则就是人会寻求丰衣足食。

entries.trans: n. 小说, 长篇故事；a. 新奇的, 异常的
example: The invention also discloses a novel medium compound A used for the method and a preparation method thereof.
本发明还公开了该方法所用的新的中间体化合物A及其制备方法。

entries.trans: n. 新奇, 新鲜, 新奇的事物
example: Now that two of her three successors have been female, the phrase 'Madam Secretary' is no longer a novelty.
她的三位继任者都为女性，大概“女国务卿”也就不新鲜了。

entries.trans: n. 现在, 现时, 当今；adv. 时下, 现今
example: Nowadays, internet has been a communicative way of modern people. With internet, we feel a fascinating life with a long distance.
因特网目前成为了现代人交流方式。即使我们在很远地方因有了因特网就感到精彩。

entries.trans: adv. 无处, 到处都无
example: There seems to always be a nomination that creeps up out of nowhere, for a movie not many people saw.
在奥斯卡历史上提名时总会冒出一个师出无名的人选出来。这部电影通常受众比较少。

entries.trans: a. 核子的, 原子能的, 核的, 中心的；[医] 核的
example: He said the nuclear reactor was intact and radiation levels were normal.
目前核反应堆工作正常，潜艇内的辐射指标符合标准。

entries.trans: n. 核心, 核子, 原子核, 起点；[计] 核心程序
example: But sperm don't have elaborate cells, just a tightly packed nucleus and a tail for swimming to the egg.
但是精子没有明确的细胞结构，只有一个紧密组装的细胞核以及一个便于游动到卵细胞的尾巴。

entries.trans: n. 讨厌的东西, 讨厌的人, 损害；[医] 损害, 讨厌
example: But the thing is, as long as you don't do something gratuitously stupid or make a flagrant nuisance of yourself, nobody's going to stop you.
但是关键是，只要你不无缘无故地做蠢事，也不要让自己变得臭名昭著，没有人会阻止你。

entries.trans: a. 数字的, 数值的, 以数字表示的, 擅长于计数的；[经] 数字的, 用数字表示的
example: Well, first off, remember that regression can only be used for numerical outputs. That differentiates it from Nearest Neighbor immediately.
首先，回归只能用于数值输出，这是它与最近邻的最直接的一个不同点。

entries.trans: a. 很多的, 数目众多的, 多数的；[机] 多数的, 甚多的
example: Numerous falconers have viewed a general concern that captive bred birds seem to be getting smaller.
无数的鹰猎者观察发现圈养繁殖的鸟类似乎是越养越小了。

entries.trans: n. 修女, 尼姑
example: I learned that she was a Roman Catholic nun on vacation from her position as an educational administrator.
我知道她是罗马天主教会的修女，以教育管理者的身份来度假的。

entries.trans: n. 托儿所, 苗圃, 温床；[医] 婴儿室, 托儿所
example: At the Taman Safari Zoo in Indonesia, one-month-old Sumatran tiger twins and a pair of baby orangutans shared a room in the zoo's nursery.
在印度尼西亚的塔曼野生动物园，一对一个月大的苏门答腊虎双胞胎和两只小猩猩一起生活在动物园的保育室。

entries.trans: n. 养育, 营养物, 培育；vt. 养育, 供给营养物, 教养
example: The controversy is often conveniently referred to as nature vs. nurture.
为方便起见，这种争论通常被称为天性论与环境因素论之争。

entries.trans: n. 坚果, 核心, 螺帽；[计] Novell NetWare服务器实用程序
example: A guy would give his left nut to be able to read a girl's mind for a day.
男生愿意用他左边的蛋换取可以读懂女生在想什么的一天。

entries.trans: a. 营养的, 滋养的；n. 营养物, 滋养物
example: Nutrient production would occur closer to the surface, promoting a food chain benefiting different species, as they migrate farther north.
养分的产生将越发接近海平面，促进食物链惠及不同的物种，因为它们往北迁移。

entries.trans: n. 营养, 营养学；[医] 营养, 营养品
example: The next time you step up to the deli counter, remember this: Bland white bread can't compete with hearty whole wheat in taste or nutrition.
下次当您朝熟食柜台走去时，要记住这一点：清淡的白色面包无论在味道上还是在营养价值上是不能与全麦面包相比的。

entries.trans: n. 尼龙；[化] 尼龙; 聚酰胺纤维
example: With the advent of extremely light silicone impregnated nylon, these tarps weigh in at less than a pound, are cheap, and are easy to make.
随着涂硅尼龙的出现，这类篷布的重量可以控制在一磅以内，而且价格便宜，制作也很简单。

entries.trans: n. 橡树, 橡木；a. 橡木制的
example: The Fibonacci pattern gives plants like the oak tree a competitive edge while collecting sunlight when the Sun moves through the sky.
斐波那契布局让橡像木这样的植物在太阳在天空中移动的情况下在收集太阳光上具有竞争力。

entries.trans: n. 桨, 桨手, 搅棒；vi. 划桨；vt. 划动
example: I grabbed one oar, and I don't remember whether Dave grabbed the other oar or was trying to restart the engine.
我抓著一根桨，而我已不记得大卫是否是抓著另一根桨或者是在试著要启动引擎。

entries.trans: n. 誓约, 誓言, 咒骂；[法] 誓言, 誓约, 宣誓
example: The man sitting in the cart, angry at the young man in the way, whipped him on the face with an oath .
该名男子在车上坐着，在路上的年轻人愤怒，掀起的脸与他的誓言。

entries.trans: n. 服从, 顺从, 忠实；[法] 服从, 顺从, 遵从
example: Each of these, he claimed, can generate obedience, but each is suitable for a different stage in an organisation's development.
他指出这三者中的任一种形式都能使人服从，但在一个机构的发展中，不同的时期应使用不同的形式。

entries.trans: a. 服从的, 顺从的, 孝顺的；[法] 服从的, 顺从的, 忠顺的
example: If he is the King of kings and Lord of lords, then our only response is to be obedient to him in all walks of life.
如果他就是万王之王和万主之主，那么我们唯一的反应就只有是在生命里完完全全地顺服他。

entries.trans: a. 肥胖的；[医] 肥胖的
example: Babies who are bottle-fed until the age of two are more likely to be obese when they start school, a US study suggests.
一项美国研究显示，到两岁都还喝奶的婴儿，上学后更可能过胖。

entries.trans: vt. 服从, 遵从, 顺从；vi. 服从
example: I wish to be a director of a farm, so the others on the farm must obey me!  Sara said, with her head held high.
萨拉高高地昂起头说：“长大后我一定要成为农场的女管事，我要让农场里的人都听我的！”

entries.trans: n. 物体, 目标, 目的, 对象, 宾语, 客体；vi. 反对, 抱反感；vt. 提出...来反对；[计] 对象
example: Now that you know the name of the file, you can read this file into its own simpleXML object.
现在您知道了文件名，可以将此文件读入到它自己的simpleXML对象中。

entries.trans: n. 异议, 反对, 不喜欢, 缺点, 缺陷, 妨碍, 拒绝之理由；[法] 异议, 反对, 抗议
example: The skilful do not seem to hear the murmured objection, and they continue their manoeuvres.
机灵人似乎听不见这种窃窃私议的反对意见，仍旧继续他们的勾当。

entries.trans: n. 目的, 目标, 宗旨, 宾格, 实物；a. 客观的, 如实的, 无偏见的, 宾格的
example: OBJECTIVE To solve the question of "double loop" in the potency determination of Gentamicin Sulfate Granules including the content of sugar.
目的解决含糖庆大霉素颗粒剂供试品溶液抑菌圈出现的“双圈”问题。

entries.trans: n. 义务, 责任, 约束, 契约, 恩惠, 债务；[经] 待付款, 债务, 义务
example: One of the doomed democracy activists, plotting against the regime, insists: "It is our obligation to call injustice by its name. "
一位因密谋推翻独裁政权而被判刑的民主活动人士坚称：“呼唤公正是我们的责任。”

entries.trans: vt. 强制, 施恩惠于, 使感激；vi. 施恩惠, 帮忙
example: Economic constraints will oblige America to define its global objectives in terms of a mature concept of the national interest.
经济限制将迫使美国从国家利益出发，以成熟观念制定全球性目标。

entries.trans: a. 淫秽的, 猥亵的, 讨人厌的, 可憎的；[法] 猥亵的, 海洋的, 污秽的
example: A fair number of words are therefore labeled as frivolous, vulgar, obscene, or at least inconsiderate when used in communication.
在人们交流的场合中，有相当一部分词语显示的是轻浮的、俗的、至少是使人难堪的意思。

entries.trans: a. 模糊的, 昏暗的, 难解的, 晦涩的, 偏僻的, 微贱的, 无名的；vt. 使变暗, 隐藏, 使变模糊, 使难解
example: The special terminology understood among the members of a profession, discipline, or class but obscure to the general population; jargon.
"But make no mistake that this film is so obscure that it might not make a return of your capital, " he reminds fund raisers.

entries.trans: n. 观察, 注意, 观测, 观察力；[化] 观察
example: Such a fine screen in the pursuit of the process of observation of young children can develop.
这样在追求画面精细过程中可以培养幼儿的观察力。

entries.trans: vt. 觉察到, 遵守, 注意到, 庆祝；vi. 注意, 评论
example: Casually drop BitTorrent into a conversation with a studio executive, and observe as they choke back their rage.
随便跟一个录音室主管谈谈BitTorrent，看看他们是怎么气得说不上话的。

entries.trans: n. 观察者, 遵守者, 观察员；[法] 观察者, 观察员, 监场员
example: The relative size of Planet X, along the edge of the Sun, has been computed by an observer.
沿着太阳边缘的行星X的相对大小被一位观测者计算了出来。

entries.trans: n. 困扰, 困扰人的情绪；[医] 强迫观念
example: His lifelong obsession with the curative powers of the orgasm no doubt played a part in the FBI and FDA's dogged pursuit of him.
一生迷恋性欲的治疗作用无疑是他受到FBI和FDA追捕的原因。

entries.trans: n. 障碍, 妨害物, 阻碍
example: The main obstacle had been the extent to which Chinalco would be represented on Rio's board of directors, he explained.
他解释道，中铝能得到几个董事会席位成为主要障碍。

entries.trans: a. 倔强的, 顽固的, 不让步的
example: Why the young rancher, irascible, obstinate, belligerent, should invariably defer to the poet, was an inconsistency never to be explained.
这位年轻的农庄主人，脾气急躁，生性固执，动不动喜欢吵架，竟然会始终对这诗人唯命是听，真是一个无从解释的矛盾。

entries.trans: vt. 获得, 达到；vi. 流行, 得到公认
example: If I could obtain US $ 9000 scholarships annually, I would be able to complete my studies.
如果我每年可获得9000美元奖学金，我就能顺利完成学业。

entries.trans: a. 明显的, 明白的, 显然的, 平淡无奇的
example: Regardless of serum ALP of men or women in the normal range, there was no obvious difference in each age stage.
而血清碱性磷酸酶不论男性或女性均在正常范围，各年龄段差异无显著性。

entries.trans: adv. 显而易见地, 明显地
example: Your case is just like a mosquito trying to shoulder a mountain or a small centipede trying to run on the river, it is obviously impossible.
这好比要一只蚊子背负大山，及令商蚷这种小虫在大河里奔跑一样，都是无法胜任的。

entries.trans: n. 场合, 时机, 机会, 诱因, 理由；vt. 惹起, 引起
example: On this occasion several of them told me that their lives had gotten better over the last seven years.
在这次聚会中，好几个人都告诉我，他们的生活在这七年中变得更好了。

entries.trans: a. 偶然的, 临时的；[法] 偶然的, 特殊场合的
example: Although there was an occasional classic French, or a semblance of Italian, by and large it was a gastronomic desert.
虽然偶尔也有不错的法国菜餐馆，或勉强算是意大利菜的餐馆，但这里基本上还是一个美食荒漠。

entries.trans: adv. 有时候, 偶而
example: He said he had quit, but then hastily added that he occasionally fell off the wagon.
他先说自己已经戒烟，但马上又补充说他偶尔也会烟瘾复发。

entries.trans: n. 职业, 占有, 占有期, 占领, 占领军；[经] 占有, 占用, 职业
example: But Abe's words and actions have not always been this free, as he stated during the Indonesian occupation of Timorese territory.
But the British did not think so, that the British era, full of mind are the massacres, occupation, or even extinction.

entries.trans: vt. 占领, 占(时间、空间等), 住进, 担任, 使从事, 使全神贯注；[法] 占领, 占据, 占有
example: I honestly think no more worthwhile activity could occupy my time. Edwin Markham has summed it up better than I could.
说实话，我认为没有什么工作能比它更值得付出时间了。

entries.trans: vi. 发生, 被想到, 存在
example: In trying to make things easier for you, basic mode sometimes does things automatically that don't occur in other modes.
为了尽量简化您的工作，基本模式有时自动执行在其他模式下不会执行的操作。

entries.trans: n. 发生, 事件, 出现；[医] 发生
example: Error, mistake is often in a time of occurrence of the.
It could have been a random occurrence tied to the specifics of the circumstance, so I decided to experiment.

entries.trans: n. 海洋, 广阔, 许多, 一大片；[法] 海洋, 海
example: Fossils bear testament to an ocean-covered formative period, although today Tatooine is all but waterless.
化石证明（塔图因）的表面曾经有段时期覆盖着广阔的海洋，然而现在却几乎没有水面。

entries.trans: n. 大洋洲
example: We had a great trip to New Zealand and capped it all off with a strong performance against the Oceania All Stars.
我们美妙的新西兰之旅以与大洋洲全明星队的完美表演精彩落幕。

entries.trans: a. 奇数的, 古怪的, 剩余的, 零散的, 各种各样的, 少量的；n. 奇特的事物, 怪人；[计] 奇数, 奇校验, 光数据数字转换器
example: And these,  said the chief, as two of his tribesmen dragged an odd-looking crate into the hut.
“还有这些，”酋长说道，同时他的两个部族手下拉着一个外形奇特的板条箱进到屋里。

entries.trans: n. 气味, 香味, 名声, 意味；[医] 气味
example: But if it had been following the odor plume, it would have come in from the other direction.
但是如果我们跟踪这气味痕迹，它可能会来自另外一个方向。

entries.trans: n. 气味, 臭气, 香气, 味道, 迹象, 名誉, 声誉；[医] 气味
example: Or cut off the flowers of wormwood growing in the rut, and crushing them in his hands, sniffed at the bitter-sweet, pungent odour.
有时采几朵长在田垄上的苦艾花，放在手掌上揉碎，然后闻那股强烈的甘苦香味。

entries.trans: n. 犯罪, 冒犯, 违反, 罪过, 过错, 攻击；[法] 犯法, 罪过, 过错
example: Another Guardian writer, Cath Elliott, is often assumed to be a lesbian by men who take offence at her dislike of rapists and sex murderers.
另外一个卫报作家凯斯·伊利尔特常常会因为不喜欢强奸及性爱谋杀主题而被男人们所厌恶，同时还被认为是一个女同性恋。

entries.trans: v. 犯罪, 冒犯, 违反, 进攻
example: If all printers were determined not to print anything till they were sure it would offend nobody, there would be very little printed.
Here and there a bit of green or red light is used to highlight some spots, but they don't offend the eye.

entries.trans: a. 令人不快的, 侮辱的, 攻击性的；[法] 攻击的, 进攻的, 冒犯的
example: He began to read the paper. There was a new Allied offensive in Italy, the newspaper headlined.
他开始看起报来。报上用大字标题报导说，盟军在意大利又发动了一次新的进攻。

entries.trans: n. 给予(物), 出价, 提议, 意图, 报价；vt. 提供, 出价, 奉献, 试图, 使出现, 演出；vi. 出现, 献祭, 提议, 求婚
example: That can be bought, used, etc.
Like an entertaining satire, the plot and characters of that report offer useful material for contemplation.

entries.trans: n. 军官, 主管, 官员, 公务员；vt. 指挥
example: Looking at him, I imagined that whatever his rank in the Japanese army had been (possibly an officer), he had performed his duties well.
我想，像他这样的人不管他在日本军队里是什么头衔（可能是个军官吧），他肯定会做得非常出色。

entries.trans: n. 官员, 公务员, 职员；a. 公务的, 官方的, 正式的
example: I didn't say the result was good, commented F. D. R. to a State Department official after Yalta. I said it was the best I could do.
“我没有说这个结果是好的，”罗斯福在雅尔塔之后向外交部的意味官员解释说，“我是说这是我所能做到的最好的结果了。”

entries.trans: n. 抵消, 把...并列, 旁系, 支管, 用胶印法印；vt. 弥补, 抵消, 胶印；vi. 装支管；n. 偏移量；[计] 偏移量
example: A second error was that Japan tried to offset the adverse economic effects of a strong yen with over-lax monetary policy.
第二个错误在于日本试着用过度宽松的货币政策来抵消强势日元对经济的副作用。

entries.trans: n. 子孙, 后代, 产物；[法] 后辈, 子孙, 后裔
example: Then, rich Britons with an eye on the future did not splash out on Chinese nannies so that their offspring might learn Mandarin.
后来，着眼与未来的富裕的英国人，不再为了他们的后代学习普通话，把大量的金钱挥霍到中国保姆身上。

entries.trans: n. 欧姆；[化] 欧姆
example: I wish I can take a bath and just soak, but, ohm, well, I'm a bit long and I don't fit in my bathtub. so it just stresses me out.
我希望我能洗个澡，只是泡一泡，但是，嗯，我现在已经很大了，不适合在我的浴缸里。所以我就出去。

entries.trans: n. 油, 石油, 油画颜料；vt. 涂油于, 使融化成油状, 加油于；vi. 加燃油, 融化
example: Copper oil lantern is made of a distinctive image of the little lamp and a huge component.
喀麦隆铜烟斗灯由一个形象鲜明的小人和一支巨大的灯管组成。

entries.trans: a. 好, 可以, 行, 对, 好吗, 很好；adv. 好, 可以, 行, 对, 好吗, 很好；n. 同意, 签认, 批准, 认可；vt. 同意, 签认, 批准, 认可
example: How bad has political correctness become that people are up-in-arms about a schoolyard slur but totally okay with a threat of violence?
政治性诋毁语言演变成那些如同学校操场上被侮辱的没有防御能力的人的代名词是如此糟糕，但却允许暴力恐吓？

entries.trans: n. 橄榄, 橄榄树, 橄榄色, 橄榄枝；a. 黄绿色的, 黄褐色的, 橄榄色的
example: In a casserole pan or roasting tray, fry the meat for a couple of minutes in half the butter and a little olive oil, until nice and golden.
在焙盘或烤盘里加入一半的黄油及一些橄榄油，把肉放进去，炸到金黄。

entries.trans: vt. 省略, 删除, 疏忽, 遗漏；[化] 省略
example: The genius is often in what you omit or leave on the editing room floor.
天才和凡人的区别往往在于被遗留在剪辑室地板上的胶片。

entries.trans: pron. 自己, 亲自
example: Our website provides China for the foreigner Anhui to help oneself or to travel on foot the entire journey service.
我们网站为外国人提供中国安徽自助或徒步旅游全程服务。

entries.trans: n. 洋葱；vt. 因洋葱使掉泪
example: As you move down the list of artifacts, you'll see that each document is the next layer of the onion.
当你在构建的列表上向下移时，你将看到每篇文档都是洋葱的下一层。

entries.trans: prep. 在...之上
example: But, of course, the vectorial sum is really the force with which the surface pushes onto that object.
但是，向量和，也的确是斜面，施加在物体上的力。

entries.trans: a. 向前的, 前进的；adv. 向前, 前进, 在先
example: But, he concludes, most researchers say that in the absence of a vaccine, a combination of these methods could slow the onward march of HIV.
但是，Cohen得出结论说，在缺乏疫苗的情况下，对这些方法的联合应用确实能够减缓艾滋病毒扩张的脚步。

entries.trans: adv. 向前, 在前面
example: Not to expose your true feelings to an adult seems to be instinctive from the age of seven or eight onwards.
从七八岁时起不再向大人表露真实感情似乎是一种本能。

entries.trans: n. 不透明物；a. 不透明的, 不传热的, 不传导的, 阴暗的；[计] 白底
example: It's not opaque,  he said indignantly. You can get plenty of information if you know where to look on a Bloomberg machine.
他愤怒地说：“什么不透明，如果你知道在彭博机（Bloombergmachine）什么位置去找，就能得到足够的信息。”

entries.trans: n. 开始, 口子, 穴, 揭幕；a. 开始的
example: Her eyes could not reach him; and the concert being just opening, she must consent for a time to be happy in an humbler way.
她的目光见不到他，音乐会刚好开始，她暂时只得将就着开开心。

entries.trans: n. 歌剧
example: Maybe I should write a play about what I was doing and copyright it. It certainly would be good for a few scenes on a soap opera.
也许我应该把我正在做的事情写成一个剧本并取得版权，作为一出肥皂剧里面的几幕肯定是不错的。

entries.trans: v. 操作, 运转, 动手术, 活动
example: A signal from a modem ( data set ) to a DTE indicating that it is ready to operate.
一种从调制解调器（数传机）到数据终端设备（DTE）的信号，用来表明它已就绪，等待操作。

entries.trans: n. 操作, 动作, 手术, 运算, 作用, 业务；[计] 运算
example: At the beginning of operation, to gear pump within the shell filled with liquid to be delivered, for safety launch.
在开始运转前，往齿轮泵的壳体内灌满待输送的液体，便于安全启动。

entries.trans: a. 操作的, 运作的；[法] 操作上的, 业务上的, 可起作用的
example: There it was attached to the underbelly of the Dark Reaper, and after thousands of years, the ancient Sith weapon was operational yet again.
在那里，采集器被附于黑暗收割器下方，历经数千年，这件古代西斯武器可以再次投入运转了。

entries.trans: n. 操作员, 行家, 经纪人, 算子, 运算符；[计] 运算符
example: A Compute Scalar operator is often used after a Constant Scan to add columns to a row produced by the Constant Scan operator.
ComputeScalar运算符通常在ConstantScan之后使用，以将列添加到ConstantScan运算符生成的行中。

entries.trans: n. 意见, 评价, 主张；[经] 意见
example: Going to a medical clinic wouldbe exposing himself to pathogens on the loose and he would get sick, in his opinion.
他认为，去医疗诊所会将自己完全暴露给病菌，就会生病。

entries.trans: n. 鸦片；[化] 阿片; 鸦片
example: The production of cocaine and opium is probably about the same as it was a decade ago; that of cannabis is higher.
可卡因和鸦片的产量和十年前一样；大麻产品比过去更高。

entries.trans: n. 对手, 敌手, 反对者；a. 敌对的, 反对的, 对面的

If your opponent is shifting in an attempt to set up a charge or a ranged or area attack, either of these allies might foil those plans.

entries.trans: n. 机会, 时机
example: However, green politicians and environmental campaign groups said the tax as a wasted opportunity and did not go far enough.
然而，提倡环保的政治家及环保运动组织表示，这项碳排放税纯属浪费机会，远远不能达到效果。

entries.trans: vt. 反对, 以...对抗, 抗争；vi. 反对
example: Since the downfall of the Gang of Four, we too have made it a state policy to oppose superpower hegemony and keep world peace.
粉碎“四人帮”以后，我们制定中国的国策，同样也是反对霸权主义，维护世界和平。

entries.trans: a. 相对的, 相反的, 对面的；prep. 对面；n. 对立面
example: Or, worse, I approach it from the absolute opposite end of the spectrum, as if in the very moment when a close connection shatters.
或更糟糕，我会从完全相反的地方看待，仿佛那一刻一个紧密的联系破碎了。

entries.trans: vt. 压迫, 压抑, 使烦恼
a. 眼睛的, 视觉的, 光学的；[机] 光学上的, 光学的
example: However, the terminology is often used to calculate decibels and measure signal intensity on copper, optical, and wireless media.
然而，这术语常常使用来计算分贝和测量在铜质、光学的和无线媒体上的讯号强度。

entries.trans: n. 光学；[化] 光学
example: These $70 American Optics Original Pilot Sunglasses are the real thing, used by astronauts since the beginning of the human space program.
这70美元的美国飞行员太阳镜光学原件是真实的东西，由宇航员利用自人类太空计划的开始。

entries.trans: a. 最佳的, 最理想的；[化] 最优的
example: Compared with trial participants who did not achieve optimal control of any measures.
与没有任何最优控制措施干预的试验参与者相比。
